ap:254043.body:
Lunds universitet grundades 1666 och rankas återkommande som ett av världens främsta lärosäten. Här finns omkring 46 000 studenter och 8 500 medarbetare i Lund, Helsingborg och Malmö. Vi förenas i vår strävan att förstå, förklara och förbättra vår värld och människors villkor.

Lunds universitet välkomnar sökande med olika bakgrund och erfarenheter. Jämställdhet, lika villkor och mångfald är grundläggande principer för alla delar av vår verksamhet.
Beskrivning av forskargruppen
Forskargruppen Clinical Memory Research vid Institutionen för kliniska vetenskaper Malmö bedriver ledande forskning om biomarkörer för Alzheimers sjukdom och andra neurodegenerativa sjukdomar, såsom Lewykroppsdemens och Parkinsons sjukdom. Forskningen, som har fått internationellt erkännande genom BioFINDER-projekten, har under flera år legat i framkant inom området vätskebaserade biomarkörer och hjärnavbildning, vilket möjliggör tidig och korrekt upptäckt, diagnostik och prognos av sjukdom.
Gruppen leds av universitetslektor Sebastian Palmqvist och universitetslektor Niklas Mattsson-Carlgren och består av forsknings- samt teknisk/administrativ personal. Arbetsplatsen är belägen vid Biomedicinskt centrum (BMC) i Lund.
Vi samarbetar nära med Minnesmottagningen vid Skånes universitetssjukhus i Malmö, där flera av våra forskare även arbetar kliniskt. Du kan läsa mer om vår spännande forskning här
Vi är en internationell forskargrupp som värdesätter en god arbetsmiljö präglad av respekt och omtanke i våra möten. Vi eftersträvar en arbetsplats som upplevs som utvecklande och stimulerande för alla medarbetare. Vi arbetar kontinuerligt med att skapa förutsättningar som främjar trivsel, utveckling och delaktighet. Vi värnar om både den fysiska säkerheten och den psykosociala arbetsmiljön.
Vi erbjuder
Lunds universitet är en statlig myndighet vilket innebär att du får särskilda förmåner, generös semester och en förmånlig tjänstepension. Vi har även ett flextidsavtal som skapar goda förutsättningar för balans mellan arbete och fritid.

Läs mer på universitetets webbplats om att vara anställd vid Lunds universitet  Jobba hos oss
Projektbeskrivning
Anställningen är i första hand knuten till ett femårigt multicenterprojekt (2026–2031) som finansieras av amerikanska National Institutes of Health (NIH) genom ett så kallat U01-anslag, för klinisk validering av blodbiomarkören MTBR-tau243 vid Alzheimers sjukdom tillsammans med Washington University in St. Louis, University of Pennsylvania och University of Alabama at Birmingham. Arbetet omfattar dock hela forskargruppens verksamhet, med longitudinella data från flera tusen deltagare i BioFINDER-studierna (biomarkörer i blod och ryggvätska, PET- och MR-avbildning, kognition, genetik och proteomik).
Arbetsuppgifter och ansvarsområden
Som biostatistiker arbetar du nära gruppens forskare och utgör en resurs för statistisk analys. Den primära uppgiften är att planera och genomföra statistiska analyser till vetenskapliga artiklar och att sammanställa data i olika projekt. Arbetsuppgifterna omfattar bland annat att:
planera och genomföra statistiska analyser till vetenskapliga publikationer i samarbete med gruppens forskare, t.ex. avseende diagnostisk precision (ROC-analys, cutoffs, kalibrering, prediktionsmodeller) och longitudinella data (mixed models, tid till händelse m.m.)
sammanställa och kvalitetssäkra analysdataset från gruppens databaser i olika projekt
ta fram tydliga figurer och tabeller av publikationskvalitet utifrån data
skriva reproducerbar och väldokumenterad analyskod i R
bidra till U01-projektets statistiska analysplan och förspecificerade analyser, i samarbete med projektledaren och statistiker vid de amerikanska parterna
skriva utkast till metod- och resultatavsnitt samt granska statistiska delar av manus
ge statistisk rådgivning vid studiedesign, powerberäkningar och val av metod
följa metodutvecklingen inom området och introducera nya verktyg och arbetssätt i gruppen.

Kvalifikationer
För anställningen krävs.
doktorsexamen i statistik, biostatistik, epidemiologi eller annat relevant område med tydlig statistisk inriktning. Doktorsexamen ska vara avlagd senast vid tidpunkten då anställningsbeslut fattas.
mycket goda kunskaper i R, inklusive datahantering och programmering av reproducerbara analyser.
mycket god förmåga att visualisera data och skapa tydliga figurer av publikationskvalitet.
goda kunskaper i statistisk modellering, framför allt regressionsmodeller, metoder för diagnostisk precision och analys av longitudinella data.
mycket goda kunskaper i engelska i tal och skrift (engelska är gruppens arbetsspråk).
stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personliga egenskaper. Den vi söker är noggrann och strukturerad, har god förmåga att förklara statistiska metoder och resultat för kliniker och forskare, är serviceinriktad och kan arbeta med flera parallella projekt och deadlines.

Meriterande för anställningen är:
tidigare erfarenhet av statistiska analyser av kliniska eller medicinska data, särskilt inom biomarkör-, kohort- eller demensforskning. Detta är mycket meriterande.
kunskap inom vårt forskningsfält: Alzheimers sjukdom och andra neurodegenerativa sjukdomar (AD/ADRD).
medförfattarskap på vetenskapliga publikationer och vana att skriva metod- och resultatavsnitt eller andra stödjande textavsnitt i manus.
erfarenhet av att skriva statistiska analysplaner och genomföra förspecificerade analyser, t.ex. inom kliniska prövningar eller diagnostiska valideringsstudier.
vana att använda LLM-baserade AI-verktyg i statistiskt arbete (kodning, dokumentation, textutkast) och/eller erfarenhet av maskininlärning på kliniska data.
erfarenhet av datahantering i databaser (t.ex. REDCap, SQL) och harmonisering av variabler mellan kohorter.
kunskaper i Python eller andra programmeringsspråk.

Övrigt
Anställningen är en tillsvidareanställning med omfattning 100 % och tillträde snarast, enligt överenskommelse. Provanställning i sex månader kan komma att tillämpas. Anställningar vid Lunds universitet bedrivs i Sverige, du förväntas därför kunna utföra ditt arbete på plats i Lund.
Kunskaper i svenska är inte ett krav för anställningen. Projektets arbetsspråk är engelska.
Så här söker du
Anställningen söks via universitetets rekryteringssystem. Ansökan ska innehålla ett personligt brev där du beskriver hur du uppfyller kvalifikationskraven samt varför du är intresserad av anställningen. Ansökan ska även innehålla CV, examensbevis samt övrigt som du önskar åberopa (kopior av betyg, uppgifter till referenser, rekommendationsbrev etc.). Universitetet tillämpar individuell lönesättning. Ange gärna löneanspråk i din ansökan.
Universitetet tillämpar individuell lönesättning. Ange gärna löneanspråk i din ansökan.
Medicinska fakulteten är ett verksamhetsområde inom Lunds universitet, med ansvar för utbildning och forskning inom medicin, vård och hälsa. Utbildningen sker i nära samverkan med sjukvården och är väl förankrad i fakultetens starka forskningstradition. Fakultetens forskning spänner över ett brett fält inom experimentell grundforskning, patientnära klinisk forskning och hälsovetenskaplig forskning. Medicinska fakulteten, med drygt 1800 anställda och 3000 studenter i Lund, Malmö och Helsingborg, är en kunskapsintensiv mötesplats för studenter, lärare och forskare från hela världen.
Institutionen för kliniska vetenskaper i Malmö är en av de sex institutionerna vid Lunds universitets medicinska fakultet. Vi har ett starkt fokus på klinisk och epidemiologisk forskning, och bedriver även en omfattande preklinisk laboratorieforskning.

ap:254045.body:
The Biozentrum of the University of Basel is one of the world's leading life sciences institutes. With 33 research groups and 500 employees, we are a dynamic and international research community that has spawned many fundamental discoveries in biology and medicine as well as several Nobel laureates. Join our community!

The research group of Prof. Knut Drescher at the Biozentrum of the University of Basel seeks to appoint a PhD student in molecular microbiology, with a focus on bacterial biofilms . The position is available immediately or by mutual agreement.
The project

The research group of Knut Drescher ( https://drescherlab.org ) focuses on understanding the development and emergent properties of bacterial communities (called “biofilms"). Biofilms are antibiotic-tolerant bacterial communities that are the cause of many chronic and acute infections in humans, but biofilms are also a model system for understanding basic aspects of multicellular organization in living systems. Our projects utilize highly controlled laboratory experiments based on microfluidic growth systems for biofilms, and stem-cell-derived organoids and bioengineered tissues for infections. We recently made important discoveries about danger signals that trigger biofilm formation ( Nature Microbiology 2025 ) and emergent behaviors of biofilms ( Cell 2023 ) that are the basis for the PhD project.

The PhD project will investigate new emergent behaviors of biofilm communities that do not occur in isolated bacterial cells. The project will utilize a variety of molecular tools to analyze, manipulate, and perturb biofilms. A particular focus will be on the use of transcriptomics, genetics, and confocal microscopy methods for investigating cellular behaviors in biofilms during biofilm growth and during infections. The exact project is flexible and will be developed together with Knut Drescher, depending on the strengths and interests of the PhD student.

To get an overview of our lab's recent projects, take a look at our publications: https://drescherlab.org/publications.html
We are looking for a highly motivated and talented PhD student to join our lab. Required qualification: A Master's degree with a research thesis in molecular microbiology.
We offer a fully funded PhD position in a highly interactive, multidisciplinary, and international research group at the Biozentrum. Our group brings together expertise in molecular microbiology, biophysics, as well as bioinformatics and the analysis of large datasets. Additionally, the PhD student will be part of the Swiss NCCR AntiResist consortium, with lots of opportunities for scientific exchange with colleagues in related fields. Moreover, the Biozentrum offers excellent support from various core facilities with expert staff, and a structured PhD program. Our group embraces diversity and equal opportunity. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

Basel is an international city with people from over 150 countries, located on the border where Switzerland, Germany, and France meet. Basel is home to numerous biomedical research institutions, offering outstanding opportunities for training, networking, and career development. Basel provides a high standard of living and a rich and varied cultural atmosphere.

Job description
The Project
The transition to digital CBM is vital for asset owners as they face challenges such as labour shortages and aging infrastructure. Traditional CBM still relies heavily on information coming from manual inspections, analysis, and planning. While generic digital tools exist, they often fail to deliver efficiency gains for complex and specialized assets like navigation locks.
Navigation locks are made up of many structural and mechanical components, each with unique degradation mechanisms. These can be detected and structural condition indicators drawn when changes in certain parameters are detected/triggered. Understanding these “triggers” is essential for building a digital CBM ecosystem that truly works. By identifying and clustering triggers, and deploying sensors optimally, we can create a Structural Health Monitoring (SHM) system that offers reliable, real-time insights into the condition of a lock complex.
Challenge
The aim of this project is to design a framework for the SHM system of the Hengelo Lock Complex . You will investigate how the condition of the lock is currently assessed and identify triggers that allow for automated, continuous SHM with minimal human interventions.
Your research will cover:
· Analysis of structural and mechanical behaviour of lock components.
· Review of relevant national, regional, and organizational regulations and guidelines.
· Evaluation of current practices and feasible structural health monitoring technologies.
· Cost–benefit assessment of sensor deployment and measurement interpretation strategies.
This is a multifaceted project at the intersection of structural and mechanical engineering, asset management, and Civionics – sensor-based SHM of civil infrastructure.
Context and Supervision
The project is sponsored and hosted by Rijkswaterstaat , the executive agency of the Dutch Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management. Rijkswaterstaat designs, constructs, manages, and maintains key infrastructure in the Netherlands.
You will be supervised by:
· Dr. Farid Vahdatikhaki (University of Twente)
· Dr. Roland Kromanis (University of Twente)
· Mr. Sukon Wu (Rijkswaterstaat)
You will work closely with Rijkswaterstaat to deliver a tailor-made design artifact with real-world impact. The project is based in Enschede/Hengelo .
On successfully completing the program, you will receive a certified and recognised degree. You will be entitled to use the academic title of Engineering Doctorate (EngD). You will be registered as a Technological Designer in the Dutch register kept by the Royal Institution of Engineers in the Netherlands (KIVI).
Your profile
We invite you to apply when fulfilling the following conditions. You are:
• One of the best M.Sc. graduates with a background in structural and mechanical engineering, structural health monitoring, monitoring systems, and asset management.
• You have the ambition and talent to accelerate in finding solutions / crafting designs for complex technological issues with a multidisciplinary character.
• Your professional English proficiency is high. A working command of Dutch is highly preferred.
• You like to spend time in a professional organisation like Rijkswaterstaat, and the academic environment of the University of Twente
• You work systematically and like designing innovative solutions.
• You can work independently.
• You have strong communication and social skills.
• You can collaborate in teams and take initiative to develop solutions.
• You must be willing to move to (the vicinity of) Enschede. Presence at the UT and Rijkswaterstaat branch in Hengelo is expected on a daily basis.
Our offer
• Two-year fulltime EngD position, where scientific and research domains are combined optimally with education and practical implementation of innovative design.
• Full status as an employee at the UT, including pension and health care benefits
• Tailor-made educational/development program of at least 6 months (30 EC), including visits to conferences.
• A salary of €3.173,- gross per month.
• An annual holiday allowance of 8% of the gross annual salary, and an annual year-end bonus of 8.3%.
• Minimum of 29 holidays per year in case of fulltime employment.
• A work environment on a green and lively campus with sports and leisure facilities.
• Mentorship that supports your professional and personal growth.
Information and application
Please send your application using the instructions below before November 15th . Your submission is considered eligible if it includes (only and no less than) the following documents:
• Recent CV (including relevant academic, and (if any) professional experience)
• Motivation letter (max 1 page) specifically explaining your interest and relevant background knowledge for the project.
• Overview of M.Sc. degree: including thesis project title, thesis abstract, and grade list
Please contact the selection committee for more information about the project or your eligibility. You can reach them via email on [email protected] (Farid Vahdati) and [email protected]
(Roland Kromanis).
About the organisation
At the Faculty of Engineering Technology (ET), we work on engineering for impact: developing smart, sustainable, human-centred and technological solutions for societal challenges. We connect fundamental education, research and practice across five core domains: Asset & Maintenance engineering, Intelligent Manufacturing Systems, Personalised Health Technology, Resilience Engineering, and Sustainable Production, Energy and Resources.
We work on education and research in mechanical engineering, civil engineering and industrial design engineering. Together, we learn by making, creating, and innovating, addressing challenges in a solution-oriented way. Quality, connection and inclusivity are the foundation of our culture.
In our open community, students, researchers and staff collaborate with industrial and societal partners. This enables us to develop insights, applications and solutions that add value to society.

ap:254047.body:
Introduction
Are you fascinated by improving the acoustic performance of timber buildings? Help develop advanced numerical models that predict sound transmission and bridge the gap between sustainable construction and high acoustic performance. Join this joint PhD project between TU/e and DTU!
Job Description
Buildings made from timber and other biobased materials generally have a significantly lower carbon footprint than conventional concrete or masonry constructions. However, lightweight timber structures often exhibit high variability in sound insulation, and poor acoustic performance remains a barrier to their wider adoption in the construction industry.
A still poorly understood source of this variability lies in the connections between structural components, such as screws, nails, steel brackets, and adhesive joints. Whether a floor is screwed or glued together, and how widely spaced the fasteners are, can significantly affect how sound travels through a building. Current prediction methods largely ignore these details, while more detailed models are often too computationally expensive for practical use. Developing methods that are both physically accurate and computationally efficient is therefore the central challenge of this project.
We offer a PhD position (4-year contract) within the QUIET-ARC project, a collaboration between Eindhoven University of Technology (TU/e) and the Technical University of Denmark (DTU) as part of the EuroTech Universities PhD programme.
As a PhD candidate in the QUIET-ARC project, you will investigate how different connection types and layouts influence sound transmission in timber buildings, develop efficient numerical simulation methods to model these effects, and quantify the uncertainty introduced by construction variability into acoustic predictions.
Noise is recognised by the World Health Organisation as a major public health concern. By improving the predictive capability of computational models for timber buildings, this research supports more reliable prediction tools for sustainable constructions and contributes to the wider adoption of low-carbon building materials.
The project will take place under joint supervision of dr.ir. Cédric Van hoorickx (TU/e, specializing in numerical modelling of sound transmission) and dr.ir. Jonas Brunskog (DTU, with expertise in the acoustics of lightweight structures). You will be based in the Building Acoustics research group ( https://building-acoustics.net/ ) in the Department of the Built Environment at TU/e, and will spend approximately six months at DTU’s Acoustic Technology group in Denmark.
Job Requirements
A master’s degree (or an equivalent university degree) in acoustics, building physics, civil engineering, mechanical engineering, or related disciplines.
A research-oriented attitude.
Motivated to develop your teaching skills and coach students.
Fluent in spoken and written English (C1 level).

The following experience could be considered an advantage and may be highlighted in your motivation letter:
Affinity for building acoustics, vibro-acoustics, or structural dynamics
Previous experience with/affinity for computational methods
Previous publications and scientific communications

Conditions of Employment
A meaningful job in a dynamic and ambitious university, in an interdisciplinary setting and within an international network. You will work on a beautiful, green campus within walking distance of the central train station.

In addition, we offer you:
Full-time employment for four years, with an intermediate assessment after nine months. You will spend a minimum of 10% of your four-year employment on teaching tasks, with a maximum of 15% per year of your employment.
Salary and benefits (such as a pension scheme, paid pregnancy and maternity leave, partially paid parental leave) in accordance with the Collective Labour Agreement for Dutch Universities , scale P (min. € 3,204 - max. € 4,051 gross base salary per month (full-time)).
In addition to your base salary, you will receive an 8% holiday allowance and an 8.3% year-end bonus, both calculated based on your annual gross base salary.
Generous leave options: a standard 29 days (based on a 38 hour working week) per year that you can increase to 41 days by working two hours more per week (flexible working hours). This is prorated if you work part-time.
As a TU/e employee, you participate in the ABP pension scheme, providing retirement pension and pension benefits for surviving dependents and occupational disability. TU/e pays 70% of the pension premium, while employees contribute the remaining 30%.
High-quality training programs and other support to grow into a self-aware, autonomous scientific researcher. At TU/e we challenge you to take charge of your own learning process .
An excellent technical infrastructure, and on-campus children's day care.
Unlimited access to the modern on‑campus TU/e Student Sports Center at an exceptionally affordable rate.
We support your wellbeing with free 24/7 access to OpenUp, providing you and your family with mental health support, expert guidance, and online training.
An allowance for commuting, working from home and internet costs.
A Staff Immigration Team and a tax compensation scheme (the Expat Scheme ) for international candidates.

On our website you can discover even more information about our conditions of employment . Build on your career at TU/e!
About us
We are a leading international university where scientific curiosity meets a hands-on mindset. We work in an open and collaborative way with high-tech industries to tackle complex societal challenges. Our responsible and respectful approach ensures impact — today and in the future. TU/e is home to over 13,000 students and more than 7,000 staff, forming a diverse and vibrant academic community. Discover what Light Up means to TU/e in our short company video .
Our university is located in Brainport Eindhoven — a world‑leading tech region with more than 7,000 high‑tech companies and strong R&D activity. Known for breakthroughs in AI, photonics, semiconductors and advanced manufacturing, Brainport is a place where technology serves people and society. Learn more about the Brainport region here .
Information
Do you recognize yourself in this profile and would you like to know more? Please contact the hiring manager dr.ir. Cédric Van hoorickx, assistant professor, [email protected] .
Visit our website for more information about the application process . You can also contact Yvette Maass, HR-Advisor, [email protected] .
Curious to hear more about what it’s like as a PhD candidate at TU/e? Please view the video .
Are you inspired and would like to know more about working at TU/e? Please visit our career page.
Application
We invite you to submit a complete application by using the apply button. The application should include a:
Cover letter in which you describe your motivation and qualifications for the position.
Curriculum vitae, including a list of your publications and the contact information of three references. Kindly note that we may reach out to references at any stage of the recruitment process. We recommend notifying your references upon submitting your application.
Copies of relevant BSc and MSc diplomas and grade transcripts.

Ensure that you submit all the requested application documents. We give priority to complete applications.

We look forward to receiving your application and will screen it as soon as possible. The vacancy will remain open until the position is filled.
Please note
You can apply online. We will not process applications sent by email and/or post.
A pre-employment screening (e.g. knowledge security check) can be part of the selection procedure. For more information on the knowledge security check, please consult the National Knowledge Security Guidelines .

ap:254055.body:
Willkommen an der Hochschule Anhalt, einer der forschungsstärksten Hochschulen des Landes. Im Herzen Mitteldeutschlands bieten wir als eine der Innovativen Hochschulen Forschung und Lehre auf internationalem Niveau sowie beste Studien- und Lebensqualität.
Mit mehr als 70 Studiengängen schaffen wir individuellen Freiraum zur Entwicklung von Persönlichkeiten und bereiten etwa 7.000 deutsche und internationale Studierende vor allem auf eines vor: einen gelungenen Berufsstart.
Am  Fachbereich Informatik und Sprachen  der  Hochschule Anhalt , Standort Köthen (Anhalt), ist ab dem nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt die auf 36 Monate befristete Vollzeitstelle eines
Wissenschaftlichen Mitarbeiters (m/w/d), Nr. 479
im  Bereich Web Engineering  zu besetzen.
Das Beschäftigungsverhältnis richtet sich nach dem Tarifvertrag für den öffentlichen Dienst der Länder. Die Einstellung erfolgt, bei Erfüllung der persönlichen Voraussetzungen, bis in die Entgeltgruppe 13 TV-L.
Die Stelle wird aus Drittmitteln des Verbundprojekts „KLARA – KI-Labor für verantwortungsvolle Anwendung, Reflexion und Akzeptanz in der Pflege“ finanziert. In KLARA entsteht gemeinsam mit Partnern aus Wissenschaft, Wirtschaft und Pflegepraxis ein webbasierter Demonstrator, in dem Pflegeeinrichtungen generative KI in einer geschützten Umgebung erproben können. Das Teilprojekt der Professur Web Engineering erforscht und entwickelt die Sicherheitsarchitektur für die datenschutzkonforme Integration generativer KI – von der Autorisierung von KI-Agenten über die Absicherung von RAG-Komponenten gegen Prompt-Injection bis zum Vergleich cloudbasierter und lokaler Sprachmodelle.
Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören:
Analyse des Forschungsstands und wissenschaftliche Untersuchung von Sicherheitsrisiken generativer KI (u. a. Prompt-Injection, Risiken von RAG-Systemen und KI-Agenten),
Anforderungsanalyse und Konzeption von Systemarchitekturen für die Integration generativer KI (u.a. Schnittstellen, Rollen- und Rechtekonzepte, modulare Einbindung von KI-Modelle),
Entwicklung von Sicherheitskonzepten unter Berücksichtigung der DSGVO und des EU AI Act sowie systematischer Vergleich cloudbasierter und lokal betriebener Sprachmodelle,
Spezifikation, prototypische Implementierung und Integration von Sicherheitskomponenten, Durchführung von Sicherheitstests sowie technische Begleitung der Praxiserprobung in Pflegeeinrichtungen,
Veröffentlichung der Ergebnisse in wissenschaftlichen Publikationen und auf Fachtagungen sowie Erstellung technischer Leitfäden,
Transfer der Forschungsergebnisse in die Lehre sowie Betreuung projektbezogener Abschlussarbeiten und studentischer Projekte sowie Anleitung studentischer Hilfskräfte.

Sie verfügen über:
ein abgeschlossenes wissenschaftliches Hochschulstudium (Diplom (Uni) bzw. Master) der Fachrichtung Informatik (oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet),
fundierte Kenntnisse in Softwarearchitektur sowie praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Web-Anwendungen insbesondere im Backend (z. B. mit Python und/oder TypeScript),
Erfahrung in der Anbindung von Large Language Models (z. B. über APIs) sowie Kenntnisse zu Retrieval-Augmented Generation und agentenbasierten KI-Systemen,
Kenntnisse   in  IT- und API-Sicherheit, insbesondere zu Authentifizierungs- und Autorisierungsverfahren (z. B. OAuth 2.0/OpenID Connect),
wünschenswert: Erfahrung mit lokal betriebenen Sprachmodellen, Containertechnologien (z. B. Docker) und CI/CD sowie Kenntnisse zu Sicherheitsrisiken von LLM-Anwendungen,
sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Es erwarten Sie:
die Mitarbeit an einem aktuellen Forschungsthema an der Schnittstelle von generativer KI, IT-Sicherheit und Datenschutz mit unmittelbarem Praxisbezug im Gesundheitswesen,
die Zusammenarbeit in einem interdisziplinären Verbund aus Informatik, Pflegewissenschaft, Medizinethik, Wirtschaft und Pflegepraxis,
großer Gestaltungsspielraum bei Konzeption und Umsetzung sowie eine enge fachliche Begleitung durch die Professur Web Engineering,
die Vorzüge eines Tarifvertrags im öffentlichen Dienst, transparente Bezahlung, 30 Tage Urlaub (bei 5-Tage-Woche), die Gewährung einer Jahressonderzahlung und Vermögenswirksamer Leistungen, eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge über die Versorgungsanstalt des Bundes und der Länder (VBL),
bedarfsorientierte Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten,
flexible und familienfreundliche Arbeitszeitmodelle sowie die Möglichkeit im Home Office zu arbeiten gemäß der jeweils gültigen Dienstvereinbarung.

Om stillingen
Institutt for produktdesign ved fakultet for teknologi, kunst og design har en ledig åremålsstilling som stipendiat innen design, kunst og helse, tilknyttet prosjektet «Skapende fellesskap? Hvordan gruppebasert kreativitet kan redusere ensomhet i eldreomsorgen».
Prosjektet undersøker hvordan gruppebaserte kunstneriske og kreative aktiviteter kan bidra til å redusere ensomhet, styrke sosial tilhørighet og fremme livskvalitet blant eldre som bor på sykehjem. Gjennom samskapende prosesser mellom eldre, helsepersonell, kunstnere og designere skal prosjektet utvikle og undersøke kunstneriske intervensjoner som også kan være gjennomførbare og bærekraftige innenfor eldreomsorgen.
Stipendiatstillingen er forankret i forskergruppen Design og kultur, og innebærer samarbeid med relevante fagmiljøer og eksterne aktører innen kunst, design og eldreomsorg.
Stillingen lyses ut som 3 år med 100% forskning. Det er et mål at kandidaten skal fullføre PhD-programmet/-graden innenfor den besluttede tidsrammen.
Dine ansvarsområder og arbeidsoppgaver vil være å
Som stipendiat vil du undersøke hvordan kunstneriske og designbaserte intervensjoner kan utvikles og gjennomføres for å fremme sosial tilhørighet og redusere ensomhet blant eldre i sykehjem.
Prosjektet benytter et exploratory sequential mixed-methods design, hvor kvalitative kunst- og designbaserte metoder kombineres med kvantitative målinger. Samskaping står sentralt, og prosjektet vil involvere eldre, helsepersonell, kunstnere og designere i utviklingen og gjennomføringen av kreative intervensjoner.
Arbeidsoppgavene vil blant annet omfatte:
gjennomføre litteraturgjennomgang om kunst, design, kreativitet, aldring og ensomhet
utvikle og lede samskapende workshops i samarbeid med eldre, helsepersonell, kunstnere og designere
utforske hvordan materialbaserte design og kunstneriske prosesser kan bidra til mestring, sosial tilhørighet og livskvalitet
samle inn og analysere kvalitative og kvantitative data
undersøke hvilke mekanismer som påvirker deltakernes opplevelse av ensomhet og sosial tilhørighet
bidra til utvikling av modeller og retningslinjer for kreative intervensjoner i eldreomsorgen
formidle forskningsresultater gjennom vitenskapelige publikasjoner, konferanser og relevante faglige arenaer

Det vil også være aktuelt å samarbeide med NOVA, gjennom prosjektets metodiske og tverrfaglige forankring innen sosialgerontologi og forskning på ensomhet.
Som stipendiat ved OsloMet har du mulighet til å søke om stipend for lengre forskningsopphold i utlandet.
Kvalifikasjonskrav
mastergrad eller hovedfag innen design, kunst, kunst- og håndverksfag eller tilsvarende relevante fagområder. Graden må normalt inneholde 120 studiepoeng (ECTS). Søkere med mastergrad bestående av mindre enn 120 ECTS må innen søknadsfristen dokumentere at graden kvalifiserer til opptak til doktorgradsstudier i landet hvor mastergraden ble tatt.
en faglig profil som passer forskningsgruppens og instituttets behov
for ansettelse i stillingen stilles normalt følgende karakterkrav: minimum gjennomsnittskarakter B på emner som inngår i mastergraden
minimum karakter B på masteroppgave/hovedoppgave
unntak fra karakterkravene er oppgitt på doktorgradsprogrammets nettside ( - Innovasjon for bærekraft - OsloMet ).

God skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne på norsk/svensk/dansk (minimum B2-nivå) og engelsk ( Språkkrav for ansatte ved OsloMet )

Godkjent opptak til doktorgradsprogrammet Ph.d. i innovasjon for bærekraft (PINS) ved Fakultet for teknologi, kunst og design er en forutsetning for stillingen. Det må søkes om opptak til doktorgradsprogrammet innen tre måneder etter tiltredelsesdato.
Generelle kriterier for ansettelse som stipendiat fremgår av forskriften ( Forskrift til universitets- og høyskoleloven- Lovdata ).
Det vil være en fordel om du har
utdanning eller kompetanse innen relevante samfunnsfaglige fagområder
erfaring med kunstneriske, designbaserte eller andre praksisnære forskningsmetoder
erfaring med samskaping, deltakende design eller brukermedvirkning
interesse for eldreomsorg, aldring, ensomhet og sosial bærekraft
erfaring med å planlegge og gjennomføre workshops eller kreative gruppeprosesser
kunnskap om kvalitative forskningsmetoder, intervjuer og observasjon
interesse for kvantitative metoder og analyse av spørreskjemadata
interesse for tverrfaglig samarbeid
erfaring med samarbeid med eksterne aktører eller praksisfelt

Personlige egenskaper
gode samarbeidsevner og evne til å arbeide selvstendig
gode analytiske og metodiske ferdigheter
kreativitet, nysgjerrighet og evne til nytenkning
gode kommunikasjonsferdigheter
strukturert arbeidsform og god gjennomføringsevne
motivasjon for å bidra til utvikling av inkluderende og bærekraftige helse- og omsorgstjenester

Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt.
Det er viktig for OsloMet å gjenspeile befolkningen i vår region og vi ønsker alle kvalifiserte søkere velkommen. Vi arbeider aktivt med å utvikle oss videre som en inkluderende arbeidsplass og for å tilrettelegge arbeidsplassen dersom du har behov for det. Har du perioder i livet hvor du ikke har vært i arbeid, utdanning eller opplæring er du også velkommen til å søke hos oss.
Vi tilbyr
interessante arbeidsoppgaver ved Norges tredje største universitet
deltakelse i forskningsgruppe og et kreativt og inspirerende fagmiljø
muligheter til faglig utvikling
gode velferdsordninger og et bredt spekter av tilbud av aktiviteter innen kultur og sport
låne- og pensjonsbetingelser i Statens pensjonskasse

Stillingen lønnes, i henhold til Hovedtariffavtalene i staten og OsloMets lønnspolitikk i stillingskode 1017 stipendiat, kroner 550 800 per år. Fra lønnen trekkes 2 % pensjonsinnskudd til Statens pensjonskasse (SPK).
Søknadsprosess
Vil du søke på stillingen må du søke via vårt rekrutteringssystem.
Innen søknadsfristen må du laste opp følgende dokumenter:
søknadsbrev som beskriver din motivasjon for å søke stillingen
CV, attester og alle sider av vitnemål. Utenlandsk utdanning bør være godkjent på forhånd, og godkjenningsbrev må da vedlegges søknaden. Informasjon finnes via lenken: Godkjenning av utenlandsk utdanning – jobb i Norge | HK-dir
masteroppgave/hovedoppgave
eventuelle vitenskapelige arbeider eller lenke til full artikkel
liste over eventuelle publikasjoner og presentasjoner på internasjonale seminarer/konferanser
eventuelt portfolio
gjerne kontaktinformasjon til to referanser

Vi behandler kun søknader sendt via vårt elektroniske rekrutteringssystem og alle dokumenter må lastes opp for at din søknad skal behandles. Dokumentene må være på et skandinavisk språk eller engelsk. Oversettelser må være autorisert og du må påregne å fremvise originaler ved et eventuelt intervju. OsloMet gjennomfører kontroll av dokumenter, slik at du som kandidat skal få en reell evaluering og rettferdig konkurranse. Ufullstendige søknader vil ikke bli tatt til vurdering.
For aktuelle stillinger gjennomfører OsloMet bakgrunnssjekk av søkere i samarbeid med en ekstern leverandør, for å verifisere opplysninger som fremgår av tilgjengelige dokumenter. Bakgrunnssjekk skjer alltid med kandidatens samtykke, og ansettelse i disse stillingene forutsetter godkjent bakgrunnssjekk. Aktuelle søkere vil motta nærmere informasjon om dette.
Ønsker du nærmere informasjon om stillingen kan du kontakte:
Førsteamanuensis Vibeke Sjøvoll, epost: [email protected]
For spørsmål av administrativ karakter, kontakt studieleder Angeliki Dimaki-Adolfsen, epost: [email protected]

Informasjon til deg som søker
Inkludering og mangfold styrker vår evne til å løse OsloMets samfunnsoppdrag. Derfor ønsker vi medarbeidere med ulike kompetanser, livserfaringer og perspektiver velkommen. Vi arbeider kontinuerlig for å være en inkluderende arbeidsplass, og gjennom dialog tilrettelegger vi for medarbeidere som har behov for det.
OsloMet er EU sertifisert HR Center of Excellence for Charter & Code  for forskere som støtter karrieremuligheter, mobilitet og arbeidstaker rettigheter for forskere.
OsloMet har sluttet seg til prinsippene og forpliktet institusjonen til å følge anbefalingene i DORA-erklæringen (sfdora.org) (The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment).
Ansettelsen blir gjennomført etter prinsippene i statsansatteloven og lovverk som regulerer eksport av kunnskap, teknologi og tjenester. Søkere som er i konflikt med dette regelverket vil ikke anses kvalifisert for stillingen.
Besøk OsloMet på LinkedIn , Facebook , Instagram
Om oss
OsloMet - storbyuniversitetet er Norges tredje største universitet med 23 000 studenter og over 2600 ansatte. Vi har campus i Oslo Sentrum og på Romerike. OsloMet leverer forskning og utdanning med høy relevans for arbeidslivet, velferdsstaten og storbyregionen.
I over 200 år har OsloMet – storbyuniversitetet bidratt til å bygge kunnskap og kompetanse for det norske velferdssamfunnet. I dag er OsloMet et moderne og urbant universitet som er kjent for sine store og solide fagmiljøer innenfor lærerutdanning, helse- og sosialfag, samfunnsforskning, design og teknologifag.
Fakultet for teknologi, kunst og design (TKD) utgjør et sterkt og mangfoldig faglig miljø med tydelig internasjonalt preg. Arbeidet gjøres i en profesjonell organisasjon som er ledende i å ta i bruk ny teknologi og nye løsninger, og er langt fremme på tverrfaglig og eksternt samarbeid. Fakultet for teknologi, kunst og design er i sterk vekst og vi rekrutterer høyt kvalifiserte medarbeidere fra hele verden.
Fakultet TKD har om lag 4 000 studenter og 400 ansatte, og holder til i Pilestredet i Oslo sentrum og på Kjeller utenfor Lillestrøm. Fakultetet utfører forskning og tilbyr utdanning på bachelor-, master- og doktorgradsnivå innen teknologi, kunst og design.

ap:254058.body:
Can a battery cathode be made from phosphorus recovered from municipal wastewater? Join us at Chalmers University of Technology to investigate how recovered phosphorus can be converted into battery-grade lithium iron phosphate (LFP), working hands-on along the entire chain from waste-derived powder to tested battery cells.
About us
You will join Daniel Weber’s research group at the Department of Chemistry and Chemical Engineering , with co-supervision from Martina Petranikova’s hydrometallurgy group within the same department. You will work alongside doctoral students and postdocs with experience from previous research projects, providing a collaborative environment for developing your experimental skills.
Our research facilities include furnaces with various atmospheres, stirred tank reactors and a spray dryer for precursor synthesis, an Ar glovebox, PXRD (housed at Chalmers Materials Analysis Laboratory ), TGA-DSC, Raman and IR spectroscopy, ICP and XRF, a laser diffraction particle size analyzer, and a battery assembly line with cell testing equipment.
Large-format pouch cells of the most promising materials will be built and tested in collaboration with a partner university in Germany. Through the project's industrial advisory board and potential research stay, you will have opportunities to engage directly with industrial partners and gain insight into how your research results can be applied in practice.
About the research project
The PHOS4CELL project investigates whether phosphorus recovered from municipal wastewater can be converted into battery-grade lithium iron phosphate (LFP). You will study how impurities in recovered phosphorus affect battery capacity and cycle life, which contaminants can be tolerated and which must be removed. By synthesizing, characterizing and testing LFP from different phosphorus sources, you will explore how recycled materials can contribute to a more sustainable battery value chain.
The four-year project is funded by the Swedish Energy Agency within the program Sustainable battery value chain (Hållbar batterivärdekedja). It brings together researchers from Chalmers, Polestar and industrial partners across the LFP value chain. The project may also include a research stay at a European LFP cathode producer.
Who we are looking for
The following requirements are mandatory:
To qualify as a Doctoral student, you must have a Master's degree ( masterexamen ) of 120 credits or a Master's degree ( magisterexamen ) of 60 credits* in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Metallurgy or a closely related field.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
Documented hands-on experience from a materials chemistry laboratory, including inorganic powder synthesis, and/or hydrometallurgical processing of materials.
Ability to independently plan and conduct laboratory experiments, identify and resolve experimental problems, and maintain accurate and systematic documentation of results.
Good communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to work with researchers and engineers from different disciplines and industrial partners.
A curious and analytical approach to experimental research, with a willingness to investigate and understand unexpected results.

The following experience will strengthen your application:
Solid-state or wet-chemical synthesis of inorganic functional materials, particularly phosphates, iron compounds or battery cathode materials.
Experience with reduction of Fe(III) under hydrogen or carbothermal conditions.
Powder X-ray diffraction and Rietveld refinement (e.g. TOPAS, GSAS-II or FullProf), including quantitative phase analysis.
Experience controlling particle size and morphology through precipitation, milling, spray drying or similar methods.
Proficiency in Swedish, as the project involves regular interaction with Swedish industrial partners.
Experience working with or for industry, or in research projects involving industrial partners.
Familiarity with Matlab, Python or similar programming languages for data analysis and visualization, and with statistical or data-driven experimental design.

What you will do
Synthesize LFP cathode materials from waste-derived phosphorus and commercial reference reagents, incl. calcination, milling, reduction under hydrogen or carbothermal conditions, and carbon coating.
Purify and characterize secondary phosphorus feedstocks and intermediates using hydrometallurgical methods, in collaboration with the Petranikova group, and quantify impurities using techniques such as XRF, ICP, TOC and CHNS analysis.
Characterize material structure, composition and morphology using powder X-ray diffraction with Rietveld refinement, particle size analysis, electron microscopy and thermal analysis.
Investigate particle engineering through precipitation and spray drying to achieve particle sizes and tap densities relevant to industrial applications.
Assemble and test half and full coin cells, and relate their electrochemical performance to material composition, impurity profiles and particle properties.
Take courses at an advanced level within the relevant graduate school at Chalmers. Read more about our graduate schools .
Develop your own scientific concepts and communicate the results of your research verbally and in writing.
The position generally also includes teaching at Chalmers' undergraduate level or performing other duties corresponding to 20 percent of working hours.
Collaborate with industrial partners through advisory board meetings, sample exchanges and discussions of technical specifications, with the possibility of an industrial research stay.
Publish research results in peer-reviewed journals, present findings at national and international conferences, and contribute to the supervision of bachelor's and master's students.

Contract terms
The Doctoral student positions are fully funded from start.
The position is a fixed-term appointment of four years, with the possibility to teach up to 20%, which extends the position up to five years.
A starting salary of 35,725 SEK per month (valid from May 1, 2026).
Doctoral studies require physical presence throughout the entire study period. A valid residence permit must be presented by the study start date; otherwise the admission may be withdrawn.

What we offer
As a Doctoral student at Chalmers, you are an employee and enjoy all employee benefits. Read more about working at Chalmers and our benefits for employees.
A dynamic and inspiring working environment in the coastal city of Gothenburg .
Read more about Sweden's generous parental leave, subsidized day care, free schools, healthcare etc. at Move To Gothenburg .

Chalmers is dedicated to improving gender balance and actively works with equality projects, such as the GENIE Initiative for gender equality and excellence .
If Swedish is not your native language, Chalmers offers Swedish courses to help you settle in.
Find more general information about doctoral studies at Chalmers here .
Application procedure
The application should be written in English and attached as PDF files, as below. Maximum size for each file is 40 MB. Please note that the system does not support Zip files.
CV
Include your academic and professional background, any publications and a brief list of laboratory instruments and techniques you have personally used.
Personal letter
A personal letter of 1–2 pages including:
A brief introduction about yourself and your academic background.
A brief motivation as to why you are interested in this position.
A summary of your relevant research experience and main results.
A clearly marked section of no more than half a page describing a previous project in which you synthesized or processed an inorganic material and characterized it using X-ray diffraction. Describe the material, the synthesis route, what the diffraction pattern showed, one aspect that did not go as planned and how you addressed it.

Master's thesis together with the transcripts.
Use the button at the foot of the page to reach the application form.
A background check may be conducted as part of the application process.
Please note: The applicant is responsible for ensuring that the application is complete. Contact details to references will be requested after the interview.
Applications sent by email or incomplete applications will be disqualified.
We welcome your application no later than the 8th of November 2026.
For questions, please contact:
Daniel Weber
Department of Chemistry and Chemical Engineering
[email protected]
*** Chalmers declines to consider all offers of further announcement publishing or other types of support for the recruiting process in connection with this position.  ***
Chalmers University of Technology in Gothenburg conducts research and education in technology and natural sciences at a high international level. The university has 3100 employees and 10,000 students, and offers education in engineering, science, shipping and architecture. With scientific excellence as a basis, Chalmers promotes knowledge and technical solutions for a sustainable world. Through global commitment and entrepreneurship, we foster an innovative spirit, in close collaboration with wider society.
Chalmers was founded in 1829 and has the same motto today as it did then: Avancez – forward.

ap:254059.body:
Do you want to contribute to impactful research in the data-driven Food and Health field?   Join our team as a Doctoral student at the Division of Food and Nutrition Science, Department of Life Sciences.
About us
The Department of Life Sciences conducts research, innovation, and education to enable a biobased society and improve human health. We explore how biological systems, and innovative technologies can be used to convert biomass into valuable products. We use advanced computational technologies to discover how biomolecules and organisms function and interact. We pioneer new methods for prediction, prevention, diagnostics and treatment of diseases.
The Division of Food and Nutrition Science addresses major societal challenges related to sustainable food production, nutrition and health. We conduct research, innovation, education and dissemination with the aim to provide new knowledge and solutions for a sustainable planet and healthy humans.
About the research project
This doctoral position is an opportunity to work at the intersection of nutrition, multi-omics, and precision health in a strong technical and natural sciences environment well connected with clinial enviromnets in Gothenburg and internationlly. You will join a dynamic, international academic community that values scientific excellence, innovation, and sustainable development. The role is designed for a curious, skilled and motivated person who wants to build a research career and contribute to better understanding how nutrition shapes human health at a molecular level.
Who we are looking for
The following requirements are mandatory:
To qualify as a Doctoral student, you must have a Master's degree ( masterexamen ) of 120 credits or a Master’s degree ( magisterexamen ) of 60 credits* in chemometry, bioinformatics, food and nutrition science, biotechnology, engineering or similar
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
Experience in computational metabolomics and microbiome research

* for students with an education earned outside of Sweden, a 4-year Bachelor’s degree is accepted.
The following experience will strengthen your application:
Experience in large scale OMICs-data handling and statistical analysis
Documented programming skills and excellent R user.
Previous experience from scientific data generation, analysis and publishing
Hands on skills in metabolomics and multi-modal data integration

What you will do
Take courses at an advanced level within the Graduate school of Bioscience  ( Bioscience | Chalmers  )
Develop your own scientific concepts and communicate the results of your research verbally and in writing
The position generally also includes teaching on Chalmers' undergraduate level or performing other duties corresponding to 20 percent of working hours
Data management and programming support to other graduate students in the environment.

Contract terms
The Doctoral student positions are fully funded from start.
The position is a fixed-term appointment of four years, with the possibility to teach up to 20%, which extends the position up to five years.
A starting salary of 35,725 SEK per month (valid from May 1, 2026).
Doctoral studies require physical presence throughout the entire study period. A valid residence permit must be presented by the study start date; otherwise the admission may be withdrawn.

What we offer
As a Doctoral student at Chalmers, you are an employee and enjoy all employee benefits. Read more about   working at Chalmers  and our  benefits  for employees.
A dynamic and inspiring working environment in the coastal city of Gothenburg .
Read more about Sweden’s generous parental leave, subsidized day care, free schools, healthcare etc at Move To Gothenburg.

Chalmers is dedicated to improving gender balance and actively works with equality projects, such as the GENIE Initiative for gender equality and excellence . We celebrate diversity and consider equality and inclusion as fundamental aspects of all our activities.
If Swedish is not your native language, Chalmers offers Swedish courses to help you settle in.
Find more general information about doctoral studies at Chalmers here .
Application procedure
The application should be written in English and attached as PDF-files, as below. Maximum size for each file is 40 MB. Please note that the system does not support Zip files.
CV
Personal letter
A brief introduction about yourself.
A brief motivation as to why you are interested in this position.

Bachelor’s and, if available, master’s thesis together with the transcripts.
Use the button at the foot of the page to reach the application form.
A background check may be conducted as part of the application process.
Please note: The applicant is responsible for ensuring that the application is complete. Incomplete applications and applications sent by email will not be considered. Contact details to references will be requested after the interview.
We welcome your application no later than  11 November, 2026.
For questions, please contact:
Rikard Landberg
Professor, Head of Division of Food and Nutrition Science
[email protected]
We look forward to your application!
*** Chalmers declines to consider all offers of further announcement publishing or other types of support for the recruiting process in connection with this position.  ***
Chalmers University of Technology in Gothenburg conducts research and education in technology and natural sciences at a high international level. The university has 3100 employees and 10,000 students, and offers education in engineering, science, shipping and architecture. With scientific excellence as a basis, Chalmers promotes knowledge and technical solutions for a sustainable world. Through global commitment and entrepreneurship, we foster an innovative spirit, in close collaboration with wider society.
Chalmers was founded in 1829 and has the same motto today as it did then: Avancez – forward.
Chalmers University of Technology conducts research and education in engineering sciences, architecture, mathematical sciences, natural and nautical sciences, working in close collaboration with industry and society. The strategy for scientific excellence focuses on our eight Areas of Advance; Built Environment, Energy, Information & Communication Technology, Life Science, Materials Science, Nanoscience & Nanotechnology, Production and Transport. The aim is to make an active contribution to a sustainable future using the basic sciences as a foundation and innovation and entrepreneurship as the central driving forces. Chalmers has around 11,000 students and 3,000 employees. New knowledge and improved technology have characterised Chalmers since its foundation in 1829, completely in accordance with the will of William Chalmers and his motto: Avancez!

ABOUT GHENT UNIVERSITY
Ghent University is a world of its own. Employing more than 9,000 people, it is actively involved in education and research, management and administration, and technical and social services on a daily basis. It is one of the largest, most exciting employers in the area and offers great career opportunities. With each of its 11 faculties and more than 100 departments offering state-of-the-art study programmes that are grounded in research in a wide range of academic fields, Ghent University is a logical choice for its employees as well as its students.
YOUR TASKS
The Department of Economics at Ghent University has one vacant position for Teaching and Research Assistants (AAP) . For this position, a good knowledge of Dutch is recommended. Preferably, the candidate is available to start immediately. Your tasks will include, among others:
You will devote at least 50% of your appointment to scientific research in the context of preparing a doctoral dissertation within one of the department’s research domains: Banking & Finance, Environmental Economics, International Economics, Labour Economics and Welfare, or Macroeconomics, Policy and Econometrics.
You will support the department’s teaching activities in general economics courses.
You will supervise students in the preparation of their bachelor’s and/or master’s theses across the various programmes in which the department provides teaching.
You will contribute to the department’s internal and external service activities.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
You hold a Master of Science degree in Economics, Business Economics, Business Engineering, Business Administration, General Economics (Complementary Studies in Economics), or an equivalent degree. You demonstrably rank within the top 20% of your graduating cohort.
An additional advanced / research master’s degree (MaNaMa) in Economics is considered an asset.
Candidates who do not have a master's degree that was awarded in a country of the European Economic Area (EEA), Switzerland or the UK must also submit GRE test scores or GMAT scores (percentile ranking).
For diplomas awarded outside the European Union, a certificate of equivalence (NARIC) must be submitted. The degree requirements need to be fulfilled at the start of your appointment.
You have a strong interest in scientific research with a view to obtaining a PhD.
Teaching experience or participation in extra training, conferences, etc. is recommended.
You have excellent didactic and communication skills.

WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU
We offer an appointment of two years. Subject to a positive evaluation of the preceding period, this appointment may be renewed twice for periods of two years each. Please note that if you have previously been appointed as an assistant or doctoral fellowship holder at a university within the Flemish Community, this period will be deducted from the maximum appointment duration, which, in accordance with the Higher Education Codex, is limited to a maximum of six years.
The earliest possible starting date is 1 January 2027.
Your remuneration will be determined according to salary scale AAP3. More information about our salary scales .
All Ghent University staff members enjoy a number of benefits, such as a wide range of training and education opportunities, 36 days of paid leave, bicycle commuting reimbursement, ecocheques, etc. A complete overview of all our fringe benefits .

INTERESTED?
Apply online through the e-recruitment system before the application deadline (see above). We do not accept late applications or applications that are not sent through the online system.
Your application must include the following documents:
In the field ‘Cv’ : (i) the completed form summarizing key information about you as a candidate ( Link ), (ii) your cv and an overview of the study results for the courses that you followed and for your master’s thesis (merged into one pdf file).
In the field ‘Cover letter’ : your application letter in pdf format.
In the field ‘Diploma’ : a transcript of the required degree (if already in your possession)
If you have a foreign diploma in a language other than our national languages (Dutch, French or German) or English, please add a translation in one of the mentioned languages.
In the field ‘Certificate of equivalence’ : only for diplomas awarded outside the European Union a certificate of equivalence (NARIC) must be submitted (if already in your possession, if not, you need to be able to provide proof that you have applied for a certificate of equivalence at the start of your appointment). The certificate can be requested via www.naricvlaanderen.be/en . For diplomas awarded in the UK before January 31st of 2020, a certificate of equivalence is not required.

Note that the maximum file size for each field is 10 MB.
As Ghent University maintains an equal opportunities and diversity policy, everyone is encouraged to apply for this position.
MORE INFORMATION
For more information about this vacancy, please contact prof. dr. Koen Inghelbrecht ( [email protected] ).
Do you have a question regarding the online application process? Please read the  FAQ or contact us via [email protected] .

Institute of Biomedicine is looking for a University Teacher for a fixed term position which focuses on the following teaching areas: bioimaging informatics, artificial intelligence and machine learning based (image) data analysis. The position will be filled from 1 January 2027 onwards (or as agreed) for three years.
Job description
The position of a university teacher includes a wide range of teaching duties within the degree programmes in biomedical sciences, medicine and dentistry. Teaching duties and course responsibilities are primarily within undergraduate education, including our international Master’s programmes (the Master’s programme in Bioimaging and the Master’s programme in Drug Discovery and Development). Teaching duties include, amongst other things, the planning and conducting of lectures, examinations, practical assignments and online teaching. Teaching may be conducted in both Finnish and English. The role also includes supervising theses, tasks related to the organisation, planning and development of teaching, high-level research work, and university administrative duties. The successful candidate will be expected to participate actively in research in the field and to apply for research funding.  Read more about studying at the Faculty of Medicine .
Who we are looking for
According to the qualification requirements, a person selected for the post of a university teacher is must have
an applicable higher university degree
good teaching skills

When assessing the merits of the applicants, the following will be taken into account
the teaching and research expertise within the relevant field
teacher training
the ability to produce study materials and multifaceted teaching
recent publications in the field as well as other academic merits

To succeed in this role, you will need
experience of modern machine learning methods
an understanding of deep neural networks
programming skills, particularly in the Python programming language and relevant development environments
experience of biomedical imaging
an enthusiastic and innovative approach to teaching
the ability to supervise international students
excellent spoken and written English
strong teamwork skills in a multidisciplinary and multicultural environment
good organisational skills and the ability to work under pressure (time management, managing multiple tasks simultaneously)
the ability to deliver multifaceted teaching and develop digital learning environments

The eligibility criteria for the position must be met by the end of the application period.
The following may be considered as an advantage
a doctoral degree in a relevant field
previous experience of publishing, teaching and supervising in the field
a proven track record of securing research funding
international research experience
experience of high-performance computing or parallel computing environments
proficiency in Finnish
a vision for the direction of research in this role
familiarity with the degree programmes offered by the University of Turku and the Faculty of Medicine
practical experience of teaching/teaching responsibilities and research in the field of biomedicine
compatibility of the candidate’s own research topics with the research priorities of the Institute of Biomedicine

We value collegiality and promote equality, diversity, and inclusivity. We encourage all qualified applicants with different backgrounds to apply for our open positions.
Benefits
We offer you responsible and interesting tasks and the opportunity to develop your professional skills in a versatile operating environment. Please read more about University of Turku as an employer from our  Come work with us!  pages.
The European Commission has awarded the University of Turku the right to use the  HR Excellence in Research quality label . The label is a token of the University's commitment to continuous development of the position and working conditions of researchers according to the guidelines set forth in the European Charter for Researchers.
The University of Turku has several high-quality research infrastructures required for cutting-edge research. Learn more about the roadmap of research infrastructures and how the research infrastructure and expert teams offer tailored solutions for businesses and organizations .
The University of Turku is among the top of the world’s universities in most rankings and among the best universities in the world in certain fields. Our high-quality basic research, a multidisciplinary research profile and close cooperation in research infrastructures creates the basis for international top research. Read more about University of Turku in international university rankings.
The university offers good support and orientation for international hires. Please learn more about the Finnish culture and relocation to Finland:
City of Turku
Welcome visitor
International House of Turku
Working culture:  infoFinland.fi
This is Finland
Careers in Southwest Finland
Finland - a superpower of education and innovations | University of Turku (utu.fi)

Salary and trial period
The salary is determined in accordance with the university salary system for teaching and research personnel (levels 4-6). In addition, a personal performance-based salary component is paid. At the beginning of the employment, the gross monthly salary is typically approximately EUR 3197-4671, depending on previous experience and expertise. The amount of the salary is defined when the employment contract is prepared. A six (6) month trial period applies to the position.
How to apply
Please submit your application through our online recruitment system by 4 November 2026 4 pm.
Applications should include:
CV ( use this template )
list of publications
motivation letter
teaching portfolio in accordance with the University guidelines
copy of a degree certificate
contact information of two referees
other relevant documents

Additional information
For further information about the position, please contact Associate Professor Pekka Ruusuvuori, [email protected]
In case you need help with the application process, please turn to HR Specialist Kristiina Nuutila, [email protected] , +358 50 313 5224

Institute of Biomedicine

Research at the Institute of Biomedicine is divided into three functional units: Infection and Immunity, Integrative Physiology and Pharmacology, and Cancer research. Research at our Institute includes both biomedical basic research and translational research, and the unit division expresses our research priorities.
The Faculty of Medicine is a high level, international and innovative research and education unit in biomedicine, clinical medicine, dentistry and health and nursing sciences, as well as a major social contributor to health promotion, disease genesis, in the research of diagnostics and treatment and in the development of the health service and education system. The faculty provides research-based multidisciplinary undergraduate education in educational programs that educate diverse and critically minded specialists. The research is multidisciplinary and results in new information aimed at promoting the health of the population and better patient care.
The University of Turku is an inspiring and international academic community of 25,000 students and staff in Southwest Finland. We build a sustainable future with multidisciplinary research, education, and collaboration. With us, your work will have a significant impact and relevance in the changing world.
See our open vacancies

Information for the applicant
The application form cannot be saved as a draft. However, after submitting you can return to edit your application via the link you receive by email. The application can be edited until the application deadline.
You have 6 hours to complete your application before the timeout.

Turun yliopiston biolääketieteen laitoksella on haettavana yliopisto-opettajan määräaikainen tehtävä, johon sisältyy seuraavat opetukseen liittyvät painoalueet: biokuvantamisen informatiikka, tekoälyyn ja koneoppimiseen perustuva (kuva)datan analyysi . Tehtävä täytetään kolmeksi vuodeksi. Valitun hakijan toivotaan aloittavan tehtävässä 1.1.2027 tai sopimuksen mukaan.
Tehtävänkuvaus
Yliopisto-opettajan tehtävä sisältää monipuolisia opetustehtäviä biolääketieteen, lääketieteen ja hammaslääketieteen tutkinto-ohjelmissa. Opetustehtävät ja opintojaksovastuut sijoittuvat erityisesti perustutkintokoulutukseen mukaan lukien kansainväliset maisteriohjelmamme Master’s programme in Bioimaging ja Master’s programme in Drug Discovery and Development. Opetustehtäviin kuuluu mm. luentojen, tenttien, harjoitustöiden ja verkko-opetuksen suunnittelu ja toteutus. Opetustyö voi olla sekä suomen että englanninkielistä. Tehtävään sisältyy myös opinnäytetöiden ohjausta, opetuksen organisointiin, suunnitteluun ja kehittämiseen liittyviä tehtäviä, korkeatasoinen tutkimustyö sekä yliopistohallinnollisia tehtäviä. Valittavan henkilön edellytetään osallistuvan aktiivisesti alan tutkimukseen ja hakevan omaa tutkimusrahoitusta.  Lue lisää opiskelusta lääketieteellisessä tiedekunnassa .
Etsimämme henkilö

tehtävään soveltuvaa ylempää korkeakoulututkintoa
hyvää opetustaitoa

tehtäväalueen opetuksellisen ja tutkimuksellisen osaamisen
pedagogisen koulutuksen
taidon tuottaa oppimateriaalia ja antaa opetusta monipuolisesti
viimeaikaisen julkaisutoiminnan alalla sekä muut akateemiset meriitit

Tehtävän menestyksekäs hoitaminen edellyttää
kokemusta moderneista koneoppimismenetelmistä
syvien neuroverkkojen ymmärrystä
ohjelmointiosaamista erityisesti Python-ohjelmointikielen osalta ja relevanteista kehitysympäristöistä
kokemusta biolääketieteellisestä kuvantamisesta
innostunutta ja kehittävää työskentelyotetta opetukseen
valmiutta kansainvälisten opiskelijoiden ohjaamiseen
erinomaista suullista ja kirjallista englannin kielen taitoa
vahvoja tiimityöskentelytaitojamonitieteellisessä ja -kulttuurisessa ympäristössä
hyviä organisointitaitoja ja paineensietokykyä (ajanhallintaa, useiden tehtävien samanaikainen hallintaa)
valmiutta monimuoto-opetukseen ja digitaalisten oppimisympäristöjen kehittämiseen

Tehtävän kelpoisuusvaatimusten tulee täyttyä tehtävän hakuajan päättymiseen mennessä.
Hakijan eduksi voidaan katsoa
tohtorintutkinto soveltuvalta alalta
aikaisempi julkaisu-, opetus- ja ohjauskokemus alalta
aikaisemmat näytöt tutkimusrahoituksen hankkimisesta
kansainvälinen tutkimuskokemus
kokemus suurteholaskenta- tai rinnakkaislaskentaympäristöistä
suomen kielen taito
näkemys tutkimuksen suuntaamisesta tehtävässä
yliopiston ja lääketieteellisen tiedekunnan koulutusohjelmien tuntemus
käytännön kokemus biolääketieteen alan opetuksesta/opetusvastuista ja tutkimuksesta
omien tutkimusaiheiden yhteensopivuus biolääketieteen laitoksen tutkimuksen painopisteisiin

Arvostamme yhteisöllisyyttä ja edistämme tasa-arvoa, monimuotoisuutta ja inklusiivisuutta. Kannustammekin erilaisen taustan omaavia päteviä hakijoita hakemaan avoimia tehtäviämme.
Tarjoamme
Tarjoamme sinulle vastuullisia ja mielenkiintoisia työtehtäviä sekä mahdollisuuden kehittää ammattiosaamistasi monipuolisessa toimintaympäristössä. Lue lisää meistä Tervetuloa meille töihin -sivulta, jossa lisää siitä mitä yliopisto tarjoaa työntekijälleen.
Euroopan komissio on myöntänyt Turun yliopistolle oikeuden käyttää erinomaisen työnantajan  HR Excellence in Research logoa  merkkinä yliopiston sitoutumisesta tutkijoiden aseman ja työolosuhteiden jatkuvaan kehittämiseen Tutkijoiden eurooppalaisen peruskirjan tavoitteiden mukaisesti.
Turun yliopisto sijoittuu kansainvälisissä yliopistorankingeissa erittäin hyvin ja on useilla aloilla maailman yliopistojen parhaimmiston joukossa. Korkealaatuinen perustutkimus, monitieteinen tutkimusprofiili sekä tiivis yhteistyö tutkimusinfrastruktuureiden osalta luovat pohjan kansainväliselle huippututkimukselle. Lue lisää sijoittumisestamme kansainvälisissä yliopistorankingeissa.
Turun yliopistossa on useita korkeatasoisia huippututkimuksen edellyttämiä tutkimusinfrastruktuureja. Katso lista Turun yliopiston tutkimusinfrastruktuureista ja lue lisää yritysyhteistyötä tukevista palvelututkimuksesta ja infrastruktuureista .
Palkkaus ja koeaika
Tehtävästä maksettava palkka määräytyy yliopistojen opetus- ja tutkimushenkilöstön palkkausjärjestelmän mukaisesti. Tehtävän vaativuustaso on 4–6. Lisäksi maksetaan henkilökohtaiseen suoriutumiseen perustuvaa palkanosaa. Palkkaus on aiemmasta kokemuksesta ja osaamisesta riippuen tehtävän alussa noin 3197-4671 euroa/kk. Tehtävässä noudatetaan kuuden kuukauden koeaikaa.
Hakuohjeet
Jätäthän hakemuksesi sähköisen rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta 4.11.2026, klo 16.00 mennessä.
Hakijoiden tulee liittää hakemukseensa
ansioluettelo (ks. ohjeet )

opetusportfolio (ks. ohjeet )
tutkintotodistuksen kopio
kahden suosittelijan yhteystiedot
muut mahdolliset tehtävän täyttämiseen vaikuttavat asiakirjat

Lisätietoja
Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa apulaisprofessori Pekka Ruusuvuori, pekka.ruusuvuori(at)utu.fi.
Hakuprosessia koskevissa kysymyksissä voit ottaa yhteyttä HR-asiantuntija Kristiina Nuutilaan, kristiina.nuutila(at)utu.fi.

Biolääketieteen laitos

Biolääketieteen laitoksessa on kolme tutkimuksen yksikköä: infektiot ja immuniteetti, integratiivinen fysiologia ja farmakologia, sekä syöpätutkimus. Laitoksellamme tutkimus käsittää sekä biolääketieteellistä perustutkimusta että translationaalista tutkimusta, ja yksikköjako heijastaa tutkimuksemme painopistealueita.
Lääketieteellinen tiedekunta on korkeatasoinen, kansainvälinen ja innovatiivinen biolääketieteen, kliinisen lääketieteen, hammaslääketieteen sekä terveys- ja hoitotieteiden tutkimus- ja koulutusorganisaatio sekä merkittävä yhteiskunnallinen vaikuttaja terveyden edistämisen, sairauksien synnyn, diagnostiikan ja hoidon tutkimuksessa sekä terveysalan palvelu- ja koulutusjärjestelmän kehittämisessä. Tiedekunnassa annetaan tutkimukseen perustuvaa monialaista peruskoulutusta koulutusohjelmissa, joissa koulutetaan monipuolisesti ja kriittisesti ajattelevia asiantuntijoita. Tutkimus on monialaista ja sen tuloksena syntyy uutta tietoa, jonka päämääränä on väestön terveyden edistäminen ja potilaiden parempi hoito.
Turun yliopisto on 25 000 opiskelijan ja työntekijän innostava ja kansainvälinen akateeminen yhteisö. Rakennamme kestävää tulevaisuutta monitieteisellä tutkimuksella, koulutuksella ja yhteistyöllä. Tarjoamme mielenkiintoisia urapolkuja, kannustamme jatkuvaan oppimiseen ja panostamme yhteisömme hyvinvointiin. Tule meille tekemään työtä, jolla on merkitystä muuttuvassa maailmassa!

ap:254077.body:
About us
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Science, Technology and Medicine (FSTM) at the University of Luxembourg contributes multidisciplinary expertise in the fields of Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences and Medicine.
Through its dual mission of teaching and research, the FSTM seeks to generate and disseminate knowledge and train new generations of responsible citizens in order to better understand, explain and advance society and the environment we live in.
The Sustainable Concrete Structure Laboratory is looking for 3 new Ph.D. candidates based on the ERC project RESCUE. In this fully-funded position, the Ph.D. candidates will work on using developing new modelling frameworks for predicting the remaining life of reused concrete elements. This project calls for an open character with a strong knowledge on concrete structures as well as curiosity across discipline boundaries (civil engineering, material science, and computer science).
Your role
As the successful candidate, you will contribute to a research project at the intersection of engineering (concrete structures), material science (durability, mechanical behavior), data science (probabilistic modelling, ML, multi-scale, …), and life-cycle analyses.
The aim of these Ph.D. projects is to develop the first predictive modelling for reused concrete-element capacity. The tasks comprise the development of a laboratory campaign of full-scale reused concrete elements, the development of non-destructive testing methods, the development of new data-driven physics-informed models, and the evaluations of life-cycle gains.
This groundbreaking research output will lead to the extension of the service life of concrete infrastructures, leading to a significant reduction of carbon emissions and costs of the construction sector.

PhD topics:
First PhD topic: Mechanical behavior of reused concrete
Second PhD topic: Durability properties of reused concrete
Third PhD topic: Data-driven modelling of reused concrete

We thus warmly encourage you to apply even if you feel that you only partially meet the criteria in terms of background and expertise, as you will have the opportunity to acquire the missing knowledge during the first year of the project.

Master's degree (or equivalent) in civil engineering or related area
Good understanding of the structural behavior and material properties of concrete structures and modelling of civil structures. Knowledge of concrete reuse is a plus
Curiosity, a genuine passion for scientific research

A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
