ap:254281.body:
Haemme Jyväskylän yliopiston fysiikan laitokselle  tutkijatohtoria kiihdytinpohjaiseen neutronifysiikka- ja BNCT-tutkimukseen 4.1.2027 alkaen tai sopimuksen mukaan, kahden vuoden määräajaksi. Etsimme motivoitunutta tutkijaa työskentelemään projektissa, jossa toteutetaan uuden 3 MV tandem-kiihdyttimen yhteyteen protonipohjainen neutronilähde. Katso tarkempi tehtävänkuvaus ja vaatimukset englanninkielisestä hakuilmoituksesta.
Tutkijatohtorin kelpoisuusvaatimuksista ja kielitaidosta määrätään  yliopiston johtosäännössä ja kielitaito-ohjeistuksissa . Tutkijatohtoreilla tulee olla tohtorin tutkinto suoritettuna ennen tehtävässä aloittamista. Tehtävissä edellytetään hyvää englannin kielen taitoa ja eduksi katsotaan kyky antaa opetusta englannin kielellä. Tehtävää täytettäessä käytetään kuuden kuukauden koeaikaa.
Tarjoamme
Tule osaksi innostavaa ja lämminhenkistä yhteisöämme!
Jyväskylän yliopistossa olet arvostettu yliopistoyhteisön jäsen. Teemme merkityksellistä työtä ja vaalimme sivistystä. Monitieteisessä yliopistossamme saat mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa kansainväliseen tutkimukseen ja laadukkaaseen akateemiseen koulutukseen. Meille jokaisen hyvinvointi on tärkeää, ja tarjoamme kampuksella sekä sen läheisyydessä erinomaiset puitteet aktiiviseen ja hyvinvoivaan elämäntapaan.
Palkkaus perustuu tehtävien vaativuuteen ja henkilökohtaiseen työstä suoriutumiseen yliopistojen palkkausjärjestelmän mukaisesti. Tutkijatohtorin tehtäväkohtainen palkanosa määräytyy opetus- ja tutkimushenkilöstön tehtävien vaativuustason 5 mukaan. Palkkasi on noin 3700–4300 euroa kuukaudessa riippuen aiemmasta osaamisestasi ja kokemuksestasi.
Tarjoamme hyvät työolosuhteet tutkijoille ja noudatamme Tutkijanuran ja -aseman kehittämisen ( HRS4R ) periaatteita. Human Resources Strategy for Researchers (HRS4R) -työ perustuu Euroopan komission julkaisemaan Tutkijoiden eurooppalaisen peruskirjan arvoihin ja säännöstöön tutkijoiden työhönotosta (englanninkielinen lyhenne Charter & Code). Jyväskylän yliopisto on sitoutunut tasapuolisuuteen, johdonmukaisuuteen ja läpinäkyvyyteen valintapäätöksissä ja noudattaa vastuullisen tutkijanarvioinnin kansallisia suosituksia . Jyväskylän yliopisto on sitoutunut vastuullisen tutkijanarvioinnin DORA-julistukseen ja noudattamaan CoARA -periaatteita.
Hakeminen
Haussa edellytetään, että ORCID‑profiilisi ( https://orcid.org ) on ajan tasalla ja julkaisusi näkyvät julkisina (Set visibility: Everyone).
Hakemuksiin tulee liittää pdf-muodossa:
Ansioluettelo (CV), jossa on  listattu haettuun tehtävään liittyvät taidot ja pätevyydet, ja joka laaditaan hyvää tieteellistä käytäntöä noudattaen sekä ottaen huomioon mahdollisuuksien mukaan ansioluettelomalli (ks.  TENK:n ohje ).
Lyhyt vapaamuotoinen hakemuskirje (enintään 2 sivua) sisältäen tutkimusintressisi.
Numeroitu julkaisuluettelo Suomen Akatemian mallin mukaan  kaikista niistä tieteellisistä ja muista julkaisuista, joilla hakija haluaa osoittaa kelpoisuutensa ja ansionsa tehtävään.
Tutkintotodistus (korkein tutkinto).
Kahden suosittelijan yhteystiedot (asema, sähköposti, puhelin). Henkilöt voivat olla esimerkiksi entisiä ohjaajia tai yhteistyökumppaneita.

Odotamme hakemustasi rekrytointijärjestelmäämme viimeistään 20.11.2026.
Lisätietoja antaa professori Timo Sajavaara, [email protected]  tai yliopistonlehtori Mikko Laitinen, [email protected] .
Hakemusprosessimme on läpinäkyvä, ammattimainen ja kansainvälinen. Tiedotamme hakijoita avoimesti prosessin edistymisestä sen eri vaiheissa. Arvostamme tasa-arvoa ja monimuotoisuutta työyhteisössämme ja kannustamme kelpoisuuden täyttäviä hakijoita hakemaan tehtäviä.

Fysiikan laitos

Hyvää tiedettä, hyvää elämää! Fysiikan laitos on kansainvälisesti tunnustettu ja dynaaminen tutkimusyhteisö, jossa korkeatasoisen tutkimuksen kärjessä ovat materiaalifysiikka, ydinfysiikka ja hiukkasfysiikka. Ydinfysiikan tutkimusalueita ovat ydinastrofysiikka, ydinrakenteen fysiikka, ja kiihdyttimillä tapahtuva soveltava tutkimus. Hiukkasfysiikassa tutkitaan erityisesti vahvaa vuorovaikutusta, ultrarelativistisia raskasionitörmäyksiä, neutriinofysiikkaa ja hiukkaskosmologiaa. Materiaalifysiikan tutkimusalueita ovat nanomateriaalit ja ohutfilmit, kvanttimateriaalit ja kvanttiteknologiat, valon ja aineen vuorovaikutus, ja nanohiukkasten ominaisuudet. Kokeellista tutkimusta tukevat kiihdytinlaboratorio ja nanotiedekeskus, sekä laajat yhteistyöverkostot mm. CERNissä ja FAIRissa. Vuodesta 2026 alkaen laitoksella toimii kolme Suomen Akatemian huippuosaamiskeskusta: kvarkkimateriaalin huippuosaamiskeskus, kvanttimateriaalien huippuosaamiskeskus ja neutronitähtien fysiikan huippuosaamiskeskus. Fysiikan laitoksella panostetaan laadukkaaseen opetukseen ja opiskelijoiden ohjaukseen. Noin 200 asiantuntijan ja 300 opiskelijan yhteisössämme työskentelet kannustavassa, avoimessa ja aidosti yhteisöllisessä ilmapiirissä, jossa hyvä työtyytyväisyys, kollegiaalinen tuki ja yhdessä tekeminen ovat keskeinen osa arkea, jossa myös tutkimus, opetus ja yhteiskunnallinen vaikuttavuus kytkeytyvät tiiviisti yhteen.

De Faculteit Letteren maakt deel uit van de Groep Humane Wetenschappen. Ze verzorgt onderwijs aan ongeveer 4.500 studenten in verschillende opleidingen en dit op de KU Leuven campussen te Antwerpen, Brussel, Kortrijk en Leuven. Voor de opleiding geschiedenis zoeken we een halftijdse praktijkassistent die inhoudelijke en praktische ondersteuning biedt bij de didactische vernieuwing van het curriculum en het onderwijs in de opleiding. In jouw functie word je aangestuurd door de programmadirecteur van de opleiding en werk je nauw samen met docenten en praktijkassistenten van de opleiding.

Functie

Het concrete takenpakket zal na overleg met het team van praktijkassistenten en de permanente onderwijsondersteuner van de opleiding vastgelegd worden. Het takenpakket kan onder meer bestaan uit volgende opdrachten:

Opvolging van lopende onderwijsprojecten in samenwerking met de POC geschiedenis. Je neemt initiatief om samen met de programmaverantwoordelijke en de betrokken docent(en) op een wetenschappelijk onderbouwde manier didactische vernieuwingen op opleidingsniveau te introduceren (bv. rond leerlijnen, Generatieve AI, werkvormen, evaluatievormen)

Didactische voorbereiding en ondersteuning van methodologische opleidingsonderdelen zoals Onderzoeksmethoden: teksten, beelden en artefacten. Concreet help je met het organiseren van onderwijsactiviteiten en nakijken van opdrachten.

Ondersteuning van het team van praktijkassistenten tijdens piekmomenten (beoordeling van examens en/of papers).

Coördinatie en planning van onderzoeksseminaries in de master geschiedenis en bijkomende excursies.

Organisatie van feedbackmomenten voor de opleidingsonderdelen die je ondersteunt. Je staat in voor een duidelijke en correcte evaluatie van die opleidingsonderdelen en voorziet de studenten van constructieve schriftelijke en/of mondelinge feedback.

Optreden als contactpersoon voor studenten, docenten, administratie en overlegorganen (zoals de permanente onderwijscommissie)

Een laagdrempelig aanspreekpunt zijn voor de opleidingsonderdelen die je ondersteunt

Deelname aan rekruteringsactiviteiten zoals SID-ins en infodagen en het opnemen van 1 of meerdere surveillantiebeurten per examenperiode

Profiel

Je hebt een masteropleiding in de geschiedenis

Educatieve bekwaamheid (diploma educatieve master, SLO of door ervaring) is een pluspunt.

Je behaalde een gemiddeld jaarlijks resultaat van onderscheiding (of hoger) tijdens je studies.

Je bent didactisch aangelegd en kan studenten motiveren

Je bent gebeten door onderwijs en onderwijsinnovatie.

Je beschikt over uitstekende interpersoonlijke vaardigheden

Je kan zowel zelfstandig als in team werken

Je stelt je proactief, stressbestendig en flexibel op.

Je hebt organisatorische en sociale vaardigheden en interesses

Je hebt zeer goede redactionele, organisatorische, communicatieve en ICT-vaardigheden

Je hebt een uitstekende kennis van het Nederlands en een goede kennis van het Engels en Frans, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Je talenkennis stelt je in staat om de (academische) schrijfvaardigheden van studenten nauwgezet te beoordelen.

Aanbod

We bieden een contract van 50% als praktijkassistent, voor bepaalde duur (tot 30 september 2027), in barema 43. We hopen jou vanaf 1 december te kunnen verwelkomen.

Je werkt in deze functie op het niveau van de opleiding, maar wordt mee opgenomen in een breder team van onderwijsondersteuners die mee zullen instaan voor de vernieuwing van de facultaire curricula. Als faculteit hechten we veel belang aan teamvorming, samenwerking, overleg, inspraak en collegialiteit.

We hechten in onze werkomgeving ook veel belang aan ruimte voor initiatief en engagement. We bieden kansen om opleidingen te volgen, en denken graag mee na over een haalbare combinatie werk-privé op jouw en onze maat. We houden van een werkomgeving met zowel voldoende on-campus aanwezigheid als mogelijkheden om van thuis uit te kunnen telewerken, volgens onze teamafspraken.

Interesse?

Voor meer informatie kan je contact opnemen met de programmadirecteur, prof. dr. Violet Soen ( [email protected] ), prof. dr. Magaly Rodriguez Garcia ( [email protected] ) of bij Freija Bornauw ( [email protected] ).

De preselectie gebeurt op basis van de ingestuurde dossiers; de selectiegesprekken zullen plaatsvinden op 9 november in de voormiddag of 12 november in de voormiddag. De gesprekken vinden plaats op de campus (Blijde Inkomststraat 21).

KU Leuven wil een inclusieve, respectvolle en sociaal veilige gemeenschap zijn. Wij omarmen diversiteit tussen individuen en groepen als een meerwaarde. Open dialoog en verschillen in perspectief zijn noodzakelijk in een ambitieuze onderzoeks- en onderwijsomgeving. In ons streven naar gelijke kansen erkennen wij de gevolgen van historische ongelijkheden. Wij aanvaarden geen enkele vorm van discriminatie op basis van, onder meer, geslacht, genderidentiteit en -expressie, seksuele oriëntatie, leeftijd, etnische of nationale afkomst, huidskleur, levensbeschouwelijke overtuiging, neurodivergentie, arbeidshandicap, gezondheid, of socio-economische status. Bij vragen over toegankelijkheid of aangeboden ondersteuning helpen we je graag op dit e-mailadres .

ABOUT GHENT UNIVERSITY
Ghent University is a world of its own. Employing more than 15.000 people, it is actively involved in education and research, management and administration, as well as technical and social service provision on a daily basis. It is one of the largest, most exciting employers in the area and offers great career opportunities.
With its 11 faculties and more than 85 departments offering state-of-the-art study programmes grounded in research in a wide range of academic fields, Ghent University is a logical choice for its staff and students.
YOUR TASKS
Q-ForestLab (www.q-forestlab.ugent.be) is seeking a highly motivated PhD candidate to work on linking high-temporal 3D structure and microclimate time series in forest ecosystems.
Forests absorb 30% of current annual CO2 emissions through photosynthesis and growth, with tropical forests storing the majority of global live biomass in forests. Despite the important role forests play in our climate system and society, growing evidence shows that forests globally are under increasing pressure from climate change. Microclimate regulation is a key forest function because forests can buffer the impacts of climate extremes. The amount of buffering within forests (buffering capacity) is directly linked to forest structure because forest structure determines the amount of incoming solar radiation, the amount of water available at the forest floor, the rate of evapotranspiration, and the speed of below-canopy winds. Forest dynamics and disturbances are key drivers of forest structure and thus directly contribute to the buffering capacity of forests. Hence, changing disturbances regimes under climate change may substantially change the buffering capacity of future forests.
This PhD position draws on the experience and resources from multiple projects (including FWO projects in the Amazon forest in Brazil, tropical Australia and Q-ForestLab's four permanent plots in Bosland, Belgium). This project will focus on understanding how disturbances and forest dynamics shape 3D forest structure over time, and how these structural changes alter the microclimate buffering capacity of tropical and temperate forests. It will lead to a step-change in our ability to observe, quantify and understand, at high temporal resolution, the link between forest structure and microclimate. The project will use high-temporal microclimate and 3D structure data from high-end terrestrial laser scanning (TLS), including permanently installed laser scanners.
Within your work, you will:
Collect and analyse high-frequency (daily, monthly or yearly) 3D terrestrial laser scanning data of tropical rainforests in Brazil and Australia and temperate forests in Belgium to quantify their 4D structure (3D plus time). Fieldwork at these sites may be required.
Combine these data with co-located microclimate measurements (including temperature and relative humidity) to link forest structure and its dynamics to buffering capacity at plot-level.
Use radiative transfer models (RTMs) to simulate the below-canopy light regime and its role in microclimate buffering using the ForEdgeClim model.

This PhD project will be promoted by prof. Kim Calders and co-supervised by dr. Louise Terryn. You will interact regularly with Prof. Pieter De Frenne, who will act as an informal advisor.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
MSc degree (or equivalent) in a relevant field (Bioscience-Engineering, Remote Sensing, Surveying, Physics, Geosciences, Environmental Sciences, Computer Science, etc.).
Fluent in programming languages such as (at least one of) R, C++ or Python
Keen to carry out fieldwork in temperate and tropical forests, including longer fieldwork campaigns of several weeks
Prior experience with, or a solid understanding of, radiative transfer modelling is a plus, but not a requirement
Previous experience with (terrestrial) laser scanning and 3D modelling of forests is a plus, but not a requirement
A passion for nature and forests and a keen interest in forest ecology.
A good command of English, both written and oral.

WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU
We offer a full-time position as a doctoral fellow, consisting of an initial period of 12 months, which, after a positive evaluation, will be extended to a total maximum of 48 months.
Your contract will start on February 1, 2027 at the earliest.
The fellowship amount is 100% of the net salary of an AAP member in equal family circumstances. The individual fellowship amount is determined by Team Personnel Administration based on family status and seniority. A grant that meets the conditions and criteria of the regulations for doctoral fellowships is considered free of personal income tax. Click here for more information about our salary scales.
All Ghent University staff members enjoy a number of benefits, such as a wide range of training and education opportunities, 36 days of holiday leave (on an annual basis for a full-time job) supplemented by annual fixed bridge days, bicycle allowance and eco vouchers. Click here for a complete overview of all the staff benefits.
The successful candidate will be based in Ghent.
Opportunities to present your work at scientific conferences.
Collaboration in a young and dynamic international scientific team. Life-work balance is important for us.
Please mention your favourite animal in your motivation letter so we can check that you at least read this vacancy in full.
About Q-ForestLab – www.q-forestlab.ugent.be Our lab is part of Ghent University in Belgium and studies vegetation dynamics, ecology, biogeochemistry, carbon and water cycling of terrestrial ecosystems. Q-ForestLab has a strong focus on forest ecosystems, but a broad interest in all types of terrestrial ecosystems, including tropical and temperate forests, drylands, peatlands and urban ecosystems. Our strength lies in a unique combination of methodologies, ranging from empirical in-situ observations and experiments, over 3D forest reconstructions, to process-based modelling and remote sensing.

INTERESTED?
Application submission (CV and application letter) through this google form: https://forms.gle/sbzJ7hcAMpKHcYhN7
Application deadline: 30 November 2026 (midnight CEST)
Notification of selection for interview: mid December 2026

You will receive a notification after submitting your application - please check your spam folder
More information: Prof. Kim Calders | [email protected]

As Ghent University maintains an equal opportunities and diversity policy, everyone is encouraged to apply for this position.

Om stillingen
Ønsker du å bidra til utdanning av fremtidens sykepleiere?
Ved Institutt for sykepleie og helsefremmende arbeid (SHA) ved OsloMet etablerer vi en ressursbank av kontaktlærere til oppfølging av studenter i praksisstudier i bachelorutdanningen i sykepleie.
Vi søker sykepleiere med relevant klinisk erfaring og interesse for studentveiledning. Kandidater som inkluderes i ressursbanken kan bli tilbudt tidsavgrensede oppdrag ved behov gjennom studieåret. Oppdragene kan ha et omfang på inntil 60 timer per måned, med varighet på inntil 10 måneder.
Arbeidsoppgaver
oppfølging og veiledning av sykepleierstudenter fra 1., 2. og 3. studieår, i praksis og/eller utdanningens simulerings- og ferdighetsenhet
vurdering av studentenes læringsutvikling i henhold til gjeldende retningslinjer

gjennomføring av student- og praksisbesøk, fysisk eller digitalt
støtte til studenter og praksisveiledere i utfordrende veilednings- og vurderingssituasjoner
deltakelse i møter knyttet til praksisoppfølging

Kvalifikasjonskrav
norsk autorisasjon som sykepleier
minimum to års relevant klinisk erfaring som sykepleier etter oppnådd autorisasjon, fra kommune- og/eller spesialisthelsetjenesten
god muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne på norsk
gode digitale ferdigheter

Det vil være en fordel om du har
mastergrad innen helse- eller utdanningsfag
erfaring med veiledning av studenter i praksis
erfaring fra undervisning eller utdanningsvirksomhet
veiledningspedagogisk kompetanse
god kjennskap til sykepleierutdanning og praksisstudier

Personlige egenskaper
er opptatt av studenters læring og utvikling
har gode samarbeids- og kommunikasjonsevner
arbeider strukturert og selvstendig
er fleksibel og løsningsorientert
trives med å bygge relasjoner mellom utdanning og praksisfelt

Om ressursbanken
Søkere som vurderes som kvalifiserte, kan bli inkludert i instituttets ressursbank for kontaktlærere i praksisstudier. Inkludering i ressursbanken innebærer ikke garanti for oppdrag eller et bestemt arbeidsomfang, men kvalifiserte kandidater vil kunne bli kontaktet ved behov for praksisoppfølging gjennom studieåret. Oppdragene vil normalt ha et omfang på inntil 60 timer per måned og med en varighet på inntil 10 måneder.
Vi kan tilby deg
mulighet til å bidra til utdanningen av framtidens sykepleiere
tilknytning til et stort og aktivt fagmiljø ved OsloMet
faglig utvikling innen veiledning og praksisoppfølging
fleksible oppdrag tilpasset instituttets behov
lønn etter avtale og gjeldende bestemmelser

Stillingen lønnes, i henhold til Hovedtariffavtalene i staten og OsloMets lønnspolitikk. Fra lønnen trekkes 2 % pensjonsinnskudd til Statens pensjonskasse (SPK).
Søknadsprosess
Vil du søke på stillingen må du søke via vårt rekrutteringssystem.
Innen søknadsfristen må du laste opp følgende dokumenter:
søknadsbrev
CV
kopi av vitnemål og attester
dokumentasjon på eventuell veilednings- og undervisningskompetanse
navn og kontaktinformasjon til to referanser

Vi behandler kun søknader sendt via vårt elektroniske rekrutteringssystem og alle dokumenter, attester og alle sider av vitnemål må lastes opp for at din søknad skal behandles. Dokumentene må være på et skandinavisk språk eller engelsk. Oversettelser må være autorisert og du må påregne å fremvise originaler ved et eventuelt intervju. OsloMet gjennomfører kontroll av dokumenter, slik at du som kandidat skal få en reell evaluering og rettferdig konkurranse. Ufullstendige søknader vil ikke bli tatt til vurdering.
For aktuelle stillinger gjennomfører OsloMet bakgrunnssjekk av søkere i samarbeid med en ekstern leverandør, for å verifisere opplysninger som fremgår av tilgjengelige dokumenter. Bakgrunnssjekk skjer alltid med kandidatens samtykke, og ansettelse i disse stillingene forutsetter godkjent bakgrunnssjekk. Aktuelle søkere vil motta nærmere informasjon om dette.
Informasjon til deg som søker
Inkludering og mangfold styrker vår evne til å løse OsloMets samfunnsoppdrag. Derfor ønsker vi medarbeidere med ulike kompetanser, livserfaringer og perspektiver velkommen. Vi arbeider kontinuerlig for å være en inkluderende arbeidsplass, og gjennom dialog tilrettelegger vi for medarbeidere som har behov for det.
Opplysninger om deg som søker kan publiseres på den offentlige søkerlisten selv om har bedt om at søknaden behandles konfidensielt. Hvis det skjer, vil du bli varslet om det før publiseringen.
Ansettelsen blir gjennomført etter prinsippene i statsansatteloven og lovverk som regulerer eksport av kunnskap, teknologi og tjenester. Søkere som er i konflikt med dette regelverket vil ikke anses kvalifisert for stillingen.
OsloMet er Charter & Code -sertifisert av EU-kommisjonen med rett til å bruke logoen HR Excellence in Research (HRS4R) og er medlem i nettverket EURAXESS , som bidrar til gode arbeidsvilkår for mobile forskere.
OsloMet har sluttet seg til prinsippene og forpliktet institusjonen til å følge anbefalingene i DORA-erklæringen (sfdora.org) (The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment).
Besøk OsloMet på LinkedIn , Facebook , Instagram
OsloMet - storbyuniversitetet
OsloMet - storbyuniversitetet er Norges tredje største universitet med 23 000 studenter og over 2600 ansatte. Vi har campus i Oslo Sentrum og på Romerike. OsloMet leverer forskning og utdanning med høy relevans for arbeidslivet, velferdsstaten og storbyregionen.
I over 200 år har OsloMet – storbyuniversitetet bidratt til å bygge kunnskap og kompetanse for det norske velferdssamfunnet. I dag er OsloMet et moderne og urbant universitet som er kjent for sine store og solide fagmiljøer innenfor lærerutdanning, helse- og sosialfag, samfunnsforskning, design og teknologifag.

Doctoral Students in Quantum Networking with Superconducting Circuits
The Quantum Device Lab is looking for highly motivated Doctoral Students for the development of a superconducting qubit quantum network and research in quantum networking applications.

A team of researchers led by Andreas Wallraff from the  Quantum Device Lab , at the  Department of Physics  of ETH Zurich has developed a unique superconducting qubit system consisting of two dilution refrigerators equipped with superconducting qubit chips, separated by 30 meters, and connected through a cryogenic link. By exchanging microwave photons across the link, this system can generate remote entanglement between the separated chips as a resource for quantum information experiments and applications. The platform has already enabled demonstrations including loophole-free Bell tests and randomness amplification .

We are now expanding the platform through advances in chip fabrication, packaging, networking protocols, and distributed control systems. These developments will enable research into further potential application areas of quantum networks, including loss-tolerant photonic state transfer, distributed quantum computing and quantum error correction, blind quantum computing, and non-local sensing. To ensure this project's success and fast progress, we are looking for highly motivated Doctoral Students in quantum networking with superconducting circuits.

Job description

You will become part of our team developing and running a two-node quantum network

You will be working closely with the rest of the Quantum Device Lab, a well-established research group with a strong background in quantum computing with superconducting qubits, and be able to both benefit from the expertise developed there and contribute to its progress

You will perform collaborative research towards the realization of quantum networking technologies

You will get to contribute to diverse aspects of the experimental effort, both technical (design of electronics and mechanical components, building of microwave setups, fabrication of superconducting circuit chips) and conceptual (design of experiments, exploring quantum networking applications, planning of future research strategies)

In the lab, you will pursue the development of the platform by enabling and implementing quantum networking protocols on a network of multi-qubit superconducting circuit chips

Profile

You have a strong interest in experimental realizations of quantum information processing systems, with a focus on remote and non-local applications

You are dedicated to pursuing a successful career in research, development, or education, either in academia or industry

You have experience and a proven record in one or more of the following:

Quantum information processing and its implementations (e.g. with superconducting circuits, quantum dots, ion traps, NMR)

Experimental quantum optics and atomic physics (cavity quantum electrodynamics)

Micro and nano-electronic devices and their fabrication (lithography and deposition techniques)

Quantum networking and remote entanglement generation

Mesoscopic solid state physics

Low temperature physics

Microwave electronics

Digital electronics

FPGAs

Instrumentation, drivers, and software development

We offer
Your project is embedded into the Swiss Quantum Science and Technology network, the  Quantum Center  at ETH Zurich, and into the broader context of a diverse set of international research projects. You will have the unique opportunity to contribute to a strong research program conducted at a leading European research institution. ETH Zurich provides a stimulating interdisciplinary research environment in quantum information science. This is combined with some of the world's best infrastructure for performing top-level research, such as our centers for micro- and nanoscience ( FIRST - Center for Micro- and Nanoscience  and  B & R Nanotechnology Center ). The Quantum Device Lab is located in Zurich, an international city with high quality of life, situated in the heart of Europe.

ETH Zurich is a family-friendly employer with excellent working conditions. You can look forward to an exciting working environment, cultural diversity and attractive offers and benefits.

About ETH Zurich

ETH Zurich is one of the world’s leading universities specialising in science and technology. We are renowned for our excellent education, cutting-edge fundamental research and direct transfer of new knowledge into society. Over 30,000 people from more than 120 countries find our university to be a place that promotes independent thinking and an environment that inspires excellence. Located in the heart of Europe, yet forging connections all over the world, we work together to develop solutions for the global challenges of today and tomorrow.

Working, teaching and research at ETH Zurich We value diversity and sustainability
In line with our values , ETH Zurich encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity, value diversity and nurture a working and learning environment in which the rights and dignity of all our staff and students are respected. Visit our Equal Opportunities and Diversity website to find out how we ensure a fair and open environment that allows everyone to grow and flourish. Sustainability is a core value for us – we are consistently working towards a climate-neutral future .
Curious? So are we.
We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:

A detailed curriculum vitae

A list of publications

A statement of research interests, containing a short description of your background, motivation, and skills

PDF copies of theses and transcripts/certificates from undergraduate studies (both Bachelor and Master’s) as available

Names of three contacts for references (Please arrange for one or more of the reference letters to be sent directly by email to [email protected] )

Further information about the Quantum Device Lab can be found on  our website . Questions regarding the position should be directed to  [email protected] (no applications).

Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through our online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered. Consideration of applications will begin immediately and will continue until we have filled the positions.

Arbetsuppgifter
Enheten för Kraft och värme vid Institutionen för energiteknik söker en forskningsingenjör som ska bedriva forskning inom de Vinnova-finansierade projekten ”Inverkan av INlopps-Distorsion på AEROdynamiska och AEROelastiska egenskaper hos ett axiellt kompressorsteg (INDIAERO)” och ”AI Supported Adaptive Manufacturing (AISAM)”.
Projekten behandlar två viktiga aspekter som påverkar den aerodynamiska och aeromekaniska prestandan hos fläkt- och kompressorblad i flygplansmotorer: skovelerosion och inloppsdistorsion. Framkantserosion kan medföra ökade aerodynamiska förluster och därmed ökad bränsleförbrukning. Samtidigt utsätts flygplansmotorer ofta för ojämna inflödesförhållanden till följd av inloppsgeometri och varierande flygförhållanden, vilket kan påverka både aerodynamisk prestanda och aeroelastisk stabilitet samt medföra risk för exempelvis fladder och högcykelutmattning.
Tillförlitliga metoder för att bedöma dessa effekter är fortfarande under utveckling och utgör ett aktivt internationellt forskningsområde. Tillgång till högkvalitativa experimentella data är en viktig förutsättning för utveckling och validering av sådana metoder.
Arbetsuppgifterna omfattar utveckling och konstruktion av experimentella uppställningar, genomförande av detaljerade aerodynamiska mätningar samt analys och jämförelse av experimentella och numeriska resultat. Tjänsten innebär nära samarbete med de industriella partnerna som deltar i projekten.
Utöver forskningsaktiviteterna kan tjänsten även innefatta undervisning och andra utbildningsrelaterade aktiviteter motsvarande upp till 10 % av arbetstiden.
Kvalifikationer
Krav
För att kvalificera dig för tjänsten har du en civilingenjörsexamen eller masterexamen inom energiteknik, flygteknik, maskinteknik, strömningsmekanik eller motsvarande kompetens.
Du har goda kunskaper i aerodynamik för turbomaskiner. Dessa ska vara demonstrerade genom utbildningsrelevanta program/kurser och/eller arbetslivserfarenhet.
Vetenskaplig skicklighet
Medvetenhet om mångfalds- och likabehandlingsfrågor, med särskilt fokus på jämställdhet
Samarbetsförmåga
Självständighet

Meriterande
Erfarenhet av experimentell prövning och design av aerodynamiska experiment är särskilt meriterande.

Vi kommer lägga stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper.
Bli en del av KTH
KTH formar framtiden genom utbildning, forskning och innovation. Som ett ledande internationellt tekniskt universitet spelar vi en aktiv roll i att driva och medverka i omställningen till ett hållbart samhälle. Här erbjuds du möjligheten att växa och utvecklas på en kreativ och dynamisk arbetsplats med goda arbetsvillkor och förmåner. Jämställdhet, mångfald och lika villkor är en kvalitetsfråga och en självklar del av KTH:s värdegrund som universitet och statlig myndighet.
Läs mer om våra förmåner och hur det är att arbeta och utvecklas på KTH.
Fackliga representanter
Kontaktuppgifter till  fackliga representanter .
Ansökan
Du ansöker via KTH:s rekryteringssystem. Du som sökande har huvudansvaret för att din ansökan är komplett när den skickas in.
Ansökan ska innehålla:
CV inklusive relevant yrkeserfarenhet och kunskap.
Kopia av examensbevis och betyg från dina tidigare universitetsstudier. Översättningar till engelska eller svenska om de ursprungliga dokumenten inte utfärdas på något av dessa språk.
Kortfattad redogörelse för varför du vill bedriva forskning, dina akademiska intressen och hur de relaterar till dina tidigare studier och framtida mål. max 1 sida lång.

Ansökan ska vara KTH tillhanda senast sista ansökningsdagen vid midnatt, CET/CEST (CentralEuropean Time/Central European Summer Time).
Om anställningen
Anställningen gäller tidsbegränsat enligt avtal - i upp till 12 mån, med tillträde enligt överenskommelse.
Övrigt
För i nformation om behandling av personuppgifter i samband med rekrytering.
Det kan förekomma att en anställning hos KTH är placerad i säkerhetsklass. Om så är fallet för just denna anställning görs en säkerhetsprövning av sökande i enlighet med säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) efter samtycke. I dessa fall är en förutsättning för anställning att sökande blir godkänd efter säkerhetsprövning.

ap:254298.body:
Introduction
Are you inspired to make textile production digital, circular, and scalable for SMEs? Are you eager to turn machine, production, and ecosystem data into insights using data science, ML, and AI, working with companies to redesign and orchestrate entire textile value chains?
Job Description
Large volumes of used textiles are collected every year, but deciding what each garment should become next remains slow, manual, and inconsistent. Information about material, construction, damage, and repair history is rarely available when that decision is made, so garments that could be repaired, reused, or resold are often downgraded or recycled too early. Moreover, orchestrating value chain efforts in textiles remains unfulfilled. As an EngD trainee, you will develop AI that assesses used garments and routes each one to its highest-value next life while looking to larger ecosystem orchestration.
What you will do
You will build labeled image datasets with repair and sorting partners and train computer vision and machine learning models that classify damage, condition, and material. You will combine these assessments with product passport, manufacturing and production data, partner capacity and environmental impact into decision models that route garments to repair, reuse, resale, remanufacturing or recycling. At ecosystem level, you will explore how AI can orchestrate the value chain, feeding what is learned from used garments back into design and manufacturing so that companies can plan production, repair and recovery together.
Working with people
This is a collaborative role. You will work alongside manufacturers, designers, sorters, and repair specialists, learn how they make decisions today, and translate their expertise into data and models they can trust. You will be part of a public-private field lab with TU/e, industry, design researchers, and the Dutch Textile Campus, with close supervision and room to grow as an engineer.
Why it matters
Your work keeps textiles in use longer, provides SMEs with evidence for new European producer responsibility rules, and turns textile waste into a resource for new production that works together. In this project, we examine how the knowledge generated informs all industries in the region.
Job Requirements
A master’s degree (or an equivalent university degree) in Industrial Design or related field.
A design-oriented attitude.
Ability to work in a team and interest in collaborating with industrial partners.
Fluent in spoken and written English.

Conditions of Employment
A meaningful job in a dynamic and ambitious university, in an interdisciplinary setting and within an international network. You will work on a beautiful, green campus within walking distance of the central train station.
In addition, we offer you:
Full-time employment for two years.

In addition to your base salary, you will receive an 8% holiday allowance and an 8.3% year-end bonus, both calculated based on your annual gross base salary.
Generous leave options: a standard 29 days (based on a 38 hour working week) per year that you can increase to 41 days by working two hours more per week (flexible working hours). This is prorated if you work part-time.
As a TU/e employee, you participate in the ABP pension scheme, providing retirement pension and pension benefits for surviving dependents and occupational disability. TU/e pays 70% of the pension premium, while employees contribute the remaining 30%.
High-quality training programs on general skills, didactics and topics related to research and valorization.
An excellent technical infrastructure, and on-campus children's day care.

We support your wellbeing with free 24/7 access to OpenUp, providing you and your family with mental health support, expert guidance, and online training.

A TU/e Postdoc Association that helps you to build a stronger and broader academic and personal network, and offers tailored support, training and workshops.
A Staff Immigration Team is available for international candidates, as are a tax compensation scheme (the Expat Scheme ) and a compensation for moving expenses.

On our website you can discover even more information about our conditions of employment . Build on your career at TU/e!
About us
We are a leading international university where scientific curiosity meets a hands-on mindset. We work in an open and collaborative way with high-tech industries to tackle complex societal challenges. Our responsible and respectful approach ensures impact — today and in the future. TU/e is home to over 13,000 students and more than 7,000 staff, forming a diverse and vibrant academic community. Discover what Light Up means to TU/e in our short company video .
Our university is located in Brainport Eindhoven — a world‑leading tech region with more than 7,000 high‑tech companies and strong R&D activity. Known for breakthroughs in AI, photonics, semiconductors and advanced manufacturing, Brainport is a place where technology serves people and society. Learn more about the Brainport region here .

We invite you to apply for a position of PhD candidate in Philosophy (1 + 2 years). The successful candidate will carry out research in the context of the project ‘Fluidity in the Medieval Aristotle. Readers and Readings of the Greek-Latin Translations’ (FitMA), funded by the European Research Council (ERC) under the Horizon Europe research and innovation programme (grant agreement 101164582 – FitMA). The project’s aim is to examine the impact of the manuscript transmission of medieval Latin translations on their reception history, with a focus on the interventions by translators and readers of the texts. The PI of the project is Pieter Beullens (KU Leuven).

The successful candidate will prepare a dissertation that realises one of the goals set in the FitMA project, i.e. the study of the connection between the annotations by readers preserved in manuscripts of the translatio vetus of Aristotle’s De anima and the earliest Latin commentary tradition of the 13th century. As part of their research, the candidate will produce a digital edition of these annotations that will be openly accessible online. The research will be supervised by the PI of the FitMA project.

FitMA project website:

Website unit

Project

The selected applicant will conduct the research leading to their own PhD as an active member of the FitMA team and within the aims of the project. They will be expected to participate in the organisation of common activities related to the project, such as team meetings, presentations, and conferences, and in the research activities of the De Wulf-Mansion Centre for Ancient, Medieval and Renaissance Philosophy, in which the project is embedded.

Profile

The candidate has

• a Master’s degree in Philosophy, Arts, or another relevant subject, concluded with excellent study results (or they will have it before the start of the employment). They meet the admission requirements of the PhD programme of the Institute of Philosophy

• an excellent academic knowledge of Latin

The candidate is

• prepared to acquire a deeper background in medieval philosophy

• aware that a working knowledge of Latin medieval palaeography and (digital) edition methods will have to be acquired within the first year of the project

• ready to (pro)actively contribute to the overall goals of the project as a team member

Offer

The successful candidate will be employed at KU Leuven under the standard conditions. The fellowship provides for training opportunities, social and health benefits, and office space. Remote working is possible within the rules of KU Leuven insofar as it does not interfere with the necessities of functioning as a team member.

- your academic CV

Preferred starting date: 1 December 2026 (or as soon as possible).

Two Doctoral Positions in Tropical Forest Ecology, Animal-Plant Interactions and Forest Restoration
The Species Interactions and Ecosystem Health group at ETH Zürich is seeking two motivated Doctoral candidates to join the SNSF Starting Grant project AniCaRes – Animating Carbon Restoration: The Role of Animals in Carbon Sequestration During Forest Restoration. Tropical forest restoration is a key strategy for addressing climate change and biodiversity loss. However, forest recovery depends not only on trees but also on animals, which influence seed dispersal, soil processes, plant establishment and seedling survival. AniCaRes investigates how animal communities shape tropical forest regeneration and carbon recovery across spatial scales. The project combines tropical field experiments, molecular ecology, DNA metabarcoding/eDNA, animal monitoring, remote sensing and ecological modelling, with fieldwork primarily in Panama and Brazil.

Job description
We are recruiting candidates for two complementary Doctoral projects:

Doctoral position 1 – Animals, seed dispersal and seedling establishment

The project will investigate how animals influence forest regeneration through seed dispersal, nutrient cycling and the dispersal of soil microorganisms, particularly mycorrhizal fungi

The candidate will combine field experiments, molecular approaches and ecological analyses

Fieldwork will primarily take place in Panama, in collaboration with the Smithsonian Tropical Research Institute (STRI)

Doctoral position 2 – Herbivory, animal communities and seedling survival

The project will investigate how herbivores and predators influence seedling survival, plant community composition and carbon recovery in regenerating tropical forests

The candidate will work with exclusion experiments, animal monitoring, vegetation surveys and ecological modelling

Fieldwork will primarily take place in Brazil

Both candidates will work closely with the PI, other group members and an international network of collaborators

They will contribute to data collection, analysis, scientific publications and dissemination of project results

Profile
We are looking for highly motivated candidates with a strong interest in tropical ecology, animal-plant interactions, biodiversity, forest restoration and ecosystem functioning.

Applicants should have:

A Master's degree in ecology, biology, environmental sciences or a related discipline

Strong interest in quantitative ecological research and tropical ecosystems

Experience with data analysis, preferably in R and/or Python

Ability and willingness to conduct extended fieldwork in tropical environments

Excellent written and spoken English

Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in an international research team

Previous experience with molecular laboratory work, DNA-based ecological methods and/or fieldwork in tropical ecosystems will be considered a strong asset. Experience with GIS, remote sensing, animal monitoring, experimental ecology or ecological modelling is also advantageous, but candidates are not expected to have expertise in all these areas.

We offer
The successful candidates will join an interdisciplinary and international research environment at ETH Zürich, with opportunities to develop expertise across field ecology, molecular ecology, quantitative analysis and emerging biodiversity-monitoring technologies. The projects include close collaboration with research institutions and local partners in Latin America and substantial opportunities for international fieldwork.

The positions will be funded according to ETH Zürich doctoral salary conditions.

Working, teaching and research at ETH Zurich We value diversity and sustainability
In line with our values , ETH Zurich encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity, value diversity and nurture a working and learning environment in which the rights and dignity of all our staff and students are respected. Visit our Equal Opportunities and Diversity website to find out how we ensure a fair and open environment that allows everyone to grow and flourish. Sustainability is a core value for us – we are consistently working towards a climate-neutral future .

Academic transcripts and degree certificates

Further information about the Insitute for Integrative Biology can be found on our Website . Questions regarding the position should be directed to  [email protected] , Prof. Carolina Bello (no applications).

ap:254304.body:
About the faculty:
The Wolfson Department of Chemical Engineering at the Technion – Israel Institute of Technology combines a strong foundation in engineering with research in advanced materials, biochemicals, energy, and sustainability. Its researchers connect fundamental science with practical solutions, addressing challenges from understanding nanoscale interactions to developing cleaner technologies and improving healthcare. Graduate students combine advanced studies with research in the department’s laboratories, gaining the skills to contribute to science and industry.
About the research:
To date Quartz Crystal Microbalance with Dissipation monitoring (QCM-D) is one of the key tools for accurate investigation of the adsorption kinetics of nanometric objects, such as DNA fragments, polypeptides, proteins, viruses, liposomes, polymer and metal nanoparticles. The QCM measurements rely on frequency response (or impedance) of fast (MHz range) oscillating quartz crystal due to an adsorbed material. While quantitative QCM impedance analysis is well-established for adsorbed uniform films, QCM sensing of discrete adsorbates in liquid phase serves typically as a qualitative tool due to a complex interplay of viscous, inertial and adhesion forces, varying with the physicochemical properties of particles and functionalized QCM sensors.
About the position:
In this project we plan to theoretically investigate the role of transient viscous hydrodynamics due to discrete adsorbates to enable accurate interpretation of the QCM impedance measurements. The analytical theory will be accompanied by the numerical analysis. The project is in collaboration with an experimental group from Cracow, Poland and it is funded by the Israel Science Foundation (ISF).
Your profile:
The ideal MSc/PhD candidate should have a strong background in Fluid Mechanics, excellent analytical skills and working knowledge of numerical methods. An undergraduate degree in Applied Mathematics, Mechanical or Chemical Engineering, Physics or similar field is expected.
What we offer:
Fully funded 2/4 years position (depending on MSc/PhD track) with a full tuition waiver and a generous monthly scholarship.
On campus housing with subsidy.

Prof. Alexander Leshansky

On ResearchGate: https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Alexander-Leshansky?ev=hdr_xprf

CV

ap:254313.body:
Employment 0.8 - 1.0 FTE
Gross monthly salary € 3,204 - € 4,051
Required background Research University Degree
Organizational unit Faculty of Social Sciences
Application deadline 09 November 2026
Are you passionate about affective neuroscience computational modelling and transcranial ultrasound stimulation? Come and join our PhD project on approach-avoidance decisions under threat, funded by the ERC Advanced Grant HEART2ADAPT, and work with a dynamic team.
Why do some people remain calm and make flexible decisions under stress, while others freeze or flee? HEART2ADAPT aims to answer this question. We are developing a new model to understand how the body’s autonomic stress state shapes responses to threat and how the balance between sympathetic and parasympathetic activity supports adaptive decision making in dynamic environments.
Using state-of-the-art methods to track brain and bodily signals in real time – such as heart rate, posture and advanced neuroimaging – we will investigate how stress influences decision-making. A key component of this specific PhD project is testing causal mechanisms using transcranial ultrasound stimulation (TUS), including both offline TUS and the development of MR-compatible online TUS.
Funded by a European Research Council (ERC) Advanced Grant, the project HEART2ADAPT offers you the opportunity to contribute to protocol development, data collection and computational modelling of behavioural and neural data. You will apply TUS to key nodes of our model, including the amygdala, ventral striatum and dorsal ACC.
You will work closely with colleagues at the Donders Institute and the Behavioural Science Institute, as well as with international collaborators. Responsibilities may also include mentoring of BSc and MSc students.
Would you like to learn more about what it’s like to pursue a PhD at Radboud University? Visit the page about working as a PhD candidate .
Does this sound like you?
You have a Master’s degree in cognitive neuroscience or an adjacent field (psychology, biology, biomedical sciences, computer sciences, or other relevant MSc).
You have a strong interest in fundamental research in cognitive and affective neurosciences and in computational psychiatry.
You have experience with applying functional MRI (acquisition and analyses), including the use of Matlab, Python, SPM, FSL and/or other software tools, or you have experience with MEG (acquisition and analyses), including the use of Fieldtrip or similar.
You have experience in non-invasive neuromodulation (preferably Transcranial Ultrasound Stimulation) or are willing to master this technique.
You have experience in the acquisition and analysis of peripheral psychophysiological data (e.g. autonomic nervous system measures).
You have the capacity to participate in an interdisciplinary and translational research environment.
You have interpersonal and communication skills to effectively collaborate and communicate in academia.
You have a proactive and goal-directed attitude and good organisational skills. You are fluent in written and spoken English.

Even if you do not meet all criteria, you are encouraged to apply if the role interests you.
What we offer you
We will give you a temporary employment contract (0.8 FTE 5- year contract - 1.0 FTE 4- year contract) of 1.5 years, after which your performance will be evaluated. If the evaluation is positive, your contract will be extended by 2.5 years (4-year contract) or 3.5 years (5-year contract).
You will receive a starting salary of €3,204 gross per month based on a 38-hour working week, which will increase to €4,051 from the fourth year onwards ( salary scale P ).
You will receive an 8% holiday allowance and an 8,3% end-of-year bonus.
You will receive extra days off. With full-time employment, you can choose between 30 or 41 days of annual leave instead of the statutory 20.

Additional employment conditions
Work and science require good employment practices. Radboud University's primary and secondary employment conditions reflect this. You can make arrangements for the best possible work-life balance with flexible working hours, various leave arrangements and working from home. You are also able to compose part of your employment conditions yourself. For example, exchange income for extra leave days and receive a reimbursement for your sports membership. In addition, you receive a 34% discount on the sports and cultural activities at Radboud University as an employee. And, of course, we offer a good pension plan. We also give you plenty of room and responsibility to develop your talents and realise your ambitions. Therefore, we provide various training and development schemes.
Where you will be working
Your position will be embedded in the Affective Neuroscience group led by Prof. Karin Roelofs at the Faculty of Social Sciences. You will be appointed by the Faculty's Behavioural Science Institute (BSI). You will be based at the Donders Centre for Cognitive Neuroimaging (DCCN) . You will also work closely with Lennart Verhagen’s group.
Both BSI and DCCN are known for their successful graduate schools and strong dedication to open science and team science. Together, they create a warm, inclusive and cooperative research environment in which staff are well-supported in a work culture that promotes collaboration and respect.
Behavioural Science Institute
BSI is an interdisciplinary research institute where fundamental, applied and translational research takes place with the aim of understanding important societal issues and contributing to their solutions. BSI is one of the three research institutes of the Faculty of Social Sciences at Radboud University. Our researchers collaborate across the boundaries of psychology, communication science and pedagogical and educational science. Our mission for the coming years is to join forces in interdisciplinary research on the theme ’Empowering the Young’. We study the challenges that young people face in our current society and contribute to their empowerment. The institute provides excellent research facilities and has strong collaborations with non-academic partners. BSI has state-of-the-art research facilities for observational studies, experiments, eye-tracking studies, EEG measurements and GSR recording, psychobiological research, and behavioural measurements in both real and 3D virtual environments.
The Donders Centre for Cognitive Neuroimaging
The mission of this world class research centre is to conduct cutting-edge fundamental research in cognitive neuroscience. Much of the rapid progress in this field is being driven by the development of complex neuroimaging techniques for measuring activity in the human brain - an area in which the Centre plays a leading role. The research themes cover central cognitive functions such as perception, action, control, emotion, decision-making, attention, memory, language, learning and plasticity. The Centre also aims to establish how the different brain areas coordinate their activity with very high temporal precision to enable human and animal cognition. Our internationally renowned centre currently hosts more than 100 PhD candidates and postdoctoral researchers from more than 25 countries, offering a stimulating and multidisciplinary research environment. The centre is equipped with four MRI scanners (7T, 2x 3T), a 275-channel MEG system, an EEG-TMS/TUS laboratory, several (MR-compatible) EEG systems and high-performance computational facilities.
Faculty of Social Sciences
At the Faculty of Social Sciences , humanity and society are our focus; we study how people behave, think and feel. Within this context, we look at themes such as human behaviour and the human psyche, education and upbringing, communication, society and culture. The faculty provides education to 6,000 students and employs 700 staff. Education is organised into six programme clusters: Psychology; Artificial Intelligence; Pedagogical Sciences and Educational Sciences; Communication Science; Sociology; and Cultural Anthropology and Developmental Sociology, and the Radboud Centre Social Sciences as an institute for post-master education have been merged into the Social Sciences Education Institute. Our research is carried out within three research institutes: the Donders Centre for Cognition, the Behavioural Science Institute, and Radboud Social Cultural Research.
Radboud University
At Radboud University, we aim to make an impact through our work. We achieve this by conducting groundbreaking research, providing high-quality education, offering excellent support, and fostering collaborations within and outside the university. In doing so, we contribute indispensably to a healthy, free world with equal opportunities for all. To accomplish this, we need even more colleagues who, based on their expertise, are willing to search for answers. We advocate for an inclusive community and welcome employees with diverse backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives.
If you want to learn more about working at Radboud University, follow our Instagram account and read stories from our colleagues.
Is this the job for you?
You can apply only via the button below. Address your letter of application to Karin Roelofs. In the application form, you will find which documents you need to include with your application. We look forward to receiving your application.
The first interviews will take place on Thursday 26 November. Any second interview will take place on Wednesday 2 December. You will preferably start your employment in January 2027.
We can imagine you're curious about our  application procedure . It describes what you can expect during the application procedure and how we handle your personal data and internal and external candidates.

Haluatko olla rakentamassa VTT:n digitaalista tulevaisuutta? Etsimme johtavaa kokonaisarkkitehtia ohjaamaan strategisia muutosohjelmia, yhdistämään liiketoiminnan ja teknologian sekä varmistamaan, että arkkitehtuuri vauhdittaa VTT:n uudistumista.
VTT on yksi Euroopan johtavista tutkimuslaitoksista. Meitä VTT:läisiä yhdistää uteliaisuus, intohimo oppimiseen ja pyrkimys ratkoa aikamme suurimpia haasteita ja kääntää ne kestävään kasvuun ja hyvinvointiin. Poikkitieteellinen ja kansainvälinen yhteisömme koostuu yli 2000 huippuammattilaisesta, jotka ovat sitoutuneet luomaan vaikuttavuutta tieteeseen perustuvien innovaatioiden avulla. Tutustu meihin tarkemmin tutkimalla  VTT tech & infraa .
Etsimme johtavaa kokonaisarkkitehtia (Chief Enterprise Architect, Digital Transformation) vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Espooseen!
Kokonaisarkkitehtina neuvot ja tuet VTT:n johtoa ja muutosohjelmia kokonaisarkkitehtuuriin liittyvissä asioissa, edistät uuden strategiamme toteuttamista ja johdat kokonaisarkkitehtuuritoiminnan kehittämistä. Tässä roolissa et vain ylläpidä arkkitehtuuria, vaan pääset aktiivisesti rakentamaan ja uudistamaan tapaa, jolla kokonaisarkkitehtuuria hyödynnetään VTT:n johtamisessa, kehittämisessä ja muutoksessa.
Kokonaisarkkitehtina neuvot ja tuet VTT:n johtoa ja muutosohjelmia kokonaisarkkitehtuuriin liittyvissä asioissa, edistät uuden strategiamme toteuttamista ja johdat kokonaisarkkitehtuuritoiminnan kehittämistä. Pääset aktiivisesti rakentamaan ja uudistamaan tapaa, jolla kokonaisarkkitehtuuria hyödynnetään VTT:n johtamisessa, kehittämisessä ja muutoksessa.
Yhdistät tutkimuksen ja liiketoiminnan tarpeet prosessien, datan, tekoälyn ja digitaalisten ratkaisujen kehittämiseen. Autat tunnistamaan kehityshankkeiden väliset riippuvuudet ja yhteiset mahdollisuudet sekä ohjaat ratkaisuja kohti yhteentoimivaa, turvallista ja hallittavaa kokonaisuutta. Työsi tukee kehittämisen ja investointien priorisointia sekä sitä, että yksittäisistä ratkaisuista syntyy laajemmin VTT:tä palvelevia kyvykkyyksiä.
Etsimämme henkilön tunnusmerkit:
Omaa vahvaa kokemusta kokonaisarkkitehtuurista (tyypillisesti yli 8 vuotta relevanttia kokemusta organisaation sisäisenä arkkitehtina tai konsulttina). Keskeinen osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi kattavat vähintään kolme viidestä näkökulmasta: liiketoiminta-, tieto-, sovellus-, integraatio- ja teknologia-arkkitehtuurista. Ymmärrät myös tietoturvan vaatimukset kaikissa näkökulmissa
Vahvaa ymmärrystä liiketoiminnan ja teknologian yhdistämisestä, tiedonhallinnasta sekä tekoälyä hyödyntävien toimintamallien suunnittelusta
Kokemusta arkkitehtina toimimisesta vaativissa liiketoiminnan muutosohjelmissa
Erinomaisia viestintä- ja esiintymistaitoja – hallitset työpajojen vetämisen, esiintymisen niin asiantuntijoille kuin ylimmälle johdolle (CxO-taso) sekä näkemystesi perustelemisen
Tuntemusta kokonaisarkkitehtuurin viitekehyksistä ja menetelmistä sekä käytännön kokemusta kokonaisarkkitehtuurityökaluista
Dynaamista ja visionääristä otetta viitekehysten soveltamisessa käytäntöön ja uusien tapojen kehittämisessä kokonaisarkkitehtuurin hallintaan VTT:llä
Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa

Katsomme erityisesti eduksi, jos sinulla on:
Kokemusta moderneista pilviteknologioista, kuten SAP, M365 ja Salesforce
Monipuolista urakokemusta muistakin kuin arkkitehdin tehtävistä, mikä tukee laajaa ja strategista liiketoimintaymmärrystäsi

Tarjoamme sinulle:
Merkityksellistä työtä: VTT:llä voit hyödyntää ammatillista osaamistasi ratkaistessamme aikamme suurimpia haasteita tieteen ja innovaatioiden avulla. Tutkimuksemme tavoitteena on vastata systeemisiin ja teknologisiin haasteisiin, kuten hiilineutraaliuden saavuttamiseen ja huippuluokan digitaalisten järjestelmien luomiseen. VTT:llä voit olla mukana tässä merkityksellisessä muutoksessa hyödyntämällä ammattitaitoasi. Lue lisää strategiastamme ja organisaatiokulttuuristamme, jonka avulla rakennamme maailman merkityksellisintä työpaikkaa Strategiamme: Kasvun ketjureaktio | VTT
Innostavan työyhteisön: VTT yhdistää innovaatioiden kärkialoja kvanttiteknologiasta synteettiseen biologiaan. VTT-tiimin jäsenenä pääset vaikuttamaan tieteen ja teknologian tulevaisuuteen.
Ura- ja oppimismahdollisuudet: Tieteellisenä asiantuntijaorganisaationa panostamme vahvasti oppimiseen ja kehittymiseen sekä tuemme henkilöstöämme täyden potentiaalin saavuttamisessa. Tarjoamme mahdollisuuksia ammatilliseen kasvuun ja etenemiseen uusien vastuualueiden myötä. Siksi VTT:llä viihdytään pitkään – työsuhteen keskimääräinen kesto on yli kymmenen vuotta. Jos olet utelias, kunnianhimoinen ja halukas oppimaan uutta, VTT on oikea paikka viedä urasi uudelle tasolle.
Tukea hyvinvointiin: Henkilöstömme on tärkein voimavaramme, joten pidämme heistä hyvää huolta. Panostamme tiimityön ja johtamisen kehittämiseen ja tarjoamme monipuolisia hyvinvointipalveluja tasapainoisen työ- ja yksityiselämän tukemiseksi. Liikunta- ja kulttuurietujen sekä harrastekerhojen lisäksi tarjoamme kuuden viikon palkallisen vuosiloman (yhden vuoden jatkuneen työsuhteen jälkeen).
Modernit, hybridityöhön suunnitellut työtilat: Työskentelemme tällä hetkellä toimistolla keskimäärin kolmena päivänä viikossa.

Hae nyt ja liity huippuammattilaistemme joukkoon!
Lähetäthän hakemuksesi viimeistään 4.11.2026. Kannustamme hakemaan mahdollisimman pian, sillä käsittelemme hakemuksia jatkuvasti ja täytämme paikan heti sopivan ehdokkaan löydyttyä. ap:254318.body:
Tampere University is a unique, boldly future‑oriented and evolving community, and one of Finland’s most multidisciplinary universities. At Tampere University, technology, health and society come together in a distinctive way. Our research groups and projects carry out interdisciplinary and cross-sectoral research that transcends organisational boundaries. Our community is international, with members from more than 80 countries. Read more at  https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau
The Faculty of Social Sciences  and  Health Sciences Unit  (HES) at Tampere University invite applications for the position of
Doctoral Researcher in Occupational Cancer Epidemiology for a fixed-term period of 3 years starting in January 2027 (or as agreed).
The Health Sciences unit provides a collaborative setting with multidisciplinary and multimethodological strengths in population health, supporting rigorous and impactful doctoral research.
Our doctoral programs in Health Sciences , Epidemiology and Public Health (IPPE) , and Medicine offer a strong methodological and research environment for completing an ongoing doctoral project within established research groups at the Health Sciences Unit. The programs provide advanced training in key areas of population health, supporting high-quality publication-oriented research and researcher training.
Job description
The doctoral researcher will join the research project “The Nordic Occupational Exposome and Cancer: Decades of Change, Mixtures, and Inequalities” (NordExCan) , led by Principal Investigator Dr. Subas Neupane. The project examines how occupational exposures change over working life and how these exposures, individually and in combination, are associated with cancer incidence, mortality, and inequalities in the Nordic countries. The research builds on the Nordic Occupational Cancer (NOCCA) cohort and Nordic job-exposure matrices, using occupational histories and population and cancer registry data from Finland, Sweden, Norway, Denmark, and Iceland.
The doctoral researcher will mainly work on Work Package 1 , focusing on occupational exposure histories and their associations with cancer incidence. The work includes harmonising occupational and registry data, estimating cumulative and time-varying exposures, and examining the effects of exposure mixtures and changes in exposure over working life. The doctoral researcher will use epidemiological and statistical methods to investigate cancer risks, including differences by sex and socioeconomic position. Depending on the research needs, the doctoral researcher may also contribute to other work packages covering rare cancers, cancer survival, and causal pathways.
The doctoral researcher will conduct research leading to a doctoral dissertation and contribute to scientific publications and conference presentations. The position also involves participating in project meetings and working closely with the Nordic research team. The research will be based on registry data analysed in secure environments using reproducible statistical methods.
Qualifications
A Master's degree in epidemiology, public health, biostatistics, health sciences, data science, or a related field is required. The selected candidate must also meet the requirements for admission to a relevant doctoral programme at Tampere University. Applicants may be required to provide proof of English proficiency, such as IELTS or TOEFL scores, in accordance with the university's admission requirements.
We are looking for a candidate with an interest in occupational and cancer epidemiology and good skills in quantitative research and statistical analysis. The candidate should be able to work independently and as part of a research team. Good written and spoken English skills are required.
The selected candidate must also meet the requirements for admission to a relevant doctoral programme ( Doctoral Programme in Health Sciences or International Doctoral Programme in Epidemiology and Public Health ) at Tampere University.
Previous experience in statistical programming, particularly R, and working with large-scale registry or longitudinal data will be considered an advantage. Experience in exposure assessment, survival analysis, or other epidemiological methods is also valuable. Familiarity with job-exposure matrices, time-varying exposures, multilevel models, or causal inference would be beneficial, but is not required. Previous experience with Nordic registry data is not required.
We offer
The position is fixed-term for 3 years starting in January 2027. A trial period of six months applies to all new employees at Tampere University.
The salary will be based on the University Salary System . The salary of a doctoral researcher is at levels 2-4. In addition to the basic salary, a supplementary portion of the salary will be paid based on the appointee’s qualifications and experience. A typical starting salary is approximately 2 800 € / month.
Most of the research will take place physically in Tampere, Finland. The appointee is expected to reside in Finland while employed by Tampere University. International staff are supported in relocating to Finland.
Tampere University is an internationally renowned research university. We offer a wide range of staff benefits, such as occupational health care, flexible working hours, and excellent sports facilities on campus. Please read more about working at Tampere University . For more information about Tampere, please see Work In Tampere . For further information about Finland, please visit InfoFinland  and This is Finland .
How to apply
Please submit your application through our online recruitment system (link below). The closing date for applications is 15th  November, 2026 (23:59 EET/UTC +2).
Please attach the following documents to your application:
Brief CV, (max. 3 pages including a list of publications.
Short (max. 1 page) motivation letter describing research interests, relevant experience, and suitability for the position.
Degree certificates and transcripts, and a brief description of previous research experience (a master’s thesis).

Enquiries
For further information about the position please contact Dr. Subas Neupane ( [email protected] ).
