ap:254430.body:
Do you want to contribute to top quality medical research?
We are seeking a Research Assistant to join the Skin Wound Healing Research Group led by Dr. Ning Xu Landén at the Division of Dermatology and Venereology, Department of Medicine, Solna, Karolinska Institutet. Based at the Centre for Molecular Medicine (CMM), our group combines human wound models, molecular biology and single-cell and spatial omics to understand tissue repair. This position offers early-career researchers hands-on training in a collaborative, internationally connected environment.
Your mission
As a Research Assistant, you will provide experimental and practical support to a project investigating how genetic sex and hormonal environment influence human skin wound healing. You will work alongside researchers studying human skin and wound samples using molecular, cellular and spatial approaches. Training will be provided for unfamiliar techniques.
Main responsibilities:
Process, prepare and document human skin and wound tissue samples
Assist with RNA extraction, gene expression assays, cell culture, immunostaining and microscopy, according to established protocols
Support sample preparation and quality control for single-cell and spatial transcriptomics experiments
Organize experimental data, maintain accurate laboratory records and contribute to preliminary analysis
Collaborate with team members, present progress in group meetings and support routine laboratory operations

Your profile
We are looking for a motivated, careful and collaborative early-career researcher with an interest in experimental biomedical research, human skin biology and tissue repair. You should be well organized, eager to learn and comfortable working with biological samples and established protocols.
Required qualifications:
A Master’s degree in Biomedicine, Molecular Biology, Cell Biology, Biotechnology, or a related field, or an equivalent degree expected to be completed before the start of employment
Documented hands-on experience in a biological or biomedical laboratory, including relevant thesis research
Ability to follow experimental protocols precisely and maintain structured laboratory records
Good communication skills in English, both spoken and written
Ability to work independently on assigned tasks and collaborate effectively with colleagues

Meritorious qualifications:
Hands-on experience with more than three of the following: RNA extraction, qRT-PCR, Western blotting, cell culture, immunostaining, and animal work
Experience handling human tissues, tissue sectioning, microscopy, RNAscope or flow cytometry
Familiarity with single-cell or spatial transcriptomics, sequencing sample preparation or basic bioinformatics
Experience presenting scientific findings or contributing to multidisciplinary research

We will place particular emphasis on your personal qualities.
What do we offer?
A creative and inspiring environment with wide-ranging expertise and interests. Karolinska Institutet is one of the world's leading medical universities. Our vision is to pursue the development of knowledge about life and to promote a better health for all. At Karolinska Institutet, we conduct successful medical research and hold the largest range of medical education in Sweden. Karolinska Institutet is also a state university, which entitles you to several good benefits through our collective agreement. And you get to practice freely in our modern wellness facilities, where trained staff are on site.
Location
The position is located within the Department of Medicine, Solna . The department consists of ten divisions and each division consists of several research groups. The position is located within the Ning Xu Landén research group, at the Division of Dermatology and Venereology, Department of Medicine, Solna, at the Centre for Molecular Medicine (CMM), Karolinska University Hospital Solna. The group studies the cellular and molecular regulation of human skin wound healing through human tissue models, experimental biology and single-cell and spatial multi-omics, in close collaboration with clinicians and other research teams.

--[Video about Karolinska Institutet, how we all work towards "a better health for all"] --

Application

The application is to be submitted through the Varbi recruitment system.In this recruitment, you will apply with your CV without a personal letter. Instead, you will answer some questions about why you are applying for the job in the application form.

ap:254431.body:
Vill du bidra till medicinsk forskning av toppkvalitet?
Vi söker en forskningsassistent till forskargruppen för sårläkning i huden, ledd av dr Ning Xu Landén vid avdelningen för dermatologi och venereologi, Institutionen för medicin, Solna, Karolinska Institutet. Vår forskargrupp är verksam vid Centrum för molekylär medicin (CMM) och kombinerar humana sårmodeller, molekylärbiologi samt encells- och spatiala omiktekniker för att förstå vävnadsreparation. Den här tjänsten erbjuder forskare i början av karriären praktisk forskningserfarenhet i en samarbetsinriktad och internationellt förankrad miljö.
Din roll
Som forskningsassistent kommer du att ge experimentellt och praktiskt stöd i ett projekt som undersöker hur genetiskt kön och hormonell miljö påverkar sårläkning i mänsklig hud. Du kommer att arbeta tillsammans med forskare som studerar human hud och sårprover med molekylära, cellulära och spatiala metoder. Introduktion och handledning ges i tekniker som du inte tidigare har arbetat med.
Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:
Hantera, preparera och dokumentera prover från human hud och sårvävnad
Medverka vid RNA-extraktion, genexpressionsanalyser, cellodling, immunfärgning och mikroskopi enligt etablerade protokoll
Stödja provberedning och kvalitetskontroll inför experiment med encells- och spatial transkriptomik
Organisera experimentella data, föra noggrann laboratoriedokumentation och bidra till preliminära analyser
Samarbeta med gruppmedlemmar, presentera arbetets framsteg vid gruppmöten och bidra till det löpande laboratoriearbetet

Vem är du?
Vi söker en motiverad, noggrann och samarbetsinriktad person i början av sin forskarkarriär med intresse för experimentell biomedicinsk forskning, human hudbiologi och vävnadsreparation. Du är välorganiserad, villig att lära dig och känner dig bekväm med att arbeta med biologiska prover och etablerade protokoll.
Kvalifikationskrav:
Masterexamen inom biomedicin, molekylärbiologi, cellbiologi, bioteknik eller närliggande område, eller motsvarande examen som förväntas vara avklarad före anställningens början
Dokumenterad praktisk erfarenhet av arbete i ett biologiskt eller biomedicinskt laboratorium, inklusive relevant examensarbete
Förmåga att följa experimentella protokoll noggrant och föra strukturerad laboratoriedokumentation
God förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på engelska
Förmåga att arbeta självständigt och god samarbetsförmåga

Meriterande kvalifikationer:
Praktisk erfarenhet av fler än tre av följande tekniker: RNA-extraktion, qRT-PCR, Western blot, cellodling, immunfärgning och djurförsök
Erfarenhet av hantering av human vävnad, vävnadssnittning, mikroskopi, RNAscope eller flödescytometri
Kännedom om encells- eller spatial transkriptomik, provberedning inför sekvensering eller grundläggande bioinformatik
Erfarenhet av att presentera vetenskapliga resultat eller delta i tvärvetenskaplig forskning

Vi lägger särskild vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.
Vad erbjuder vi?
En kreativ, internationell och inspirerande miljö fylld av kompetens och nyfikenhet. Karolinska Institutet är ett av världens ledande medicinska universitet. Vår vision är att driva utvecklingen av kunskap om livet och verka för en bättre hälsa för alla. Här bedriver vi framgångsrik medicinsk forskning och har det största utbudet av medicinska utbildningar i Sverige. Som universitet är Karolinska Institutet en statlig myndighet. Det gör att du får goda förmåner genom vårt kollektivavtal. Medarbetare på KI erbjuds också möjlighet till ett flexibelt arbetssätt. Det innebär att om den verksamhet du jobbar i tillåter, så kan du arbeta en del av din arbetstid på distans. Du får även träna fritt i våra moderna friskvårdsanläggningar där utbildad personal finns på plats.
Placering
Tjänsten är placerad inom Institutionen för medicin, Solna. Institutionen består av tio avdelningar och varje avdelning består av flertalet forskargrupper. Den aktuella tjänsten är placerad inom forskargrupp Ning Xu Landén vid avdelningen för dermatologi och venereologi, Institutionen för medicin, Solna, på Centrum för molekylär medicin (CMM), Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset Solna. Gruppen studerar cellulär och molekylär reglering av sårläkning i mänsklig hud genom humana vävnadsmodeller, experimentell biologi samt encells- och spatial multiomik, i nära samarbete med kliniker och andra forskargrupper.

--[Video om Karolinska Institutet, hur vi alla bidrar till en bättre hälsa för alla] ---

Ansökan
KI tillämpar individuell och differentierad lönesättning enligt våra kollektivavtal RALS och RALS-T.
Ansökan ska göras via rekryteringssystemet Varbi. I denna rekrytering söker du med ditt CV utan personligt brev. I ansökningsformuläret kommer du istället att få svara på några frågor om varför du söker jobbet.

ap:254436.body:
About the Position
The University of Stavanger invites applicants for a position as PhD Fellow in Biological Psychology at the Faculty of Social Sciences, Department of Psychology. The position is vacant from December 2026.
The PhD fellowship leads to a doctoral degree and gives you the opportunity to develop research expertise in an active and stimulating academic environment. Through the doctoral education, you will acquire knowledge, skills and experience that qualify you for a further career in research, higher education, and other knowledge-intensive sectors.
The successful candidate will be admitted to the PhD programme in Social Sciences, Research School in Psychology (PSYENCE). The programme includes coursework, an independent research project culminating in a doctoral thesis, participation in national and international research communities, dissemination of research, a trial lecture, and a public defence of the thesis. For more information about the PhD education at UiS, please visit our website.
As a PhD Fellow at UiS, you will receive supervision and support for your academic and professional development through mentoring, skills development, and career planning.
The position is for three years of pure research training and is associated with the  UiS Biopsychology Research Group
Research Topic
The successful candidate will be affiliated with the research project PRIME (Physiological Reactivity in Health and Disease: Mechanisms and Effects) is led by Professor Bianka Karshikoff. PRIME investigates physiological reactivity – the body’s capacity to respond to stress and immunological challenges – along two interconnected lines of research:
Individual differences in physiological reactivity , and how these are related to health and personality.
Early chronic pain as a distinct and understudied population, focusing on individuals within the first year of persistent musculoskeletal pain.

The project is interdisciplinary, spanning psychology, endocrinology, and immunology, and uses experimental methods and physiological biomarkers.
We are looking for a candidate with a genuine interest in this area of research or in one or more of the study components. Within the overall framework of the project, there is also scope to further develop the research and design sub-studies with a clear individual focus, in collaboration with Professor Karshikoff.
A more detailed description of the study is available at www.uis.no and in the project registry.
Project Proposal
As part of the application, you are required to submit a preliminary project proposal for a PhD project within the research area described above.
In the proposal, we ask you to give a brief description of how you might further develop the study, for example through an independent research question or research direction within the overall framework of the project.
The project proposal should give a sense of your scientific reasoning and will be considered as part of the overall assessment. The final direction of the PhD project will be developed in collaboration with the supervisors and will depend on available resources, data, and practical feasibility. During the first three months of the employment period, the project proposal and progress plan will be further developed in collaboration with the supervisors and finalized as the PhD project plan. A project proposal template can be found  here.
Qualifications
You must have a strong academic background with a five-year master's degree within a subject that is relevant to the project (psychology, neuroscience, biomedicine, cognitive science, or related fields), or equivalent qualifications that provide a basis for undertaking doctoral studies, preferably obtained recently.
Your master's thesis grade and weighted average grade for the master's degree must both correspond to a grade of B or better.
If you have completed your education at an institution that uses a grading scale other than A-F, please provide documentation explaining how your grades correspond to the Norwegian grading scale. You may use these conversion tables to calculate your admission score.
If you are completing your master's degree in the autumn 2026, you are also welcome to apply.
The assessment emphasizes your potential for research within the field and the personal aptitude to complete the doctoral programme within the employment period.
We will also place emphasis on whether you:
demonstrate high academic integrity and a strong commitment to quality in your work
are curious and motivated to carry out the research project and contribute to academic communities and collaboration across disciplines
have a documented interest in biological psychology, psychophysiology, psychoneuroimmunology, stress and/or pain research
have experience with quantitative and statistical methods, as well as motivation and potential for research within the field
are able to work effectively both independently and in collaboration with other researchers
demonstrate the ability for critical reflection, innovative thinking, and independent problem-solving, and work in a structured and goal-oriented manner
have good collaboration and communication skills and contribute to a constructive working environment
have good command of English, both written and spoken

It is an advantage if you:
have previous laboratory experience
have proficiency in a Scandinavian language, given the nature of the data collection

As a PhD Fellow at UiS, you will receive
a PhD education at a university with a strong societal mission and ambitious academic goals
an ambitious and inclusive research environment. We strive to include employees at all levels in strategic decisions and promote an informal atmosphere with a flat organisational structure.
free Norwegian language courses if you do not have proficiency in Norwegian, Swedish, or Danish at level A2 at the time of employment.
access to Lifekeys , a digital service that supports mental health and well-being
salary in accordance with the State Salary Scale, l.pl 17.515, code 1017, NOK 580 000 gross per year with salary development according to seniority in the position. From the salary, 2% is deducted as a contribution to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund.
membership in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (Statens pensjonskasse), which provides favourable pension and insurance schemes
favourable membership terms at SiS Sports Centre and the university sports club
employment with an Inclusive Workplace organisation committed to reducing sick leave and promoting and inclusive working life
access to the Hjem-jobb-hjem programme, offering discounted public transportation to and from work
relocation support
access to comprehensive health services, generous parental leave arrangements and a well-developed welfare system.

Diversity and Inclusion
Diversity is a strength at the University of Stavanger. Different experiences, perspectives and backgrounds contribute to better solutions and a positive working and learning environment. We welcome applicants with diverse qualifications, life experiences and perspectives, and encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of gender, age, disability, cultural background, or whether they have experienced periods outside the workforce. UiS is committed to supporting employees in different stages of life and to providing reasonable accommodation for employees with individual needs.
In accordance with applicable regulations, at least one qualified applicant with a disability, a gap in their CV, or an immigrant background will be invited for an interview. If this applies to you, you may indicate this in the application portal. Read more about the scheme here .
The University seeks to improve gender balance in PhD positions within this field and therefore particularly encourages women to apply. In cases where applicants are considered equally qualified, women may be given preference in accordance with applicable regulations.
Do you have questions?
Feel free to contact us if you would like to know more about the position:
Professor Bianka Karshikoff, phone: 518 314 88, e-mail: [email protected]

If you have questions about the recruitment process, please contact:
HR-rådgiver Christina Storm, phone: 518 317 53, e-mail: [email protected]

How to Apply
Apply for this job by clicking "Apply for this job" button on this page.
In Jobbnorge, you must register at least your application, relevant education and work experience, as well as language skills. In your application letter, please describe your research interests, your motivation for applying for the position, and how your background is relevant to the research project.
The following documentation must be uploaded as attachments to your application:
project proposal, see template available on our website .
CV with a complete overview of your education, experience, and any scientific or scholarly work
diploma and transcript of records documenting completion of a master's degree. If you have not yet completed your master's degree, you must submit an up-to-date transcript of records
Diploma Supplement or equivalent documentation, and a confirmed grade conversion scale if required
publications or other relevant research work
references and other documentation considered relevant to the application

The documentation must be provided in a Scandinavian language or in English
Applications will be assessed based on the information available in Jobbnorge when the application deadline expires. Please ensure that your application clearly demonstrates how your qualifications and experience meet the requirements described in the announcement, and that all required documentation has been uploaded. If the total size of the attachments exceeds 100 MB, the files must be compressed before upload.
UiS only considers applications and attachments submitted through Jobbnorge.
Information about applicants may be made public even if an applicant has requested not to be included on the public list of applicants, cf. Section 25 of the Freedom of Information Act . If such a request is not granted, you will be notified.
Terms of Employment and Recruitment Process
UiS is subject to the Norwegian Security Act. Employees are expected to demonstrate security-conscious behaviour and comply with applicable security and export control procedures. In the appointment process, attributes such as reliability, sound judgement and loyalty will be emphasised.
Employment as PhD Fellow is regulated in Regulations to the Universities and Colleges Act, chapter IV . Admission to the doctoral programme is governed by the Regulations for the degree of Philosophia Doctor (PhD) at the University of Stavanger.
Your qualifications for the position, based on the documentation registrered in Jobbnorge by the application deadline, will be assessed by an internal committee. Based on the committee's assessment, selected candidates will be invited to an interview. References will also be obtained for relevant candidates.   Read more about the recruitment process on our website.
The PhD work will primarily be carried out at the University of Stavanger. It is a condition of employment that the successful candidate resides in a location that enables regular presence at and active participation in the academic environment during normal working hours.
The position is advertised in both Norwegian and English. In the event of any discrepancy between the texts, the Norwegian version shall prevail.
UiS - challenge the well-known and explore the unknown
The University of Stavanger (UiS) has about 12,000 students and 2,200 employees. The university has high ambitions. We strive to have an innovative and international profile, and be a driving force in knowledge development and in the process of societal change. Our common direction is driven by consideration for green and sustainable change and equitable social development, through new ways of managing natural r

ap:254437.body:
Om stillingen
Universitetet i Stavanger har ledig stilling som stipendiat i biologisk psykologi ved Det samfunnsvitenskapelige fakultet, Institutt for psykologi. Stillingen er ledig fra 1. desember 2026.
Stipendiatstillingen leder fram til doktorgrad og gir deg mulighet til å utvikle forskningskompetanse i et aktivt og stimulerende fagmiljø. Gjennom doktorgradsutdanningen opparbeider du kunnskap, ferdigheter og erfaring som kvalifiserer for videre karriere innenfor forskning, høyere utdanning og andre kunnskapsintensive sektorer.
Den som ansettes tas opp på doktorgradsprogrammet i samfunnsvitenskap, Forskerskolen i psykologi (PSYENCE). Programmet omfatter en opplæringsdel, arbeid med en vitenskapelig avhandling basert på selvstendig forskning, deltakelse i nasjonale og internasjonale forskermiljø, forskningsformidling, prøveforelesning og disputas. Les mer om forskerutdanningen ved UiS på våre nettsider.
Som stipendiat ved UiS får du støtte til faglig og karrieremessig utvikling gjennom veiledning, kompetanseutvikling og karriereplanlegging.
Stillingen er for tre år med ren forskerutdanning og er knyttet til forskningsgruppen  UiS Biopsychology Research Group .
Forskningstema
Den som ansaettes vil være tilknyttet forskningsprosjektet  PRIME  (Physiological Reactivity in Health and Disease: Mechanisms and Effects) ledes av professor Bianka Karshikoff. PRIME undersøker fysiologisk reaktivitet, kroppens evne til å respondere på stress og immunologiske utfordringer, langs to sammenhengende hovedspor:
Individuelle forskjeller i fysiologisk reaktivitet , og hvordan disse henger sammen med helse og personlighet.
Tidlig kronisk smerte  som en egen og lite studert gruppe, det vil si personer i det første året med vedvarende muskel- og skjelettsmerter.

Prosjektet er tverrfaglig og spenner over psykologi, endokrinologi og immunologi, med bruk av eksperimentelle metoder og fysiologiske biomarkører.
Vi ser etter en kandidat med en genuin interesse for forskningsfeltet eller for én eller flere av studiens komponenter. Innenfor rammene av prosjektet er det også rom for å videreutvikle studien og utforme delstudier med et tydelig eget preg i samarbeid med professor Karshikoff.
En mer detaljert beskrivelse av studien finnes på våre nettsider og i prosjektregisteret.
Prosjektskisse
Som søker skal du utarbeide en foreløpig prosjektskisse, med et samlet omfang på maksimalt 3.000 ord.
I skissen ber vi deg redegjøre for hvordan du kunne tenke deg å videreutvikle studien, for eksempel gjennom en selvstendig problemstilling eller forskningsretning innenfor prosjektets rammer.
Prosjektskissen skal gi et inntrykk av din vitenskapelige tenkning og inngår som en del av vurderingsgrunnlaget. Den endelige retningen for doktorgradsarbeidet utvikles i samarbeid med veilederne og vil avhenge av tilgjengelige ressurser, data og praktisk gjennomførbarhet. I løpet av de tre første månedene av ansettelsesperioden vil prosjektskissen og fremdriftsplanen bli videreutviklet i samarbeid med veilederne og utformes til den endelige planen for ph.d.-prosjektet. Mal for prosjektskisse finner du her.
Kvalifikasjoner
Du må ha en sterk faglig bakgrunn med femårig mastergrad innenfor et fagområde som er relevant for prosjektet (psykologi, nevrovitenskap, biomedisin, kognitiv vitenskap eller beslektede fagområder) eller tilsvarende utdanning som gir grunnlag for å gjennomføre en forskerutdanning, fortrinnsvis av nyere dato.
Karakter på masteroppgaven og veid gjennomsnittskarakter for masterstudiet må begge tilsvare B eller bedre, er du den vi søker etter.
Dersom du har utdanning fra en institusjon med annen karakterskala enn A-F, ber vi deg legge ved dokumentasjon som viser hvordan karakterene kan sammenliknes med den norske karakterskalaen.  Du kan bruke disse konverteringsskalaene til å beregne poengene dine for opptak.
Dersom du fullfører mastergraden høsten 2026, er du også velkommen til å søke.
I vurderingen blir det lagt vekt på at du har potensiale for forskning innenfor fagfeltet og personlige forutsetninger for å fullføre doktorgradsutdanningen innen ansettelsesperioden.
Vi legger vekt på at du:
har høy faglig integritet og fokus på kvalitet i arbeidet
er nysgjerrig og motivert for å gjennomføre forskningsprosjektet og bidra til faglige fellesskap og samarbeid på tvers av fagområde
har dokumentert interesse for biologisk psykologi, psykofysiologi, psykonevroimmunologi, stress- og/eller smerteforskning
har erfaring med kvantitative og statistiske metoder
kan arbeide godt både selvstendig og i samarbeid med andre forskere
har evne til kritisk refleksjon, nytenkning og selvstendig problemløsning, og arbeider strukturert og målrettet
har gode samarbeids- og kommunikasjonsevner og bidrar til et konstruktivt arbeidsmiljø.
har gode ferdigheter i engelsk, både skriftlig og muntlig.

har tidligere erfaring med laboratoriearbeid
kan kommunisere på et skandinavisk språk

forskerutdanning ved et universitet med et viktig samfunnsoppdrag
et ambisiøst og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø
veiledning og støtte til faglig og karrieremessig utvikling
gratis norskkurs dersom du ikke behersker norsk, svensk eller dansk på minimum A2-nivå ved ansettelse
tilgang til Lifekeys , en digital tjeneste for mental helse og livskvalitet
lønn etter Statens lønnsregulativ l.pl 17.515, kode 1017, kr 580 000 bto pr år med lønnsutvikling etter ansiennitet i stillingen. Fra lønnen trekkes lovfestet innskudd til Statens pensjonskasse.
medlemskap i Statens pensjonskasse med gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger

Les mer om ansattgoder og fordeler på uis.no .
Mangfold og inkludering
Mangfold er en styrke ved universitetet. Ulike erfaringer, perspektiver og bakgrunner bidrar til bedre løsninger og et godt arbeids- og læringsmiljø. Vi ønsker søkere med ulike kvalifikasjoner, livserfaringer og perspektiver, og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke, uavhengig av kjønn, alder, funksjonsevne, kulturell bakgrunn eller om du har hatt opphold i arbeidslivet. UiS legger til rette for ansatte i ulike livsfaser og for medarbeidere med behov for individuell tilrettelegging.
I tråd med gjeldende regelverk vil minst én kvalifisert søker med funksjonsnedsettelse, hull i CV-en eller innvandrerbakgrunn bli invitert til intervju. Dersom dette gjelder deg, kan du oppgi det i jobbsøkerportalen. Les mer om ordningen  her .
Universitetet ønsker bedre kjønnsbalanse i stipendiatstillinger innenfor fagområdet og oppfordrer derfor særlig kvinner til å søke. Ved tilnærmet like kvalifikasjoner kan kvinner bli prioritert i samsvar med gjeldende regelverk.
Har du spørsmål?
Ta gjerne kontakt dersom du ønsker å vite mer om stillingen:
Professor Bianka Karshikoff, tlf: 518 314 88, e-post: [email protected]

Har du spørsmål om ansettelsesprosessen, kan du kontakte:
HR-rådgiver Christina Storm, tlf: 518 317 53, e-post: [email protected]

Slik søker du
Søk stillingen ved å klikke på "Søk stillingen" på denne siden.
I Jobbnorge registrerer du søknad, relevant utdanning og arbeidserfaring samt språkferdigheter. I søknaden ber vi deg beskrive dine forskningsinteresser, din motivasjon for stillingen og hvordan din bakgrunn er relevant for forskningsprosjektet.
Følgende dokumentasjon skal lastes opp som vedlegg til søknaden:
prosjektskisse, se mal tilgjengelig på våre nettsider
CV med fullstendig oversikt over utdanning, erfaring og eventuell vitenskapelig virksomhet
vitnemål med karakterutskrift som dokumenterer fullført mastergrad. Dersom du ikke har fullført mastergraden, skal du legge ved oppdatert karakterutskrift.
Diploma Supplement eller tilsvarende dokumentasjon, samt konverteringsskala dersom dette er påkrevd
publikasjoner eller annet relevant forskningsarbeid
attester og annen dokumentasjon som vurderes relevant for søknaden

Dokumentasjonen må foreligge på et skandinavisk språk eller engelsk.
Søknaden vurderes på grunnlag av informasjonen som er registrert i Jobbnorge ved søknadsfristen utløp. Sørg derfor for at søknaden tydelig viser hvordan din kompetanse og erfaring oppfyller kompetansekravene i utlysningen, og at nødvendig dokumentasjon er lastet opp. Dersom vedleggene samlet overskrider 100 MB, må filene komprimeres før opplasting.
UiS behandler bare søknader og vedlegg registrert i Jobbnorge.
Opplysninger om søkere kan bli offentliggjort selv om det er bedt om unntak fra offentlig søkerliste, jf. offentlighetsloven § 25.  Dersom anmodningen ikke tas til følge, vil du bli varslet.
Ansettelsesvilkår og videre prosess
UiS er underlagt sikkerhetsloven, og det forventes at ansatte utviser sikkerhetsbevisst atferd, og følger gjeldende sikkerhets- og eksportkontrollrutiner. Ved ansettelse vil egenskaper som pålitelighet, dømmekraft og lojalitet bli vektlagt.
Ansettelse som stipendiat er regulert i universitets- og høgskoleforskriften kapittel IV . Opptak til doktorgradsutdanningen er regulert i forskrift for graden philosophiae doctor (ph.d.) ved Universitetet i Stavanger.
Dine kvalifikasjoner for stillingen vil bli vurdert av en intern komité på grunnlag av dokumentasjonen registrert i Jobbnorge ved søknadsfristens utløp. På bakgrunn av komiteens vurdering vil aktuelle søkere bli invitert til intervju. Det vil også bli innhentet referanser for aktuelle kandidater. Les mer om ansettelsesprosessen på våre nettsider.
Doktorgradsarbeidet skal i hovedsak gjennomføres ved Universitetet i Stavanger. Det er en forutsetning at den som ansettes bosetter seg slik at vedkommende kan være til stede og tilgjengelig for fagmiljøet i ordinær arbeidstid.
Stillingen er kunngjort på både norsk og engelsk. Ved eventuelle motstridende opplysninger mellom tekstene er det den norske teksten som legges til grunn.
UiS - vil utfordre det velkjente og utforske det ukjente
Universitetet i Stavanger (UiS) har omlag 12.000 studenter og 2.200 ansatte. Universitetet har store ambisjoner. Vi skal ha en innovativ og internasjonal profil og være en drivkraft i kunnskapsutviklingen og endringsprosesser i samfunnet. Vår felles retning skal drives frem av omtanke for grønn og bærekraftig omstilling og rettferdig samfunnsutvikling, gjennom nye måter å forvalte naturressursene på og legge til rette for bedre byer og lokalsamfunn. Energi, helse og velferd, læring for livet er våre satsingsområder.
I samspill og dialog med våre omgivelser regionalt, nasjonalt og internasjonalt har vi et åpent og innovativt klima for utdanning, forskning, kunstnerisk utviklingsarbeid, nyskapning, formidling og museumsvirksomhet. Den faglige virksomheten ved universitetet er organisert i seks fakultet med 13 institutt og to nasjonale forsknings- og kompetansesenter i tillegg til Arkeologisk museum. Vi er medlem i det europeiske nettverket for innovative universitet - European Consortium of Innovative Universities. Universitetet ligger i den mest attraktive regionen i landet med 300.000 innbyggere.  Stavangerregionen har et dynamisk arbeidsmarked og tilbyr en rekke spennende kultur- og fritidsaktiviteter.
Sammen med våre ansatte og studenter vil vi løfte blikket, og våge å tenke stort og nytt – vi vil utfordre det velkjente og utforske det ukjente.
Det er i dag 25 ansatte og rundt 500 studenter tilknyttet instituttet.
Det samfunnsvitenskapelige fakultet har om lag 2.000 studenter og 180 ansatte. Fakultetet tilbyr utdanninger på bachelor-, master- , doktorgradsnivå samt et profesjonsstudium. Studiene bygger på en kombinasjon av teoretisk og praktisk kunnskap, på tverrfaglighet og samarbeid med offentlig og privat virksomhet. Fakultetet består av Institutt for medie- og samfunnsfag, Institutt for psykologi og Institutt for sosialfag.
Institutt for psykologi tilbyr følgende utdanninger: Psykologi: treårig bachelor og toårig master, årsstudium i psykologi, samt profesjonsstudium fra høsten 2026. Instituttet har også forskerskolen PSYENCE som er en forskerskole innen psykologi, som er en del av forskerutdanningen ved Det samfunnsvitenskapelige fakultet.

ap:254440.body:
Join a world-leading research environment at the Chalmers Security and Privacy Lab and help shape the future of web, software, and AI security. As a doctoral student, you will contribute to cutting-edge cybersecurity research while working closely with internationally recognized researchers. This position offers an excellent opportunity to develop as an independent researcher and make an impact on secure and trustworthy digital systems.
Software is often the root cause of vulnerabilities in modern computing systems. We develop principled concepts and mechanisms to ensure robust security and privacy for software. You will be supervised by Prof. Andrei Sabelfeld (Wallenberg Scholar and recipient of awards from ERC, SSF, VR, WASP, Google, Amazon, Facebook, and OpenAI, as well as the Chalmers Doctoral Supervisor of the Year award).
About us
The Department of Computer Science and Engineering , a joint department of Chalmers and the University of Gothenburg, spans the breadth of computing disciplines. Our internationally visible research, strong industry links and diverse environment create a collaborative setting where ideas grow into real impact.
At the division of Computing Science , we advance secure and trustworthy software and systems, spanning foundations, programming languages, tools and practical methods that help shape dependable digital infrastructures.
About the research project
You will contribute to one of our research projects on Web and Emerging Applications Security. Our research tracks include:
• Web application crawling and security scanning ( Black Widow , Black Ostrich , and Spider-Scents )
• Security and privacy of browser extensions ( FakeX and CodeX )
• JavaScript server-side sandboxing ( SandTrap )
• Data minimization in Trigger-Action Platforms ( minTAP and LazyTAP )
• Security and privacy of agentic and AI-integrated systems (ongoing research area)
Promotional video of our research on securing web applications
Who we are looking for
The following requirements are mandatory:
To qualify as a Doctoral student, you must have a Master's degree ( masterexamen ) of 120 credits or a Master’s degree ( magisterexamen ) of 60 credits* in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a closely related field
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
Documented research interest and/or achievements in cybersecurity and/or privacy
Ability to work independently and analytically to solve complex research problems

* for students with an education earned outside of Sweden, a 4-year Bachelor’s degree is accepted.
The following experience will strengthen your application:
A Master's thesis or research-oriented project in language-based security, web security, or systems security
Experience with program analysis, formal methods, or AI/LLM-based systems
Publications, open-source security tools, or participation in security competitions (CTFs) and bug bounty programs

What you will do
Take courses at an advanced level within the Graduate School of Computer Science and Engineering
Develop your own scientific concepts and communicate the results of your research verbally and in writing
The position generally also includes teaching on Chalmers' undergraduate level or performing other duties corresponding to 20 percent of working hours
Conduct research within one of the tracks above
Design, implement, and evaluate security analysis tools and prototypes, such as crawlers, scanners, sandboxes, data minimizers, and extension analyzers
Publish and present results at cybersecurity venues

Contract terms
The Doctoral student positions are fully funded from start.
The position is a fixed-term appointment of four years, with the possibility to teach up to 20%, which extends the position up to five years.
A starting salary of 35,725 SEK per month (valid from May 1, 2026).
Doctoral studies require physical presence throughout the entire study period. A valid residence permit must be presented by the study start date; otherwise the admission may be withdrawn.

What we offer
As a Doctoral student at Chalmers, you are an employee and enjoy all employee benefits. Read more about   working at Chalmers  and our  benefits  for employees.
A dynamic and inspiring working environment in the coastal city of Gothenburg .
Read more about Sweden’s generous parental leave, subsidized day care, free schools, healthcare etc at Move To Gothenburg.

Chalmers is dedicated to improving gender balance and actively works with equality projects, such as the GENIE Initiative for gender equality and excellence . We celebrate diversity and consider equality and inclusion as fundamental aspects of all our activities.
If Swedish is not your native language, Chalmers offers Swedish courses to help you settle in.
Find more general information about doctoral studies at Chalmers here .
Application procedure
The application should be written in English and attached as PDF-files, as below. Maximum size for each file is 40 MB. Please note that the system does not support Zip files.
CV
Personal letter
A brief introduction about yourself and your track record.
A brief motivation as to why you are interested in this position.
A brief description of your future goals and research focus.

Bachelor’s and, if available, master’s thesis together with the transcripts.
Documented evidence of relevant work, if available, such as (links to) research papers, project reports, and software repositories.
Use the button at the foot of the page to reach the application form.
A background check may be conducted as part of the application process.
Please note: The applicant is responsible for ensuring that the application is complete. Incomplete applications and applications sent by email will not be considered. Contact details to references will be requested after the interview.
We welcome your application no later than  November 27, 2026.
For questions, please contact:
Professor Andrei Sabelfeld
[email protected]
We look forward to your application!
*** Chalmers declines to consider all offers of further announcement publishing or other types of support for the recruiting process in connection with this position.  ***
Chalmers University of Technology in Gothenburg conducts research and education in technology and natural sciences at a high international level. The university has 3100 employees and 10,000 students, and offers education in engineering, science, shipping and architecture. With scientific excellence as a basis, Chalmers promotes knowledge and technical solutions for a sustainable world. Through global commitment and entrepreneurship, we foster an innovative spirit, in close collaboration with wider society.
Chalmers was founded in 1829 and has the same motto today as it did then: Avancez – forward.

ap:254441.body:
Materialwissenschaft und Technologie sind unsere Leidenschaft. Mit unserer Spitzenforschung leisten die rund 1'100 Mitarbeitenden der Empa entscheidende Beiträge zum Wohle der Gesellschaft für eine lebenswerte Zukunft. Die Empa ist eine Forschungsinstitution des ETH-Bereichs.
Für unsere Abteilung „ Fügetechnologie und Korrosion “ suchen wir als Verstärkung der Gruppe „Korrosion und Werkstoffintegrität“ eine/n Fachspezialist im Bereich Korrosion und Werkstoffintegrität von metallischen Werkstoffen im Hoch- und Tiefbau.
Fachspezialist/in im Bereich Korrosion und Werkstoffintegrität von metallischen Werkstoffen im Hoch- und Tiefbau (a)
Ihre Aufgaben
Untersuchungs- und Beratungsmandate im Hoch- und Tiefbau mit Schwerpunkt „Korrosion und Werkstoffintegrität von sicherheitsrelevanten metallischen Bauteilen" im Auftrag und in Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Partnern (Ingenieure, Architekten, Fachplaner, Spin-offs und Behörden) in den Bereichen Planung, Realisierung und Erhaltung von Bauwerken
Fachlicher Support des Teams im Bereich der Schadensanalyse und Prüfung von metallischen Werkstoffen im Anlagen- und Maschinenbau sowie industriellen Produkten
Praxisnahe Forschungsprojekte im Bereich neuer metallischer Werkstoffe und Korrosionsschutzsysteme bzw. -konzepte

Nach einer Einarbeitungszeit von ca. 6-12 Monaten (abhängig von den Vorkenntnissen) in unserem 9-köpfigen Team bestehend aus Projektleitern, Technikern und Laboranten sollen Untersuchungs- und Beratungsmandate von der Offerte, der Planung und Durchführung der Untersuchungen bis hin zur Fakturierung als Projektleiter selbstständig bearbeitet werden.

Ihr Profil
Naturwissenschaftliches oder ingenieurtechnisches Hochschulstudium oder Fachhochschulstudium
Erfahrung im Bereich Korrosion und Projektleitung von Vorteil
Bereitschaft für externe Arbeiten/Untersuchungen (Baustelle, Tunnel, Schwimmbäder)
Flair für Teamarbeit und Kommunikation
Interesse an interdisziplinären Fragestellungen im Bereich Chemie, Werkstoffe und Ingenieurwesen
Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Kenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch; Grundkenntnisse in Französisch und/oder Italienisch von Vorteil

Unser Angebot
Wir bieten Ihnen ein vielseitiges und abwechslungsreiches Aufgabengebiet in einem modernen, technischen und innovativen Forschungsumfeld mit internationalem Flair, in dem Sie Ihre beruflichen Fähigkeiten weiterentwickeln können. Für weitere Auskünfte wenden Sie sich bitte an Lars Jeurgens , Abteilungsleiter, oder Ulrik Hans , Gruppenleiter.
«a» steht in unseren Stelleninseraten für «alle». Wir leben eine Kultur der Inklusion und des Respekts. Bei uns sind alle Menschen willkommen, die Lust auf innovative, nachhaltige und sinnstiftende Tätigkeiten haben. Unser Commitment ist in unserem Diversity Aktionsplan verankert und umfasst konkrete Ziele und Massnahmen, die wir kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln und umsetzen.
Nicht ganz alle Anforderungen erfüllt? Uns ist bewusst, dass sich insbesondere Frauen und Personen, die einer Minderheit angehören, oft erst bewerben, wenn sie das Anforderungsprofil nahezu vollständig erfüllen. Für uns zählen jedoch auch Motivation, Engagement und Lernbereitschaft. Wenn Sie sich in der Stelle wiedererkennen, freuen wir uns auf Ihre qualifizierte Bewerbung, auch wenn Sie die Anforderungen nicht zu 100% erfüllen.
Wir freuen uns auf Ihre vollständige Online-Bewerbung inkl. Motivationsschreiben, Lebenslauf, Zeugnisse, Diplome und Kontaktdaten von zwei Referenzpersonen. Bitte reichen Sie diese ausschliesslich über unser Bewerbungsportal ein. Bewerbungen per E-Mail sowie auf dem Postweg werden nicht berücksichtigt.

ap:254442.body:
Do you want to contribute to top quality medical research?
To be a doctoral student means to devote oneself to a research project under supervision of experienced researchers and following an individual study plan. For a doctoral degree, the equivalent of four years of full-time doctoral education is required.
The research group
The project is based within the research team of Maarten van de Klundert, which is part of senior professor Anders Sönnerborgs activities at the department of Medicine, Huddinge, Centrum of Infectious Medicine – Clinical Infectious Disease. The team has a strong research focus on HIV-1.
The PhD position is based at ANA Futura Laboratory, Campus Flemingsberg, a modern and international research environment with access to advanced infrastructure and opportunities for interdisciplinary collaboration.  The position will be closely integrated with the clinical microbiology laboratory at Karolinska University Laboratory, the National Reference Laboratory for HIV-1 and Retroviruses.
You will work in a collaborative environment involving researchers with complementary expertise in molecular virology, HIV-1 immunology, and bioinformatics.
The doctoral student project and the duties of the doctoral student
The PhD position is part of the national Graduate School: Biomedical Laboratory Scientists for Excellence – Future Educators in Health and Medical Care, (BioLabX). Therefore, only graduated Biomedical laboratory scientists are eligible to apply for the position
In this doctoral project, you will investigate the HIV-1 reservoir in clinical samples from people living with HIV-1. It is closely connected to an ongoing clinical cohort at Department of Infectious Diseases, Karolinska University Hospital, and combines established clinical sampling with molecular and bioinformatic analyses of HIV-1 proviruses.
You will establish and optimise workflows for the analysis of HIV-1 proviral DNA to characterise HIV-1 proviral sequences with respect to genetic diversity, viral subtype, drug-resistance mutations, hypermutation, and other sequence features. For data analysis, you will use advanced bioinformatics and phylogenetic analysis. You will also be involved in biobanking of all incoming samples, and later characterise immunological characteristics of selected study participants, for instance by FACS analysis, ELIspot assays, assessing HIV reactivation and more.
In addition to mandatory courses specific to the PhD education at Karolinska Institutet, the BioLabX program includes a shared course package consisting of two subject-specific doctoral courses. The program also comprises a seminar series, workshops, and annual retreats that are mandatory for the doctoral students.
What do we offer?
A creative and inspiring environment full of expertise and curiosity. Karolinska Institutet is one of the world's leading medical universities. Our vision is to pursue the development of knowledge about life and to promote a better health for all. At Karolinska Institutet, we conduct successful medical research and hold the largest range of medical education in Sweden. As a doctoral student you are offered an individual research project, a well-educated supervisor, a vast range of elective courses and the opportunity to work in a leading research group. Karolinska Institutet collaborates with prominent universities from all around the world, which ensures opportunities for international exchanges. You will be employed on a doctoral studentship which means that you receive a contractual salary. Employees also have access to our modern gym for free and receive reimbursements for medical care.
Eligibility requirements for doctoral education
In order to participate in the selection for a doctoral position, you must meet the following general (A) and specific (B) eligibility requirements at latest by the application deadline.
It is your responsibility to certify eligibility by following the instructions on the web page Entry requirements (eligibility) for doctoral education.

A) General eligibility requirement

You meet the general eligibility requirement for doctoral/third-cycle/PhD education if you:
have been awarded a second-cycle/advanced/master qualification (i.e. master degree), or
have satisfied the requirements for courses comprising at least 240 credits of which at least 60 credits were awarded in the advanced/second-cycle/master level, or
have acquired substantially equivalent knowledge in some other way in Sweden or abroad.*

Follow the instructions on the web page Entry requirements (eligibility) for doctoral education.
*If you claim equivalent knowledge, follow the instructions on the web page Assessing equivalent knowledge for general eligibility for doctoral education.

B) Specific eligibility requirement
You meet the specific eligibility requirement for doctoral/third-cycle/PhD education if you:
- Show proficiency in English equivalent to the course English B/English 6 at Swedish upper secondary school.
Follow the instructions on the web page English language requirements for doctoral education.
Verification of your documents Karolinska Institutet checks the authenticity of your documents. Karolinska Institutet reserves the right to revoke admission if supporting documents are discovered to be fraudulent. Submission of false documents is a violation of Swedish law and is considered grounds for legal action.
(A) and (B) can only be certified by the documentation requirement for doctoral education .
Skills and personal qualities
The successful candidate is required to have:
A strong interest in HIV research, molecular virology and translational biomedical research.
Good analytical skills and an ability to interpret experimental and quantitative data.
Excellent ability to speak, read and write in English.
A degree in Biomedical Laboratory Science or an equivalent degree

The following qualifications are desirable:
Experience of experimental laboratory work in molecular biology, microbiology, virology or a related field.
Experience with DNA and RNA sequencing, especially NGS and phylogeny.
Basic programming and/or bioinformatic experience, for example in R, Python or related tools, and working in linux environments.
Experience working with immunological methods and assays, such as PBMC isolation, FACS, ELIspot, intracellular cytokine staining (ICS) etc.

It is considered an advantage to have some knowledge of Swedish. Particular emphasis will be placed on the applicant's motivation for doctoral studies, scientific curiosity and analytical ability.
Terms and conditions
The doctoral student will be employed on a doctoral studentship maximum 4 years full-time.

Application process
Submit your application and supporting documents through the Varbi recruitment system. Use the button in the top right corner and follow the instructions. We prefer that your application is written in English, but you can also apply in Swedish.
Your application must contain the following documents:
- A personal letter and a curriculum vitae
- Degree projects and previous publications, if any
- Any other documentation showing the desirable skills and personal qualities described above
- Documents certifying your general eligibility (see A above)
- Documents certifying your specific eligibility (see B above)
Selection
A selection will be made among eligible applicants on the basis of the ability to benefit from doctoral education. The qualifications of the applicants will be evaluated on an overall basis.
Karolinska Institutet uses the following bases of assessment:
- Documented subject knowledge of relevance to the area of research
- Analytical skill
- Other documented knowledge or experience that may be relevant to doctoral studies in the subject.
All applicants will be informed when the recruitment is completed.

ap:254443.body:
Vill du bidra till medicinsk forskning av toppkvalitet?
Att vara doktorand innebär att vara antagen till en utbildning på forskarnivå (forskarutbildning) där man följer en individuell studieplan. En doktorand ägnar sig åt ett forskningsprojekt under handledning, kompletterat med kurser och andra lärandeaktiviteter. För en doktorsexamen krävs motsvarande fyra års utbildning på forskarnivå på heltid.
Forskargruppen
Projektet är förlagt till Maarten van de Klunderts forskarteam, som ingår i senior professor Anders Sönnerborgs verksamhet vid Institutionen för medicin, Huddinge, Centrum för infektionsmedicin – Kliniska infektionssjukdomar. Forskargruppen har ett starkt forskningsfokus på HIV-1.
Doktorandanställningen är placerad vid ANA Futura, Campus Flemingsberg, en modern och internationell forskningsmiljö med tillgång till avancerad infrastruktur och möjligheter till tvärvetenskapligt samarbete. Anställningen kommer att vara nära integrerad med det kliniskt mikrobiologiska laboratoriet vid Karolinska Universitetslaboratoriet, som är nationellt referenslaboratorium för HIV-1 och retrovirus.
Du kommer att arbeta i en forskningsmiljö som präglas av nära samarbete mellan forskare med kompletterande expertis inom molekylär virologi, HIV-1-immunologi och bioinformatik.
Doktorandprojektet och doktorandens uppgifter
Doktorandanställningen är en del av den nationella forskarskolan Biomedical Laboratory Scientists for Excellence – Future Educators in Health and Medical Care (BioLabX). Därför är endast sökande med examen som biomedicinsk analytiker behöriga att söka anställningen.
I detta doktorandprojekt kommer du att undersöka HIV-1-reservoaren i kliniska prover från personer som lever med HIV-1. Projektet är nära kopplat till en pågående klinisk kohort vid Infektionskliniken, Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset, och kombinerar etablerad klinisk provtagning med molekylära och bioinformatiska analyser av HIV-1-provirus.

Du kommer att etablera och optimera arbetsflöden för analys av HIV-1-proviralt DNA för att karakterisera HIV-1-provirala sekvenser med avseende på genetisk variation, viral subtyp, läkemedelsresistensmutationer, hypermutation och andra sekvensegenskaper. För dataanalysen kommer du att använda avancerad bioinformatik och fylogenetisk analys. Du kommer även att medverka i biobankning av samtliga inkommande prover och senare karakterisera immunologiska egenskaper hos utvalda studiedeltagare, exempelvis genom FACS-analys, ELISpot-analyser, analys av HIV-reaktivering och andra metoder.
Utöver de obligatoriska kurser som ingår i forskarutbildningen vid Karolinska Institutet omfattar BioLabX-programmet ett gemensamt kurspaket bestående av två ämnesspecifika kurser på forskarnivå. Programmet omfattar även en seminarieserie, workshoppar och årliga internat, vilka är obligatoriska för doktoranderna
Vad erbjuder vi?
En kreativ, internationell och inspirerande miljö fylld av kompetens och nyfikenhet. Karolinska Institutet är ett av världens ledande medicinska universitet. Här bedriver vi framgångsrik medicinsk forskning och har det största utbudet av medicinska utbildningar i Sverige. På KI får du träffa forskare med olika forskningsinriktningar som jobbar tillsammans. Det är det gränsöverskridande samarbetet som bidrar till KI:s världsledande position inom forskning. Som doktorand erbjuds du ett individuellt forskningsprojekt, en välutbildad handledare, ett stort utbud av valbara kurser och möjligheten att arbeta i en framgångsrik forskargrupp. Karolinska Institutet har samarbeten med framstående universitet över hela världen, vilket ger möjlighet till internationella utbyten. Som anställd doktorand får du en avtalsenlig lön, du får träna fritt i våra moderna friskvårdsanläggningar och du får ersättning för läkarvård.
Behörighetskrav för utbildning på forskarnivå
För att delta i urvalet till en doktorandplats måste du styrka både det grundläggande (A) och det särskilda (B) behörighetskravet innan ansökningsperioden stänger.
Det är ditt ansvar som sökande att styrka din behörighet genom att följa instruktionerna på webbsidan Behörighet till utbildning på forskarnivå.
A) Grundläggande behörighetskrav
Du uppfyller det grundläggande behörighetskravet för utbildning på forskarnivå om du:
har avlagt en examen på avancerad nivå (magister- eller masterexamen), eller
har fullgjort kursfordringar om minst 240 högskolepoäng, varav minst 60 högskolepoäng på avancerad nivå,  eller
har på annat sätt förvärvat i huvudsak motsvarande kunskaper.*

Följ instruktionerna på webbsidan  Behörighet till utbildning på forskarnivå .
*Om du anser dig ha motsvarande kunskaper ska du följa instruktionerna på webbsidan Bedömning av motsvarande kunskaper för grundläggande behörighet till utbildning på forskarnivå.
B) Särskilt behörighetskrav
Du uppfyller det särskilda behörighetskravet för utbildning på forskarnivå om du:
- Intygar kunskaper i engelska (motsvarande Engelska B/Engelska 6 vid gymnasiet med godkänt betyg).
Följ instruktionerna på webbsidan  English language requirements for doctoral education.
Kontroll av dokument Karolinska Institutet gör kontroll av dokumenten för att upptäcka förfalskningar. Karolinska Institutet förbehåller sig rätten att återkalla antagningsbeslut om förfalskningar eller oriktigheter påvisas. Inlämnande av falska handlingar är ett brott mot svensk lag och anses vara grund för rättsliga åtgärder.
Färdigheter och personliga egenskaper
Den sökande ska ha:
Ett stort intresse för HIV-forskning, molekylär virologi och translationell biomedicinsk forskning.
God analytisk förmåga och förmåga att tolka experimentella och kvantitativa data.
Mycket god förmåga att tala, läsa och skriva på engelska.
Biomedicinsk analytikerexamen (BMA-examen)

Följande kvalifikationer är meriterande:
Erfarenhet av experimentellt laboratoriearbete inom molekylärbiologi, mikrobiologi, virologi eller närliggande område.
Erfarenhet av DNA- och RNA-sekvensering, särskilt NGS (Next Generation Sequencing) och fylogenetisk analys.
Grundläggande erfarenhet av programmering och/eller bioinformatik, exempelvis i R, Python eller liknande verktyg, samt arbete i Linux-miljö.
Erfarenhet av immunologiska metoder och analyser, såsom isolering av PBMC, FACS, ELISpot, intracellulär cytokinfärgning (ICS) eller liknande.

Vissa kunskaper i svenska är meriterande. Särskild vikt kommer att läggas vid den sökandes motivation för forskarutbildning, vetenskapliga nyfikenhet och analytiska förmåga. Villkor
Doktorandplatsen innebär en anställning som doktorand under maximalt 4 år på heltid.

Ansökan
Du söker doktorandplatsen i rekryteringsverktyget Varbi. Använd knappen uppe till höger och följ anvisningarna. Vi ser gärna att din ansökan är skriven på engelska, men det går också bra att ansöka på svenska.
Din ansökan ska innehålla dessa dokument:
- Ett personligt brev och curriculum vitae
- Eventuella examensarbeten och publikationer
- Andra dokument som styrker de ovan efterfrågade färdigheter och egenskaper
- Dokument som styrker det grundläggande behörighetskravet (se A ovan)
- Dokument som styrker det särskilda behörighetskravet (se B ovan)
Urval
Urval bland behöriga sökande görs med hänsyn till deras förmåga att tillgodogöra sig forskarutbildning. En samlad bedömning av de sökandes meriter och lämplighet kommer att göras.
Följande bedömningsgrunder tillämpas vid Karolinska Institutet:
- Dokumenterade ämneskunskaper av betydelse för forskningsområdet
- Analytisk skicklighet
- Övriga dokumenterade kunskaper/erfarenheter som kan ha betydelse för aktuell forskarutbildning
Alla sökanden kommer att få information när rekryteringen är slutförd.

KI tillämpar en lönestege vid lönesättning av doktorander.

ap:254444.body:
Bepaal mee de toekomst – Universiteit Antwerpen
De Universiteit Antwerpen zoekt een gemotiveerde doctoraal onderzoeker om mee te werken aan het Europese Driving Urban Transitions-onderzoeksproject TOILED (Towards More Resilient Urban Infrastructures through Toilet-Led Research and Policy on Provisioning, Accessibility and Maintenance of Public Toilets). Het project wordt gecoördineerd door dr. Rianne van Melik van de Radboud Universiteit en brengt onderzoekers en stedelijke partners uit Nederland , België en Turkije samen. De projectresultaten omvatten wetenschappelijke artikels, stadsrapporten, beleidsnota’s en een Toiletmanifest. Help mee kennis te ontwikkelen over de rol van openbare toiletten in veerkrachtige en toegankelijke stedelijke infrastructuren.
Openbare toiletten zijn essentiële, maar vaak onderbelichte stedelijke infrastructuren. Ze bepalen mee wie toegang heeft tot en kan deelnemen aan het stedelijke leven, in het bijzonder ouderen, mensen die dak- of thuisloos zijn, personen met een beperking en mensen met spijsverteringsaandoeningen. TOILED onderzoekt hoe veerkrachtigere, inclusievere en rechtvaardigere steden kunnen worden gerealiseerd via een beter bestuur van openbare toiletten. Het project bestudeert drie onderling samenhangende thema’s: de voorziening, de sociaal-ruimtelijke toegankelijkheid en het onderhoud van openbare toiletten in Rotterdam (Nederland), Gent (België) en Ankara (Turkije).
Functie
Je werkt actief aan de voorbereiding en verdediging van een doctoraal proefschrift in het domein van de stadsociologie. Dit doctoraatsonderzoek wordt uitgevoerd binnen het TOILED-project (zie boven) en vanuit het Centre for Research on Environmental and Social Change , Departement Sociologie en het Antwerp Urban Studies Institute (UAntwerpen) met Prof. Stijn Oosterlynck en Dr. Francesco Campagnari als promotoren.
Het project gebruikt een kwalitatieve en interdisciplinaire onderzoeksaanpak, waaronder beleids- en institutionele analyses, cartografische analyses, etnografische observaties en interviews met beleidsmakers, aanbieders van openbare toiletten, onderhoudsmedewerkers, belangenorganisaties en groepen die in het bijzonder afhankelijk zijn van openbare toiletten. Jij bent verantwoordelijk voor het uitvoeren van het onderzoek in Gent.
Je stelt een onderzoeksplan en bijhorende onderzoeksmethoden op in samenspraak met je promotor(en), de andere leden van het onderzoeksconsortium en je onderneemt de nodige administratieve stappen voor een vlot doctoraatsproces.
Je voert het onderzoek efficiënt en naar gepaste standaard uit en dingt mee naar financiering voor algemene of specifieke kosten.
Je rapporteert de voortgang aan je promotor(en), commissies en de andere leden van het onderzoeksconsortium en presenteert je onderzoek op wetenschappelijke congressen.
Je verdedigt je proefschrift openbaar en streeft naar publicatie in wetenschappelijke tijdschriften.
Je neemt deel aan consortiumvergaderingen, workshops en veldwerkactiviteiten met partners in België, Nederland en Turkije.
Je levert een ondersteunende, wetenschappelijke bijdrage aan bestaande onderzoeksprojecten of onderzoekslijnen, buiten het eigen doctoraatsonderzoek. Naast de affiliatie met CRESC, ben je ook verbonden met het Antwerp Urban Studies Institute.

Profiel
Master in de Sociologie, Menselijke Geografie, Antropologie, Bestuurskunde, Sociaal Werk, Ruimtelijke Planning of een verwante sociaalwetenschappelijke disciplines.
Sterke interesse in en aantoonbare affiniteit met de stadstudies
Kennis van kwalitatieve onderzoeksmethoden, waaronder interviews, etnografische observaties en beleidsanalyse.
Een sterke interesse om zowel fundamenteel als beleidsgericht wetenschappelijk onderzoek te combineren binnen een doctoraatstraject.
Vermogen om zelfstandig veldwerk uit te voeren en tegelijk constructief samen te werken in een interdisciplinair onderzoeksteam. CRESC hecht veel belang aan een sterke en ondersteunende onderzoeksgroepwerking. Daarom verwachten we een regelmatige aanwezigheid op de stadscampus. Thuiswerk is mogelijk tot maximaal twee dagen per week.
Een scherp analytisch vermogen, een sociale ingesteldheid en de juiste skills en competenties om tot waardevolle resultaten te komen.
Een uitstekende beheersing van het Nederlands en het Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk (C2).

Aanbod
Wij bieden een voltijdse aanstelling als doctoraatsbursaal aan het onderzoekscentrum CRESC in het departement Sociologie van de Universiteit UAntwerpen, bestaande uit een initiële periode van 12 maanden, die na een positieve evaluatie wordt verlengd tot een maximale totale duur van 36 maanden.
De aanstelling start op 1 januari 2027 of zo spoedig mogelijk nadien.
We bieden de mogelijkheid om binnen het kader van je werkzaamheden deel te nemen aan wetenschappelijke activiteiten alsook de mogelijkheid om je verder te ontwikkelen via vorming en opleiding.
Je maandelijkse beurs wordt berekend volgens de beursbedragen voor doctoraatsbursalen in de barema’s voor het Bijzonder Academisch Personeel. Je krijgt ecocheques, internet-connectiviteitsvergoeding en een fietsvergoeding of volledige terugbetaling van je woon-werkverkeer met het openbaar vervoer.
Je krijgt als doctoraatsonderzoeker toegang tot een breed en gevarieerd opleidingsaanbod en opleidingskrediet via de Antwerp Doctoral School .
Lees hier meer over werken bij de Universiteit Antwerpen.

Solliciteren?
Je kan tot en met 25 november 2026 voor deze vacature solliciteren via het online sollicitatieplatform van de Universiteit Antwerpen. Klik op de knop ‘Solliciteren’ en vervolledig het online sollicitatieformulier. Voeg een motivatiebrief  en een pdf van de masterscriptie en/of een ander relevant Nederlandstalig en Engelstalig schrijfvoorbeeld.
Kandidaten die op de shortlist staan, zullen worden uitgenodigd voor een interview op 3 december 2026. Interviews zullen doorgaan in het Engels.
Bij vragen over het online sollicitatieformulier kan je de Frequently Asked Questions raadplegen of mailen naar [email protected] . Bij inhoudelijke vragen over de functie kan je contact opnemen met Stijn Oosterlynck ( [email protected] )

De Europese Commissie bekroonde het HR-beleid van de Universiteit Antwerpen met de ‘ HR Excellence in Research Award ’. We zijn een duurzame, gezinsvriendelijke organisatie die maximaal in de groei van medewerkers investeert. We stimuleren diversiteit  en hechten veel belang aan een inclusieve werkomgeving met gelijke kansen - ongeacht gender, functiebeperking, afkomst, levensbeschouwing, seksuele oriëntatie of leeftijd. Wij moedigen mensen met een diverse achtergrond en diverse eigenschappen aan om te so

ap:254447.body:
The University of Oulu is a multidisciplinary, international research university, with about 4000 employees who produce new knowledge based on high-standards research and provide research based education to build a more sustainable, smarter, and more humane world. The University of Oulu community has about 19,000 people in total. Our northern scientific community operates globally and creates conditions for the emergence of innovations. The University of Oulu is ranked in the top 3% of the world’s universities. All our research, education, and community activities are guided by our university’s values and ethical principles.
We are now looking for
a Doctoral Researcher in Anthropology
to join the Department of Cultural Anthropology, located within the Faculty of Humanities. This position is one of four Oulu-based doctoral researcher positions working on MITIME (“Entanglements of Migration and Time in Post-industrial Urban Europe”). MITIME is an EU-funded (MSCA-DN) doctoral programme focusing on temporal dimensions of migration, inequality, and urban life in post-industrial Europe. It offers international, interdisciplinary, and intersectoral training to 15 recruited doctoral researchers across seven partnered European universities. For more information on MITIME, click here .
About the job
As a doctoral researcher on MITIME, you will conduct original, interdisciplinary research at the intersection of migration, temporality, and labour, leading to a PhD thesis in Cultural Anthropology.
The provisional title of this project is ‘Imagining and Representing Urban Pasts and Futures.’ The project explores how histories and legacies of industrialisation and de-industrialisation, alongside past and present labour migration, shape experiences and imaginaries of post-industrial urban landscapes in Europe. Focusing on a post-industrial setting in Finland and/or Germany, the research will examine how industrial change and shifting urban labour markets shape migrants’ experiences of settlement, belonging, and home-making, as well as processes of urban redevelopment and place-branding.
Possible research directions might include, for example, how histories of labour and migration intersect with urban development; how migrants build relationships with local communities and urban labour markets over time; how different understandings of belonging, mobility and temporality shape visions about urban futures; and how municipal and regional actors seek to attract and retain newcomers. Projects may also explore different perspectives and knowledge systems (including Indigenous, translocal, and gender-diverse approaches).
The doctoral project is expected to combine multimodal ethnography (such as interviews, participant observation, and arts-based methods) with critical discourse analysis (of materials such as policy documents and branding initiatives). As part of the MITIME Doctoral Network, you will undertake two secondments. At the City of Oulu, you will investigate policies and initiatives relating to labour migration, urban development, and sustainability; at Ruhr University Bochum, you will work with your co-supervisor on policy analysis and mobile methods for documenting the social geographies of migration, labour, and societal change.
Fieldwork is expected to focus primarily on Oulu, Finland, and/or Bochum, Germany. However, applicants may propose alternative case-study locations where they can clearly demonstrate their relevance to the project’s research objectives.
The project will be supervised by Prof. Roger Norum (University of Oulu) and Dr. Katrin Menke (Ruhr University Bochum, Germany).
What we offer
Work that matters and a workplace that promotes flexibility and work-life balance. Read more about working with us.
Finland is one of the most livable countries in the world, with a high quality of life, safety, and an excellent education system. Read more about living in Oulu .
Our  Buddy Programme and  Spouse Network support you and your family in settling into Oulu.
Wellness benefit ePassi covering sport, culture, and well-being. Read more about other staff benefits here.
We have an HR Excellence in Research -quality label, which is a recognition awarded by the European Commission for the development of researchers’ working conditions and careers.

Programme benefits
A prestigious Marie-Curie position within a dynamic network of universities and societal partners in migration and urban studies.
A comprehensive training programme combining courses in theory and method, with transferable skills.
Joint supervision by leading academic experts with interdisciplinary guidance and intellectual support.
International and intersectoral secondments with non-academic and institutional partners across Europe.
Strong career-development opportunities across academic, public, and private sectors.
Structured mentoring, leadership training, and professional development.
A competitive MSCA salary with mobility and family allowances, and, where applicable, special-needs support.

Who are you?
We welcome applications from highly motivated candidates with a demonstrated capacity for independent and collaborative research and a strong interest in the interdisciplinary study of migration, temporality, and urban inequality.
In order to succeed and most benefit from the position, you are expected to demonstrate the following:
A strong commitment to conducting interdisciplinary and collaborative research in international and cross-sectoral contexts.
The ability to take initiative, manage research tasks responsibly, and work both independently and as part of a team.
The capacity to design and complete a doctoral research project within the framework and timeline of the assigned project description, leading to the submission of a PhD thesis and other academic outputs.
Willingness to contribute to MITIME’s collective research, training, and dissemination activities, including workshops, summer schools, and other network events.
The capacity to play an active role in conceptualizing, developing, and executing core MITIME project outputs, e.g. scientific articles, reports, conferences.
Prior experience with the theoretical and methodological dimensions of qualitative research.
Academic or professional experience relevant to the thematic focus of MITIME.
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, attention to detail, and the ability to deliver high-quality written and oral outputs.
Demonstrated academic writing experience in the social sciences or humanities.
Excellent English-language communication skills, both written and spoken.
Willingness and readiness for international mobility, including research secondments, training events, and conference participation.

We also require that you:
Hold a relevant Master’s degree in anthropology, geography, sociology, or another relevant social science or humanities discipline, completed and formally awarded before the start of the contract.
Have not previously completed or defended a PhD.
Have not lived or carried out your main work or studies in Finland for more than 12 months during the 36 months before the position begins (in accordance with Marie Skłodowska-Curie Doctoral Network regulations). There are a few exceptions, such as compulsory national service, short visits (e.g., holidays), or time spent in processes related to obtaining refugee status under the Geneva Convention.
See also the requirements of  the University of Oulu Graduate School (UniOGS).

We also appreciate:
A record of scholarly publications (where available).

Salary
The position is fixed-term for 36 months beginning on 1.2.2027.
The successful candidate will receive a competitive salary in accordance with the MSCA regulations for Doctoral Candidates. The positions offer support provided in the form of:
Competitive gross salary (living allowance): €3696,72 per month*
Mobility allowance : €554,69 per month
Family allowance, if applicable : € 515,63 per month

* To allow for the difference in cost of living in different EU Member States, the base gross salary of €4010 has been adjusted through the application of a correction coefficient based on the country where the position is based . This means that your final gross salary may be more or less than this amount. The coefficients applied can be found on p.156-157 of Annex II Horizon Europe Work Programme 2023-2024 - 2. Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions . The gross salary is subject to all compulsory deductions under national legislation of the country of the recruiting institution, such as social security contributions and/or taxes.
A trial period of 6 months is applied to the position.
How to apply?
Please apply by Friday, 27 November 2026  (23:59 Finnish local time) through our recruitment system.
The application should be written in English and the requested documents must include the following:
Motivation Letter  (maximum 1 page): Introduce yourself and your qualifications, outline your motivation for applying to the position, and describe your future career objectives.
Curriculum Vitae (CV): I nclude details of educational qualifications, grades achieved in relevant research modules or dissertations, and any other pertinent academic or professional experience. You may (but are not required to) follow the TENK template for researcher CVs .
Research Proposal (3-6 pages long + abstract, font size 12pt), written in English. Please ensure that your proposed research aligns closely with the focus of the PhD project, ‘Imagining and Representing Urban Pasts and Futures’. General guidelines for preparing a research plan can be found here .
Degree Certificates:  Submit copies of Bachelor’s and Master’s diplomas or proof of degree completion. If you are currently enrolled in a Master’s programme, include available transcripts and a statement from your supervisor confirming that you are on track to complete your degree by the commencement of the contract.
Official Transcripts:  Provide final grade transcripts for both Bachelor’s and Master’s degrees. If transcripts are not in English, include an official translation.
Proof of English Language Competence:  Submit documentation of English proficiency (e.g., TOEFL, IELTS). Candidates whose first language is English, or who have previously studied in English, should provide a brief justification requesting exemption from this requirement.

The eligible applicants who best fit the profile expected for the position will be invited to an interview. Additional documentation might be requested from candidates to be interviewed. The position is anticipated to begin in February 2027.
We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, such as people of different ages, different genders, and members of different linguistic, cultural, or minority groups.
Contact Information
You can find more information regarding the programme here .
If you have any further questions about this position or about the MITIME programme, please contact the primary supervisor Prof. Roger Norum ( [email protected] ).
