Référence : 2027/A025
Date limite du dépôt des candidatures :  01/02/2027 à midi
Date d’entrée en fonction prévue le : 01/10/2027
Descriptif du poste
La filière d’enseignement en Tourisme du Département des Géosciences, Environnement et Société de la Faculté des Sciences de l’ULB ouvre un poste académique temps plein sous la forme d’une chaire intitulée « Régulations, tourisme et société ». Le poste conduit à une nomination à titre définitif à condition de satisfaire à une évaluation de ses activités d’enseignement et de recherche, 3 ans après sa prise de fonction.
La chaire « Régulations, tourisme et société » s’insère dans les activités de recherche du Brussels Centre for Tourism Studies, spécialisé dans l’étude des problématiques liées au tourisme en tant que fait social et ensemble d’activités économiques . Le BCTS réunit plusieurs chercheur.es et académiques qui abordent le tourisme selon des approches mono-, pluri- ou interdisciplinaires, appliquées ou fondamentales. Ses préoccupations de recherche portent sur une diversité de pratiques, d’acteurs et d’espaces touristiques. Issu de l’Institut de Gestion de l’Environnement et d’Aménagement du Territoire (IGEAT), il s’est depuis peu associé à quatre autres entités de recherche, pour former le hub USET, avec pour ambition de tisser des synergies de recherche sur les questions des transformations socio-environnementales en milieux urbains.
Tant l’offre de la filière d’enseignement que la recherche au BCTS ont ces cinq dernières années suivi une orientation plus prononcée sur les dynamiques de transformations et d’adaptation des systèmes touristiques face aux enjeux sociaux et écologiques se posant avec acuité aux sociétés contemporaines. Pour en savoir davantage sur le BTCS et l’offre d’enseignement, vous pouvez consulter le site web :  https://bcts.sciences.ulb.be .
C’est dans ce cadre que la ou le titulaire de la chaire développera un axe de recherche et un enseignement, consacré aux régulations dans les systèmes touristiques, un champ d’investigation qui n’est pas encore abordé au sein du BCTS.
Description de la chaire « Régulations, Tourisme et Société »
Domaine de recherche  :
Si vous êtes recruté.e, il sera attendu de vous que vous développiez une recherche empirique investiguant en profondeur les modes/formes de régulation de systèmes touristiques, les processus et dynamiques qui les sous-tendent et leurs évolutions récentes et à venir. La notion de « régulation », déclinée ici au pluriel, est entendue de manière large. Elle renvoie à l’ajustement, en fonction de règles ou normes préalablement définies, d’une pluralité de mouvements, d’actes et de leurs effets ou produits dans les systèmes touristiques. A ce titre, elle englobe les modes de gouvernance (i.e., systèmes décisionnels), mais aussi tous les dispositifs visant à influencer les systèmes touristiques.
Dans cette optique, vous vous intéresserez à la manière dont les acteurs du tourisme prennent en compte et tentent d’agir sur des trajectoires sociotechniques actuelles et futures. Parmi ces trajectoires, l’on peut citer, par exemple mais sans être exhaustif, la financiarisation du tourisme, la digitalisation et IA-tisation, la dés- et ré-intermédiation, l’individualisation, la croissance forte des mobilités. Il sera, enfin, attendu de vous que vous vous intéressiez à l’articulation entre les modes/formes de régulations que vous étudiez et les enjeux sociaux et/ou écologiques auxquels les sociétés contemporaines sont confrontées.
Pour étudier ces régulations, vous devrez nécessairement témoigner de compétences solides en méthodologie de recherche.
Objectifs pédagogiques et scientifiques :
En matière de recherche, il sera attendu de vous que vous conceviez, pilotiez et/ou contribuiez à des projets de recherche dans le domaine de la chaire (cf. ci-dessus). Dans ce cadre, vous vous attèlerez, entre autres, à nouer des synergies de recherche à l’échelle du département, de USET, de l’ULB et à l’international. Vous vous inscrirez dans une stratégie de diffusion de votre recherche alliant communication scientifique et vulgarisation. Vous vous impliquerez également dans la direction, l’accompagnement et/ou l’évaluation de thèses de doctorat.
En matière d’enseignement, vous contribuerez de manière active et créative au programme du Master en sciences et gestion du tourisme (120 ECTS) ainsi qu’au programme de cours complémentaires y liés. Les pédagogies actives sont privilégiées dans le cadre du master. Cette contribution correspondra à terme à une charge d’enseignement de 120 heures minimum (cf. ci-dessous pour un aperçu des cours associés à cette charge au moment du recrutement). Outre cette charge, vous dirigerez des mémoires du Master en sciences et gestion du tourisme, et interviendrez comme lecteur ou lectrice d’autres mémoires. Il sera également attendu de vous que vous participiez pleinement à d’autres initiatives reliées au Master en sciences et gestion du tourisme, que ce soit en vue d’en faire évoluer le contenu programmatique ou les approches pédagogiques ou de renforcer les liens avec son réseau de partenaires professionnels, académiques et alumni.
Dans un futur relativement proche, il sera attendu de vous que vous vous investissiez dans un ou plusieurs rôles auprès de la communauté scientifique dans son ensemble et de l’ULB. L’on peut citer entre autres les rôles suivants :
l’évaluation d’articles scientifiques proposés pour publication dans diverses revues scientifiques ;
l’organisation de conférences scientifiques ;
la coordination de la qualité d’enseignement et du programme du Master en sciences et gestion du tourisme ;
le pilotage du BCTS ou de la filière d’enseignement « tourisme »
la participation active au sein du Conseil du DGES, par exemple en tant que secrétaire (rédaction de comptes rendus de réunions).

Dans un futur plus lointain, ces rôles pourront s’étendre pour inclure la vice-présidence et la présidence du DGES, la participation à des groupes de travail ou à des commissions facultaires ou universitaires, etc.
Cours repris dans la charge au moment du recrutement :
TOUR-F-433 Tourisme et régulations (Cours magistral : 24h, Travaux pratiques : 6h, Séminaires : 12h)
TOUR-F-434 Data Analysis Applied to Research and Management (en cotitularisation; Cours magistral: 24h, Travaux pratiques : 12h, Projet: 12h)
TOUR-F-436 Gouvernance et dynamiques collectives dans un monde en mutations (en cotitularisation ; Cours magistral : 18h ; Travaux pratiques : 18h).
TOUR-F-431 Principes et pratiques de l’analyse critique (en cotitularisation ; Cours magistral : 6h ; Travaux pratiques : 12h ; Séminaire : 6h).
D’autres cours seront ajoutés plus tard pour atteindre une charge de 120h d’enseignement minimum. Parmi les cours envisagés, l’on note un cours relatif aux dynamiques socio-culturelles en tourisme.

La langue d’enseignement – en français et/ou en anglais – constitue matière à discussion. La maîtrise du français est toutefois indispensable pour assurer un encadrement pédagogique de qualité aux étudiant.es.
Titre requis
Docteur à thèse en :
Sciences/études du tourisme et/ou gestion du tourisme et/ou gestion hôtelière
Sociologie
Anthropologie
Sciences politiques
Géographie
Sciences de gestion

Compétences requises
En plus d’être titulaire d’une thèse de doctorat dans un des domaines susmentionnés, vous avez des connaissances solides et approfondies ainsi qu’une expérience de recherche sur les questions de régulations associées au tourisme.
Vous avez des connaissances solides voire de l’expérience de recherche sur les phénomènes et/ou enjeux sociaux associés au tourisme.
Vous avez de l’expérience dans l’approche systémique de vos objets de recherche.
Vous avez des connaissances solides et de l’expérience d’application voire d’enseignement des méthodes quantitatives et qualitatives de recherche en sciences sociales.
Vous avez une ancienneté scientifique de 4 années minimum (doctorat inclus) au moment de l’engagement.
Vous pouvez faire état d’une expérience postdoctorale (i.e., expérience de recherche scientifique après l’obtention du doctorat) et d’un dossier scientifique solide.
Vous devez être capable d’enseigner et participer à des réunions en français.
Par ailleurs,  si vous avez effectué une mobilité en dehors de l’institution où a été réalisé votre doctorat (durant la période doctorale ou après), ce sera pris en compte lors de l’évaluation de votre dossier.
si vous pouvez démontrer un intérêt effectif pour les problématiques urbaines, cela constitue un atout majeur pour ce poste (études antérieures, expérience de recherche, publications…).

Intéressé·e ?
Des renseignements complémentaires peuvent être obtenus auprès de Mme Isabelle Cloquet (courriel :  [email protected] ).
Votre dossier de candidature sera composé d’un Curriculum vitae ( si vous le souhaitez un CV type peut être téléchargé via le site internet :  https://www.ulb.be/fr/documents-officiels/emplois-academiques-et-scientifiques-cv-type   ) et d’un document complété à l’aide du template disponible à cette adresse URL  https://www.ulb.be/fr/documents-officiels/1f-dossier-de-candidature-acad-tps-plein-docx ).
Ce canevas structure votre dossier de candidature en reprenant les éléments suivants :
une lettre de motivation
un rapport de 7000 signes (ou 4 pages) environ sur les activités de recherche et un projet de recherche, en ce compris l’insertion envisagée au sein des équipes de recherche de l’ULB
un dossier d’enseignement comprenant un rapport de 7000 signes (ou 4 pages) environ sur les activités d’enseignement antérieures et un projet d’enseignement pour les 5 premières années du mandat, qui s’intègre de manière cohérente dans la vision de l’entité de rattachement et dans les profils d’enseignements des filières de formation auxquelles le candidat devra contribuer
une note sur les réalisations et projets internationaux (4 pages maximum)
les noms et adresses mail de contact de cinq personnes de référence susceptibles d’être contactées par les organes chargés d’évaluer les dossiers, en veillant à l’équilibre des genres.  Ces personnes ne peuvent être en conflit d’intérêt en raison de liens familiaux ou affectifs.

Les dossiers incomplets ou les dossiers n'utilisant pas le canevas mis à votre disposition ne seront pas examinés par la commission de sélection.
La nomination, dans le cadre académique de I’ULB, se fait au rang de chargé de cours.  Dès leur nomination, les membres du corps académique sont autorisé·e·s à porter, à titre honorifique, le qualificatif de professeur·e.
Où se rendre pour postuler ?
Cliquez ici : https://jobs.ulb.be/job-invite/2096/?isInternalUser=true
Pour tout problème de connexion ou question à propos de notre application, consultez notre FAQ : e-recrut-mode-d-emploi-candidat-fr-_1734942952302-pdf
N.B. : SAP respecte des directives européennes et états-uniennes, et en conséquence, n’autorise pas les accès à son application à partir des pays/ régions suivants : La Crimée, Sébastopol, République populaire de Donetsk (DNR) / République populaire de Louhansk (LNR), Les zones non contrôlées par le gouvernement ukrainien dans les oblasts de Kherson et Zaporijia, Cuba, l’Iran, La Corée du Nord, la Syrie, la Russie et la Biélorussie.
Dès lors, les candidats qui postulent au départ de ces pays – et uniquement au départ de ces pays – peuvent envoyer leur curriculum vitae et leur dossier de candidature à cette adresse :  [email protected]
Politique d’égalité des chances
La politique de gestion du personnel de l’ULB est axée sur la diversité et l’égalité des chances.
Nous recrutons les candidat·es en fonction de leurs compétences, indépendamment de leur âge, leur genre, leur orientation sexuelle, leur origine, leur nationalité, leurs convictions, leur handicap, etc.

ap:254681.body:
Psykologian laitos hakee tutkijatohtoria ajalle 18.1.2027 (tai sopimuksen mukaan mahdollisimman pian)–30.9.2029 Strategisen Tutkimuksen Neuvoston (STN) rahoittamaan Planetary Mind -tutkimushankkeeseen.
Planetary Mind -hanke tutkii, miten ympäristötoimijuus eli kyky tehdä kestäviä arjen valintoja vaikuttaa mielenterveyteen eri ikäryhmissä. Projektilla on kolme päätavoitetta: (1) selvittää ympäristötoimijuuden merkitystä mielenterveydelle, (2) tuottaa uutta tietoa yksilöiden ja yhteisöjen ympäristötoimijuudesta psykososiaalisena resurssina ja sen vaikutuksesta osallisuuteen ja hyvinvointiin, sekä (3) kehittää ja arvioida skaalautuvia osallistavia ja digitaalisesti tuettuja keinoja ympäristötoimijuuden ja mielenterveyden vahvistamiseksi arjessa.
Tarjoamme merkityksellisen postdoc-tehtävän monitieteisessä tutkimushankkeessa, jonka tavoitteena on vastata ajankohtaisiin yhteiskunnallisiin haasteisiin. Tehtävässä yhdistyvät korkeatasoinen tutkimustyö, tieteellinen julkaiseminen, kansallinen ja kansainvälinen yhteistyö sekä tutkimustiedon vaikuttava hyödyntäminen yhteiskunnassa. Kyseessä on konsortiohanke, joten tutkijatohtorin tehtävässä työskennellään monitieteisessä tiimissä. Tutkimusryhmään kuuluvat tutkimuksen vastuullisen johtajan lisäksi mm. professoreja, tutkijatohtoreita, väitöskirjatutkijoita, vuorovaikutusvastaava, projektipäällikkö sekä kotimaisia ja kansainvälisiä yhteistyökumppaneita.
Etsimämme henkilö
Etsimme aiheesta motivoitunutta postdoc-tutkijaa, jonka tehtävänkuvaan kuuluu mm.:
Ympäristötoimijuutta ja mielenterveyttä edistävien interventioiden kehittäminen
Sekä määrällisten että laadullisten tutkimusaineistojen kerääminen, hallinta ja analysointi
Tieteellinen julkaiseminen ja osallistuminen kansainväliseen tutkimusyhteistyöhön
Aktiivinen yhteistyö hankkeen tutkimus- ja sidosryhmäverkostojen kanssa
Opinnäyte- ja väitöskirjaohjausta

Edellytämme hakijalta:
Tohtorin tutkintoa psykologiasta, terveystieteistä, käyttäytymistieteistä tai muulta tehtävään soveltuvalta alalta
Näyttöä itsenäisestä tieteellisestä tutkimuksesta ja korkeatasoisesta julkaisemisesta
Vahvaa osaamista määrällisistä tutkimusmenetelmistä ja tilastollisista analyyseista
Kokemusta pitkittäis-, kysely- tai interventiotutkimuksesta
Hyviä yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja
Innostusta ja osaamista mielenterveyden ja käyttäytymisenmuutoksen tutkimukseen
Erinomaista suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa

Lisäksi arvostamme:
Kokemusta käyttäytymisenmuutosta tai hyvinvointia edistävien interventioiden kehittämisestä tai arvioinnista
Osaamista ja kiinnostusta laadullisiin tutkimusmenetelmiin ja aineiston analyysiin
Näyttöä kansainvälisestä tutkimusyhteistyöstä
Kokemusta tutkimuseettisten lupaprosessien ja tutkimusrahoitushakemusten valmistelusta
Kokemusta tieteen vaikuttavuustyöstä, tiedeviestinnästä tai yhteistyöstä yhteiskunnallisten toimijoiden kanssa.
Osaamista tutkimuksen avoimen tieteen käytännöistä ja tutkimusaineistojen hallinnasta

Tutkijatohtorin kelpoisuusvaatimuksista ja kielitaidosta määrätään  yliopiston johtosäännössä ja kielitaito-ohjeistuksissa . Tutkijatohtoreilla tulee olla tohtorin tutkinto suoritettuna ennen tehtävässä aloittamista. Tehtävää täytettäessä käytetään kuuden kuukauden koeaikaa.
Tarjoamme
Tule osaksi innostavaa ja lämminhenkistä yhteisöämme!
Jyväskylän yliopistossa olet arvostettu yliopistoyhteisön jäsen. Teemme merkityksellistä työtä ja vaalimme sivistystä. Monitieteisessä yliopistossamme saat mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa kansainväliseen tutkimukseen ja laadukkaaseen akateemiseen koulutukseen. Meille jokaisen hyvinvointi on tärkeää, ja tarjoamme kampuksella sekä sen läheisyydessä erinomaiset puitteet aktiiviseen ja hyvinvoivaan elämäntapaan.
Palkkaus perustuu tehtävien vaativuuteen ja henkilökohtaiseen työstä suoriutumiseen yliopistojen palkkausjärjestelmän mukaisesti. Tutkijatohtorin tehtäväkohtainen palkanosa määräytyy opetus- ja tutkimushenkilöstön tehtävien vaativuustason 5–6 mukaan. Palkkasi on noin 3700–4800 euroa kuukaudessa riippuen aiemmasta osaamisestasi ja kokemuksestasi.
Monipuolinen henkilöstökoulutuksemme tarjoaa sinulle mahdollisuuden jatkuvaan oman osaamisen kehittämiseen. Huolehdimme hyvinvoinnistasi tarjoamalla sinulle hyvän työterveyspalvelun ja huippuluokan liikuntapalvelut ja -edut. Voit käyttää työajastasi kaksi tuntia viikossa liikunnan harrastamiseen. ap:254682.body:
The Department of Psychology is seeking a Doctoral Researcher for the period 18 January 2027–30 September 2029 to join the Planetary Mind research project, funded by the Strategic Research Council (SRC).
The Planetary Mind project examines how Environmental Agency – that is, the capacity to make sustainable choices in everyday life – affects mental health across different age groups. The project has three main objectives: (1) to examine the significance of Environmental Agency for mental health; (2) to generate new knowledge about individual and community Environmental Agency as a psychosocial resource and its effects on participation and well-being; and (3) to develop and evaluate scalable, participatory and digitally supported approaches to strengthening Environmental Agency and mental health in everyday life.
We offer a meaningful Doctoral Researcher position in a multidisciplinary research project that addresses current societal challenges. The role combines high-quality research, scientific publishing, national and international collaboration, and the effective use of research knowledge in society. As this is a consortium project, you will work as part of a multidisciplinary research team and prepare your doctoral dissertation on a topic related to the research themes of the Planetary Mind project.
Who should apply
We are looking for a motivated Doctoral Researcher whose duties include:
Conducting doctoral research and completing doctoral studies as part of the research project
Collecting and analysing both quantitative and qualitative research data
Publishing scientific research and participating in international research collaboration
Actively collaborating with the project’s research and stakeholder networks
The duties may include teaching for up to 5 % of annual working time.

We expect you to have:
A suitable Master’s degree (e.g. in psychology, social sciences or health sciences)
Readiness to apply for and obtain the right to pursue doctoral studies in the doctoral programme in psychology. Doctoral study right must be applied for separately in spring 2027, in accordance with the application deadlines .
Competence in quantitative research methods and good basic skills in statistical analysis methods (SPSS, R or Mplus)
Good interaction and collaboration skills and readiness to work as part of a research team
The ability to work independently and with perseverance
Excellent written and spoken English skills
An interest in research on mental health and behaviour change

We consider the following advantages:
Fluency in Finnish
Experience of and interest in qualitative research methods
Experience in collecting or analysing research data
Evidence of scientific writing and publishing

The person appointed to the position must meet the eligibility requirements for doctoral studies in the Doctor of Psychology (PsyD) or Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) programme (for details, see the Doctoral Programme in Education and Psychology, Spring 2027, University of Jyväskylä ) and must be committed to completing a doctoral degree on topics related to the research themes of the project. The duties, qualification requirements, and the language skills of Doctoral Researchers are stipulated by  the University of Jyväskylä Regulations and language skills guidelines . A trial period of six months will be used in the beginning of the employment.
What we offer
Come to Jyväskylä, Finland, and join our vibrant and inspiring community!
At the University of Jyväskylä, you will be a valued member of our community with a unique opportunity to contribute to international research. You will become part of our international and multidisciplinary community that prioritizes the wellbeing of each individual. Our lively campus provides excellent opportunities for maintaining an active and healthy lifestyle.
Finland, named the world’s happiest country for consecutive years since 2018, offers a high standard of living with free education (also in English), affordable childcare, generous family benefits, and comprehensive healthcare. Work–life balance is highly valued in Finland, and employees enjoy four to six weeks of annual holiday. Jyväskylä is located in central Finland, just three hours by train from the capital Helsinki. Part of the Finnish Lakeland, the city offers easy access to nature and a range of outdoor, sports and exercise activities. As a major centre of education with a large student population, it also features a vibrant cultural scene. For more information about the University of Jyväskylä, the city of Jyväskylä, and living in Finland, see the  University's International Staff Guide .
Salaries are based on job demands and employees’ performance following the Finnish University Salary System. The salary for a Doctoral Researcher is determined based on the task-specific demand level 2–4 for teaching and research staff. The starting salary will be approximately EUR 2700 per month (gross income). A holiday bonus is paid to all employees. With progress of thesis work, the salary will be revised in accordance with the Collective Agreement of Finnish Education Employers: The job demanding level for a beginning doctoral researcher is OV02. Once the doctoral research has progressed to 50% completion, the job requirement level will be raised to OV03. When the doctoral research has reached 75% completion, the job requirement level will be raised to OV04. If you are relocating from abroad, we will support your move to Jyväskylä and Finland.
We offer a wide range of staff training opportunities to support your continuous professional development. We promote your well-being by providing comprehensive occupational health services as well as excellent sports facilities and benefits. You may use up to two hours of your working time per week for physical exercise. Our campus and its surroundings offer excellent opportunities for maintaining an active and healthy lifestyle. Flexible working hours and the possibility of remote work help support a healthy work-life balance.
How to apply?
The application documents that should be included in English and in PDF format:
A Curriculum vitae, composed according to good scientific practice and considering the template for researcher´s curriculum vitae by  The Finnish Advisory Board on Research Integrity .
Informal cover letter (max 2 pages), including a description of your eligibility for doctoral studies, your research interests, and your merits and experience in relation to the requirements of the position.
Degree certificate (highest degree).
Societal engagement and impact, as well as international activities, through which the applicant wishes to demonstrate their ability to contribute to the societal impact expected of the position.

We look forward to receiving your application in our recruitment system by 18 November 2026 .
For further information, please contact  the Project Lead of Planetary Mind Project, Katri Savolainen,  [email protected] / +358 40 805 4854
Our application process is transparent, professional and international. We communicate openly with the applicants throughout the recruitment process. We value equality and diversity in our work community and encourage qualified applicants to apply for this position.
We offer good working conditions for researchers and promote the principles of HR Excellence in Research,  HRS4R . The Human Resources Strategy for Researchers (HRS4R) is based on the values of the European Charter for Researchers & The Code of Conduct for the Recruitment of Researchers (Charter & Code). JYU is committed to fairness, consistency and transparency in selection decisions, and undertakes  the recommendations for the responsible evaluation of a researcher in Finland . JYU has signed  the DORA Declaration . By signing the agreement, JYU is committed to complying with the  CoARA principles.

University of Jyväskylä

The University of Jyväskylä  is a human-centred environment of 2,500 experts and 14,500 students. Our goal is to create wisdom and wellbeing for us all. It is essential that each member of the community thrives and has opportunities to develop and grow. We cherish openness of thinking as well as the balance between research and education. Our naturally beautiful campus is located at the heart of the city of Jyväskylä. JYU is the third largest employer in Central Finland.

Planetary Mind -hanke tutkii, miten ympäristötoimijuus eli kyky tehdä kestäviä arjen valintoja vaikuttaa mielenterveyteen eri ikäryhmissä.

(1) selvittää ympäristötoimijuuden merkitystä mielenterveydelle

Tieteellinen julkaiseminen ja osallistuminen kansainväliseen tutkimusyhteistyöhön

Työnkuvaan voi sisältyä opetustehtäviä enintään 5 % vuotuisesta työajasta.

Kykyä itsenäiseen ja pitkäjänteiseen työskentelyyn

ap:254685.body:
Place of work: Brig | Start date: Immediately or upon agreement
UniDistance Suisse offers fully online university degree programmes and is accredited under the Swiss Higher Education Act (HEdA). It combines flexible, location‑independent part‑time distance learning with an active, interdisciplinary research culture on its campus in Brig. Across five faculties – Law, Psychology, Business & Economics, History, and Mathematics & Computer Science – we have been shaping modern teaching, learning and research for more than 30 years. Today, UniDistance Suisse counts over 2,700 students and around 550 staff members.
To strengthen and further develop its research cluster in behavioural and experimental economics, the Faculty of Business & Economics at UniDistance Suisse is looking for a:
Doctoral Student in Business & Economics (80–100 %)
Place of work : Brig
Start date : Immediately or upon agreement
This is a unique opportunity to pursue a PhD in experimental and behavioural economics, to collaborate with experienced researchers, and to participate in research seminars and workshops. We are looking for candidates with a Master’s degree in Economics, Management, or a related field who have a strong interest in experimental and behavioral economics and are enthusiastic about the opportunities offered by online education and a modern digital working environment. The position provides the opportunity to develop a strong academic profile and acquire advanced research skills within an active and collaborative research environment.
Your responsibilities
Design and conduct research in experimental and behavioural economics as part of your doctoral studies
Develop and complete your doctoral dissertation
Complete the required doctoral coursework and training as part of the UniDistance Suisse PhD programme
Present your research at seminars, workshops, and academic conferences and work towards publications in international academic journals
Collaborate with researchers at UniDistance and other institutions on research projects and publications
Assist in online teaching activities

Your profile
Master’s degree in Economics, Management, or a related field
Strong interest in experimental and behavioural economics and quantitative empirical research
Interest in designing, conducting, and analysing lab and/or field experiments; previous experience with experimental research is an advantage
Interest in at least one of the following topics: organizational and institutional economics, applied game theory, political economy, environmental economics and sustainability
Strong analytical skills and motivation to pursue an academic research career
Fluent in English, ideally combined with sufficient knowledge of German to assist with teaching.

We offer
The opportunity to pursue a PhD and develop your academic profile in an active research environment, close collaboration with and support from experienced researchers and opportunities to develop and implement your own research ideas
A research-intensive academic environment: You will be part of a dynamic university setting characterised by strong scientific expertise and a culture of interdisciplinary collaboration.
Attractive employment conditions: modern working conditions, generous social benefits and a wide range of continuing education opportunities.
A committed team: you will join a highly skilled and engaged team that embodies innovation, excellence, and a strong culture of collaboration.
An inspiring working environment: our campus in Brig is located in immediate proximity to the historic old town, the Swiss Federal Railways (SBB) station and attractive natural and mountain regions. It offers a high quality of life and a vibrant academic exchange.

Interested? Please send us your application containing a motivation letter and a CV. We will review applications on a rolling basis and start holding first-round online interviews in November and December. The ad remains open until the position is filled or until 31 January 2027 at the latest.
We look forward to receiving your full application at the following address: [email protected] . For further information, please contact Prof. Manuel Grieder ( [email protected] ).
Applications are welcome from candidates worldwide. Successful applicants must reside in Switzerland or be willing to relocate to Switzerland upon taking up the position.

Salary and conditions are competitive and will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Qualifications
NOVA IMS seeks a candidate with a strong commitment to excellence in scholarly research and teaching. He/ she will be expected to teach in undergraduate as well as graduate programme classes related to one or more of the following areas of expertise:
Risk Analysis
Risk Management in Banking & Insurance
Risk Management Models
Financial Markets and Risks
Market & Credit Risk Management

The successful applicants should have a strong academic background and an international profile in the aforementioned expertise areas with a record of research publications in top-ranked field journals. Moreover, relevant experience in obtaining funding and managing national and international research projects will be considered an advantage.
The successful candidate should be able to provide strong and committed leadership in education, including curriculum development, course coordination and educational innovation, the preparation and delivery of lectures, seminars and tutorials, consultation with students, and marking and assessment.
The main requirements for applicants are listed below:
PhD or doctoral degree from a recognized university;
Excellent scientific achievements, documented by internationally recognized publications;
Excellent didactic skills;
Demonstrate an excellent teaching ability at both the undergraduate and graduate levels;
High capacity to develop pedagogical innovations and to manage a programme;
Excellent communication skills (oral, written, presentation);
Proficient in English (oral and written);
Ability to teach in English;
Collaborative skills, initiative, result oriented, organization, and capacity to work in an interdisciplinary environment.

The School
NOVA Information Management School (NOVA IMS,   www.novaims.unl.pt ) is the School of Information Management and Data Science of Universidade Nova de Lisboa. It is one of the 9 academic units of Universidade NOVA de Lisboa, a university institution with internationally recognized research and quality teaching.
It is dedicated to converting data into value, under the motto “Data with Purpose”, through a wide range of activities, namely teaching, and research and development activities that are largely supported by international partnerships, offering a unique research environment to address its main research challenges.
The quality of its training is recognized globally, through different national and international accreditations, and outstanding positions achieved in various fields, namely in the Eduniversal ranking (seven of its masters and postgraduate degrees are recognized among the best in the world in their respective areas).
NOVA IMS has more than 30 years of accumulated experience in data processing and analysis, which it now puts at the service of digital transformation and the “Big Data” environments in which we live in, namely through a wide range of laboratories (NOVA ANALYTICS LABS powered by NOVA IMS). Today, it has more than 3.000 students from 81 different countries, and high levels of internationalization in all the activities it carries out from Lisbon to the world.
How to apply
Interested candidates are invited to send the application material listed below by email to [email protected] (mentioning the reference of the application):
A cover letter including motivation to join NOVA IMS;
A complete curriculum vitae with a list of publications and a list of classes taught;
A copy of the three most significant recent publications, communications or working papers.

Reference : NOVAIMS_Risk
Application deadline: November 30th, 2026

ap:254689.body:
OsloMet - storbyuniversitetet er Norges tredje største universitet med 23 000 studenter og over 2600 ansatte. Vi har campus i Oslo Sentrum og på Romerike. OsloMet leverer forskning og utdanning med høy relevans for arbeidslivet, velferdsstaten og storbyregionen.
Om stillingen
Vil du være med å utvikle instituttets arbeid innen master i estetiske fag og kunstterapi?
Ved Institutt for estetiske fag, Fakultet for teknologi, kunst og design , er det ledig et 20 % ekstraerverv i fire år som førsteamanuensis II i kunstterapi, med ønsket tiltredelse 01.08.27. Stillingen er en åremålsstilling etter UH-loven § 7-7. Stillingen lyses ut for en periode på fire år, med mulighet til forlengelse i ytterligere to år. Vi søker en utviklingsorientert medarbeider som kan bidra til å styrke instituttets arbeid med kunstterapi i tett dialog med forsknings- og praksisfeltet.
Institutt for estetiske fag (EST) holder til i Pilestredet 52 med nyrenoverte lokaler. Fakultetet er i sterk utvikling og står foran spennende endringer de nærmeste årene. Institutt for estetiske fag vil stå sentralt i denne utviklingen.
Stillingen er i hovedsak knyttet til Master i estetiske fag, Kunstterapi, studieretning i estetiske fag - OsloMet . Arbeidsoppgavene omfatter undervisning, veiledning og sensur på primært masternivå, samt relevante oppgaver i forsknings- og utviklingsprosjekter og gjennom oppdragsvirksomhet. Du kan også få ansvar for program- og emneutvikling. Studieretningen kunstterapi er samlings- og nettbasert; med både norske, nordiske og internasjonale studenter.
Dine ansvarsområder og arbeidsoppgaver vil være å
undervise og veilede på primært masternivå, samt etter- og videreutdanninger
følge opp studenter i praksis og ha kontakt med yrkesfeltet
utføre faglig-administrative oppgaver
aktivt bidra til utvikling av studiet, instituttet og OsloMet som helhet
ta initiativ til, og delta i, utviklingen av større forskningsprosjekter og søknader om ekstern finansiering gjennom akademisk samarbeid
oppsøke og delta i forskningssamarbeid med nasjonale og internasjonale samarbeidspartnere

Kvalifikasjonskrav
Relevant doktorgrad hvor kunstterapi har vært en hoveddel av avhandlingen eller kompetanse på tilsvarende nivå dokumentert enten ved vitenskapelig arbeid eller kunstnerisk arbeid av samme omfang og kvalitet
god skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne på norsk/svensk/dansk (minimum B2-nivå) og engelsk ( Språkkrav for ansatte ved OsloMet )
undervisnings- og veiledererfaring på bachelor og/eller masternivå innen sosialfaglig eller helsefaglig utdanning som kunstterapi

Generelle kriterier for ansettelse i undervisnings- og forskningsstillinger følger av Forskrift til universitets- og høyskoleloven .
Det vil være en fordel om du har
forsknings- og utviklingsarbeid som er relevant for stillingen
erfaring med forskningsmetoder og etikk innen kunstterapi
resultater med å innhente ekstern forskningsfinansiering
nordisk praksisnettverk innen kunstterapi
god digital kompetanse, inkludert erfaring med digitale undervisnings- og vurderingsverktøy
erfaring med studentaktive læringsformer som kombinerer teori og praksis

Personlige egenskaper
god gjennomføringsevne
motivasjon for fag- og forskningsfeltet
god evne til å kommunisere og samarbeide med studenter og kolleger
evne til nytenkning og innovasjon

Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt.
OsloMet gjennomfører prøving av pedagogiske kvalifikasjoner i forbindelse med intervju.
Vi tilbyr
interessante arbeidsoppgaver ved Norges tredje største universitet
deltakelse i forskningsgruppe og et kreativt og inspirerende fagmiljø
muligheter til faglig utvikling
låne- og pensjonsbetingelser i Statens pensjonskasse

Stillingen lønnes, i henhold til Hovedtariffavtalene i staten og OsloMets lønnspolitikk i stillingskode 1011 førsteamanuensis, kroner 720 000 – 920 000 per år. For spesielt kvalifiserte søkere kan høyere lønn vurderes. Fra lønnen trekkes 2 % pensjonsinnskudd til Statens pensjonskasse (SPK).
Søknadsprosess
Vil du søke på stillingen må du søke via vårt rekrutteringssystem.
En sakkyndig komité vil gjennomføre vurdering av aktuelle søknader. Før oversendelse av søknadspapirene til sakkyndig komité, vil alle søknadene bli gjennomgått ved fakultetet. Søknader fra ikke-kvalifiserte søkere vil ikke bli oversendt til vurdering. Dersom omfanget av søknader nødvendiggjør det, vil en sorteringskomité gjøre en første utvelgelse av søkere. Utvalgte søkere vil igjen bli vurdert av en sakkyndig komité.
Innen søknadsfristen må du laste opp følgende dokumenter:
søknadsbrev
CV, attester og alle sider av vitnemål. Utenlandsk utdanning bør være godkjent på forhånd, og godkjenningsbrev vedlegges. Informasjon finnes via lenken:  Godkjenning av utenlandsk utdanning – jobb i Norge | HK-dir
fullstendig publikasjonsliste
inntil 10 vitenskapelige arbeider, og en oversikt over disse, inkludert doktorgradsavhandling hvis relevant
pedagogisk mappe som dokumenterer utdanningsfaglig kompetanse
gjerne kontaktinformasjon til to referanser

Vi behandler kun søknader sendt via vårt elektroniske rekrutteringssystem og alle dokumenter må lastes opp for at din søknad skal behandles. Dokumentene må være på et skandinavisk språk eller engelsk. Oversettelser må være autorisert og du må påregne å fremvise originaler ved et eventuelt intervju. OsloMet gjennomfører kontroll av dokumenter, slik at du som kandidat skal få en reell evaluering og rettferdig konkurranse. Ufullstendige søknader vil ikke bli tatt til vurdering.
For aktuelle stillinger gjennomfører OsloMet bakgrunnssjekk av søkere i samarbeid med en ekstern leverandør, for å verifisere opplysninger som fremgår av tilgjengelige dokumenter. Bakgrunnssjekk skjer alltid med kandidatens samtykke, og ansettelse i disse stillingene forutsetter godkjent bakgrunnssjekk. Aktuelle søkere vil motta nærmere informasjon om dette.
Informasjon til deg som søker
Inkludering og mangfold styrker vår evne til å løse OsloMets samfunnsoppdrag. Derfor ønsker vi medarbeidere med ulike kompetanser, livserfaringer og perspektiver velkommen. Vi arbeider kontinuerlig for å være en inkluderende arbeidsplass, og gjennom dialog tilrettelegger vi for medarbeidere som har behov for det.
OsloMet er EU sertifisert HR Center of Excellence for Charter & Code  for forskere som støtter karrieremuligheter, mobilitet og arbeidstaker rettigheter for forskere.
OsloMet har sluttet seg til prinsippene og forpliktet institusjonen til å følge anbefalingene i DORA-erklæringen (sfdora.org) (The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment).
Ansettelsen blir gjennomført etter prinsippene i statsansatteloven og lovverk som regulerer eksport av kunnskap, teknologi og tjenester. Søkere som er i konflikt med dette regelverket vil ikke anses kvalifisert for stillingen.
Besøk OsloMet på LinkedIn , Facebook , Instagram
For spørsmål av administrativ karakter, kontakt (e-post [email protected] )
Om oss
OsloMet - storbyuniversitetet er Norges tredje største universitet med 23 000 studenter og over 2600 ansatte. Vi har campus i Oslo Sentrum og på Romerike. OsloMet leverer forskning og utdanning med høy relevans for arbeidslivet, velferdsstaten og storbyregionen.
I over 200 år har OsloMet – storbyuniversitetet bidratt til å bygge kunnskap og kompetanse for det norske velferdssamfunnet. I dag er OsloMet et moderne og urbant universitet som er kjent for sine store og solide fagmiljøer innenfor lærerutdanning, helse- og sosialfag, samfunnsforskning, design og teknologifag.
Fakultet for teknologi, kunst og design (TKD) utgjør et sterkt og mangfoldig faglig miljø med tydelig internasjonalt preg. Arbeidet gjøres i en profesjonell organisasjon som er ledende i å ta i bruk ny teknologi og nye løsninger, og er langt fremme på tverrfaglig og eksternt samarbeid. Fakultet for teknologi, kunst og design er i sterk vekst og vi rekrutterer høyt kvalifiserte medarbeidere fra hele verden.
Fakultet TKD har om lag 4 000 studenter og 400 ansatte, og holder til i Pilestredet i Oslo sentrum og på Kjeller utenfor Lillestrøm. Fakultetet utfører forskning og tilbyr utdanning på bachelor-, master- og doktorgradsnivå innen teknologi, kunst og design.

ap:254693.body:
Om stillingen
VID vitenskapelige høgskole søker etter en nytenkende, verdidrevet og tillitsskapende prorektor for utdanning. Stillingen er et fireårig åremål fra 1.8.2027. Du har sterke samarbeidsevner, sans for både detaljer og de store linjene, god prosessforståelse og er motivert av å være en pådriver for å videreutvikle utdanningsporteføljen og posisjonere VID som en sterk utdanningsinstitusjon.
Om stillingens arbeids- og ansvarsområder
Prorektor for utdanning inngår i rektors ledergruppe, og har felles strategisk lederansvar for å realisere VIDs strategi og samlede utvikling og resultat.
Prorektor for utdanning har delegert ansvar og myndighet for utdanningsområdet, herunder VIDs kvalitetsarbeid. Prorektor for utdanning har linjeansvar for Avdeling for utdanning, hvor blant annet studieseksjonen og seksjon for internasjonalisering inngår med til sammen rundt 30 årsverk.
Følgende arbeids- og ansvarsområder inngår i stillingen:
strategisk ansvar for å utvikle VIDs utdanningsvirksomhet og studieprogramportefølje på bachelor- og masternivå i tett samarbeid med dekanene ved VIDs tre fakulteter
ekstern posisjonering av VID som kunnskaps- og utdanningsaktør
ansvar for VIDs kvalitetssystem og kvalitetsarbeid
ansvar for tilbud om og videreutvikling av samlet utdanningsfaglig kompetanse
linjeansvar for seksjonsledere og stabsmedarbeidere i avdeling for utdanning
lede det sentrale utdanningsutvalget ved VID

Kvalifikasjoner
Vi søker en person som har:
høy vitenskapelig kompetanse på et relevant fagområde, minimum førstekompetanse
dokumentert og relevant ledererfaring
god innsikt i nasjonal og europeisk utdanningspolitikk
utdanningspedagogisk kompetanse og erfaring med pedagogisk utviklingsarbeid, innovative undervisningsformer, digitalisering og livslang læring
meget god muntlig og skriftlig framstillingsevne på norsk og engelsk

Det er også ønskelig med:
toppkompetanse (dosent, professor)
pedagogisk formalkompetanse
dokumentert lederutdanning
god økonomiforståelse
god saksbehandlingskompetanse

Personlige egenskaper
Vi søker etter en person som
kan være en pådriver for utviklingen av VID som utdanningsinstitusjon
evner å samarbeide med og integrere studentenes ønsker og behov i arbeidet med utvikling av utdanningene
har evne til å arbeide strategisk, strukturert og resultatorientert
har en engasjerende, verdidrevet og tillitvekkende lederstil
har gode kommunikative evner
har evne til å bygge tillit og nettverk nasjonalt og internasjonalt
kan identifisere seg med VIDs verdigrunnlag, formål og faglige og strategiske ambisjoner, og promotere dette internt og eksternt

I en helhetsvurdering av søkere vil det bli lagt vekt på personlig egnethet.
Vi tilbyr
Prorektor ansettes på åremål for fire år fra 1. august 2027, med mulighet for forlengelse i ytterligere en periode på fire år, til sammen åtte år, på bakgrunn av utlysning. For søkere uten grunnstilling ved VID, vil dette tilbys, sammen med rett til forskningstermin etter endt åremål i tråd med VIDs betingelser for lederstillinger.
For øvrig tilbyr vi:
en unik lederposisjon ved en vitenskapelig høgskole som i juni 2026 søkte om å bli akkreditert som universitet
gode muligheter for å påvirke VIDs samlede utvikling og utvikling som utdanningsinstitusjon
medlemskap med gode pensjons- og lånevilkår i Statens pensjonskasse
gode velferdsordninger
lønn etter avtale i henhold til hovedavtalen mellom VIRKE og arbeidstakerorganisasjonene i stillingskode 1062 Direktør, arbeidstittel prorektor for utdanning.
arbeidssted: Oslo, Bergen eller Stavanger

Generell informasjon
Et godt arbeidsmiljø er preget av mangfold. Vi oppfordrer kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke uavhengig av kjønn, funksjonsevne eller kulturell bakgrunn.
Den som ansettes må kunne arbeide lojalt i samsvar med mål og verdigrunnlag ved VID vitenskapelige høgskole og rette seg etter de lover, forskrifter, retningslinjer og avtaler som til enhver tid gjelder for stillingen.
Søknaden
Søknaden med vedlegg sendes via linken «Søk stillingen» øverst på denne siden og må inneholde:
Søknad
CV
Vitnemål
Attester

Søkere som har høyere utdanning fra utlandet skal søke om godkjenning av utdanningen fra HK.dir.
Vennligst merk at alle relevante dokumenter må foreligge på et skandinavisk språk eller engelsk, enten som original eller i oversettelse.
Kun søkere som benytter seg av søknadsportalen er aktuelle for stillingen.
Søkere som inviteres til intervju må kunne fremlegge bekreftede kopier av vitnemål, attester og tre referanser.
Om VID
VID vitenskapelige høgskole tilbyr utdanning og forskning innen helse-, sosial- og samfunnsvitenskap, samt ledelse, diakoni og teologi. Vi har rundt 60 studieprogrammer på bachelor-, master- og ph.d.-nivå. Vårt mål er å bli universitet innen 2028.
VID ble grunnlagt i 2016 gjennom en fusjon av tidligere høgskoler med røtter tilbake til 1843. Med nesten 6000 studenter og 600 ansatte er VID i dag en av Norges største private høgskoler. Vi har campuser i Oslo, Bergen og Stavanger, men har også utdanningstilbud i Tromsø, Sandvika og Sandnessjøen.

ap:254698.body:
Job description
KTH is establishing a new Makerspace, which is scheduled to open in February 2027. We are looking for a student assistant to support the development of activities within the Makerspace. The Makerspace is a place where students can develop their skills through hands-on work with tools and machinery. This may involve woodwork, 3D printing, prototype design using various materials, and electronics. The role involves tasks such as:
planning and running workshops for the space’s users
collaborating with teachers to integrate the use of the space into educational programmes
producing training materials and manuals on how to use the space

You may also be expected to manage technical equipment and software within the facility, maintain materials and equipment, and help with procurement.
Qualifications
Requirements
You should be admitted to first or second-level cycle education at a  Swedish university
Experience in organizing peer groups, student organizations, or volunteer teams.
Ability to create structured schedules, rosters, and event workflows.
You should be fluent in Swedish and English, for day-to-day work.

Preferred qualifications
Student at KTH
Ability to translate technical processes into clear, written instructions for non-technical users.
Experience in liaising with faculty and administration to identify curriculum needs.

Great emphasis will be placed on personal skills.
Join us at KTH
KTH shapes the future through education, research and innovation. As a leading international technical university, we play an active role in advancing the transition towards a sustainable society. At KTH, you have the opportunity to grow and develop in a creative and dynamic environment, with good working conditions and attractive benefits. Equality, diversity and equal opportunities are essential to quality and form an integral part of KTH’s core values as a university and public authority.
Learn more about our benefits and what it's like to work and grow at KTH

ap:254700.body:
Arbetsuppgifter
KTH etablerar en ny Makerspace-miljö som planeras att lanseras februari 2027. Vi söker en studentassistent som ska stödja utvecklingen av verksamheten i Makerspacet. Miljön är en plats för studenter att utveckla sina färdigheter genom praktiskt arbete med verktyg och maskiner. Det kan handla om arbete i trä, 3D-printning, prototypdesign i olika material och elektronik. Arbetet innefattar uppgifter som att:
planera och genomföra workshops för miljöns användare
samarbeta med lärare för att integrera användningen av miljön i utbildningsprogram
producera utbildningsmaterial och manualer för användningen av miljön

Du kan också förväntas hantera teknisk utrustning och mjukvara i miljön, underhålla material och utrustning och vid behov beställa nytt material.
Kvalifikationer
Krav
Du ska vara antagen till utbildning på grund- eller avancerad nivå vid svenskt lärosäte
Erfarenhet av att organisera studentgrupper, föreningar eller volontärteam.
Förmåga att skapa strukturerade tidsplaner, bemanningsscheman och arbetsflöden för evenemang.
Du bör vara flytande i svenska och engelska, då det krävs i det dagliga arbete.

Meriterande
Student på KTH
Förmåga att omvandla tekniska arbetsmoment till tydliga skriftliga instruktioner för icke-tekniska användare.
Professionalism i samarbetet med fakultet och administration för att identifiera utbildningsbehov.

Vi kommer att lägga stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper.
Bli en del av KTH
KTH formar framtiden genom utbildning, forskning och innovation. Som ett ledande internationellt tekniskt universitet spelar vi en aktiv roll i att driva och medverka i omställningen till ett hållbart samhälle. Här erbjuds du möjligheten att växa och utvecklas på en kreativ och dynamisk arbetsplats med goda arbetsvillkor och förmåner. Jämställdhet, mångfald och lika villkor är en kvalitetsfråga och en självklar del av KTH:s värdegrund som universitet och statlig myndighet.
Läs mer om våra förmåner och hur det är att arbeta och utvecklas på KTH.
Fackliga representanter
Kontaktuppgifter till  fackliga representanter.
Ansökan
Du ansöker via KTH:s rekryteringssystem. Du som sökande har huvudansvaret för att din ansökan är komplett när den skickas in. Din kompletta ansökan ska vara KTH tillhanda senast sista dagen för ansökningsperioden.

CV

Övrigt
För information om behandling av personuppgifter i samband med rekrytering.

Om så är fallet för just denna anställning görs en säkerhetsprövning av sökande i enlighet med säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) efter samtycke. I dessa fall är en förutsättning för anställning att sökande blir godkänd efter säkerhetsprövning.

ap:254704.body:
At the University of Neuchâtel we have an open position for a
Post-Doctoral Researcher (4 years, 100% FTE, part-time possible)
The start date will be 1 February 2027 or by mutual agreement. The successful applicant is expected to contribute to a major interdisciplinary project on  health disparities among migration-related populations in Switzerland , funded by the SNSF. The project combines migration studies and public health to analyse mental and physical health outcomes, access barriers, and the role of policy contexts.
The   Swiss Forum for Migration and Population Studies  (SFM) is a prominent research and training institute at the University of Neuchâtel, specialized in questions of human migration and mobility. It has partnered with the   Epidemiology, Biostatistics and Prevention Institute  (EBPI) at the University of Zürich, a leading research and teaching institution in the fields of public health, epidemiology, and preventive medicine.
Using a newly developed, purposefully sampled survey targeting specific migration-related groups, the project addresses disparities in mental and physical health, access barriers and discrimination in healthcare, and the role of policy and reception contexts in shaping health outcomes. Comparisons to the general population are foreseen via the Swiss Health Survey. You will play a central role in the project and be involved in all stages, from development to analysis, publication, and dissemination. Initially, you will help co-develop the survey instrument, drawing on validated measures from existing surveys, and incorporating insights from bottom-up consultations with members of migration-related populations. You will then support the survey implementation in REDCap and take a leading role in data analysis and publications. There is a strong commitment to data sharing and stakeholder engagement (public health, migration).
You will contribute to different analyses and publications alongside other members of the research team. We expect you to take primary responsibility for analyses on the role of context, which requires advanced modelling skills including multilevel regression models with cross-level interactions. You will be attached to the Swiss Forum for Migration and Population Studies at the University of Neuchâtel, but the position is shared between the University of Neuchâtel and the University of Zürich, exposing you to two complementary research environments and their respective networks.
Your profile:
PhD in a relevant discipline (public health, epidemiology, sociology, demography, political science, migration studies)
strong quantitative skills, especially survey analysis, supported by relevant publications
experience with or interest in interdisciplinary research, combining questions of migration and health
familiarity with survey design and implementation, supported by relevant publications
interest in open science practices (preregistration, data sharing)
you enjoy working independently and as part of an interdisciplinary team
strong organizational and communication skills, a high level of self-motivation, and the ability to work in a structured and conceptual manner
excellent English skills
German, French, or Italian are strong assets
knowledge of Dari, Pashto, Tigrinya, Tamil, Albanian, Ukrainian/Russian, and Turkish is an asset

What we offer:
a fully funded four-year position in an interdisciplinary project with a strong publication strategy targeting journals in both public health and migration studies
salary in accordance with university guidelines
a budget for conference participation
mentoring from leading senior researchers with complementary expertise
a collaborative team including two PhD researchers and support staff
exposure to two institutions and their distinct academic cultures
the opportunity to shape a novel survey instrument from the ground up
a project that actively engages with stakeholders and seeks real-world impact

The University of Neuchâtel is an Equal Opportunities Employer. Qualified candidates from all genders and candidates with a migration history are encouraged to apply. Requests for part-time positions will be considered.
Submitting your application : Applications (motivation letter, CV, names of two referees, a relevant research paper as a writing sample) should be submitted as a  single PDF to  [email protected]  (also for queries). The position is open until filled; for full consideration, apply by  1 December 2026 .

ap:254705.body:
THE POSITIONS
emlyon business school invites applications for the following full-time Faculty positions:
A full-time position in Geopolitics at (Assistant / Associate professor) Level - Research-Driven
A full-time position in Digital Marketing at Full professor Level - Research-Driven Profile
A full-time position in Accounting and Corporate Finance at Full Professor Level - Research-Driven Profile
Associate Professor of Applied Mathematics emlyon tech school

Appointments are made at full Professor, Associate and Assistant level depending on research, teaching record and business experience.
All these positions are based in  France (Lyon - Paris)
Rank of appointment and salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience. Salary and conditions will be competitive with leading European Business Schools
Successful candidates are expected to start by  May or September 2027.
We strongly encourage people of all backgrounds (gender, ethnic background, nationality) to apply.
The selected candidate is expected to  be based in Lyon or nearby area . emlyon business school has set-up a relocation policy to support the moving process.

THE SCHOOL
Founded in 1872, emlyon business school is one of the oldest business schools in Europe. It belongs to the top 1% of business schools worldwide recognized by the triple accreditation: EQUIS, AACSB, and AMBA.
emlyon business school welcomes 9,260 students from 130 nationalities across its three campuses in Lyon, Shanghai, and Paris. The School relies on a Faculty of 174 international professors and researchers, as well as a network of 220 academic partners, to deliver top-quality trainings recognized in the world’s best rankings. It boasts a community of 48,000 alumni.
As a Mission-driven company since 2021, emlyon business school cultivates the ability to drive change in resonance with the world by placing the hybridization of skills with social and environmental responsibility at the core of its training programs, supported by teaching methods that combine action and thinking. emlyon has endorsed the European Charter for researchers and is awarded HR excellence in research by the European Commission. The HR Strategy for Researchers (HRS4R) is available at the following link:  https://em-lyon.com/en/faculty-and-research/hr-strategy-for-researchers
THE ENVIRONMENT
emlyon  business school is at the center of a vibrant ecosystem of large universities with excellent research teams in engineering, computer science, natural sciences, social sciences, and the humanities (see:  https://www.lyoncampus.com/en/welcome/lyon-a-city-of-innovation )
Lyon is the second largest city in France, with a long entrepreneurship tradition and a solid digital industry.
Further information
About  emlyon  business school:  http://www.em-lyon.com/en/

THE APPLICATION SHOULD CONSIST OF
A cover letter including the motivation to join emlyon business school
An up-to-date curriculum vitae
A research statement
A teaching statement (with teaching evaluations, where available)
A list of papers under review or in progress
Two references/names with contact information

All application materials should be submitted in English. The application materials will not be returned.
Candidates are strongly encouraged to apply as soon as possible as review of applications will begin immediately.
Interested candidates should apply electronically through emlyon business school recruitment webpage:
HERE
RECRUITMENT PROCESS
emlyon business school complies with the Open, Transparent and Merit-based Recruitment principles as stated in the European Code of Conduct for the recruitment of researchers.
The selection committee is appointed by the Head of department and composed of three to eight professors, ensuring a balanced representation of gender, national origin, and professor grades.
Pre-selection step: the selection committee reviews all the applications to short-list the candidates who meet the most criteria as described in the candidate’s characteristics.
Short-listed candidates are invited to a recruitment day (held by videoconference in most cases) with:   a) a job talk presentation
b) one-on-one interviews with committee members.

Each permanent professor attending the job talk completes an assessment grid, and the results are aggregated to identify the top one and top two applicants. Finalists are interviewed by the Dean for Faculty & Research and/or the Associate Dean for Research. The final decision is communicated by the Dean for Faculty & Research.

ap:254709.body:
Join our research team at the Division of Materials and Manufacture, Chalmers University of Technology, and contribute to the development of next-generation solid-state batteries. Through close collaboration with Fraunhofer (Germany), RISE (Sweden) and Swedish industrial partners, you will investigate polymer-based solid-state electrolyte synthesis, materials engineering, and advanced electrode processing, with a strong focus on scalable battery manufacturing.
About us
At the Department of Mechanical Engineering , we unite the power of technology, people, and society to drive the transition toward a sustainable future. Through research, education, and collaboration, we create solutions that connect materials to mobility, ideas to impact – shaping a resilient and sustainable world.
The Division of Materials and Manufacture conducts research across the full value chain, from materials design and processing to advanced manufacturing and characterisation, with a strong emphasis on metallic systems. We combine interdisciplinary expertise with close industry collaboration to develop sustainable materials and manufacturing technologies.
About the research project
Our research group at Chalmers focuses on advanced materials development, electrode processing and battery manufacturing, and is part of Sweden’s strong and growing battery research and innovation ecosystem. The project aims to advance the development and manufacturing of next-generation solid-state batteries through innovative electrolyte materials and electrode processing strategies.
The research will combine materials synthesis, polymer science and processing technologies to understand and improve the properties, interfaces and manufacturability of solid-state battery components. The Doctoral student will work in an interdisciplinary and collaborative environment, involving Chalmers, Fraunhofer, RISE and Swedish industrial partners, with a focus on bridging materials research and practical battery manufacturing.
The Doctoral student will undertake a research exchange at Fraunhofer for a minimum of six months, providing an opportunity to work in an international research environment and strengthen the collaboration.
Who we are looking for
The following requirements are mandatory:
To qualify as a Doctoral student, you must have a Master's degree ( masterexamen ) of 120 credits or a Master’s degree ( magisterexamen ) of 60 credits* in materials science, chemical engineering, materials mechanics, polymer chemistry, materials chemistry, physics, or production engineering
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
Experience in lithium-ion batteries and/or solid-state electrolyte battery

* for students with an education earned outside of Sweden, a 4-year Bachelor’s degree is accepted.
The following experience will strengthen your application:
Experience in solid-state electrolytes, lithium-ion batteries, electrode processing, battery manufacturing, battery binder development.

What you will do
Take courses at an advanced level within the Graduate school of Materials Science
Work in the research project as described above
Develop your own scientific concepts and communicate the results of your research verbally and in writing
The position generally also includes teaching on Chalmers' undergraduate level or performing other duties corresponding to 20 percent of working hours

Contract terms
The Doctoral student positions are fully funded from start.
The position is a fixed-term appointment of four years, with the possibility to teach up to 20%, which extends the position up to five years.
A starting salary of 35,725 SEK per month (valid from May 1, 2026).
Doctoral studies require physical presence throughout the entire study period. A valid residence permit must be presented by the study start date; otherwise the admission may be withdrawn.

What we offer
As a Doctoral student at Chalmers, you are an employee and enjoy all employee benefits. Read more about   working at Chalmers  and our  benefits  for employees.
A dynamic and inspiring working environment in the coastal city of Gothenburg .
Read more about Sweden’s generous parental leave, subsidized day care, free schools, healthcare etc at Move To Gothenburg.

Chalmers is dedicated to improving gender balance and actively works with equality projects, such as the GENIE Initiative for gender equality and excellence . We celebrate diversity and consider equality and inclusion as fundamental aspects of all our activities.
If Swedish is not your native language, Chalmers offers Swedish courses to help you settle in.
Find more general information about doctoral studies at Chalmers here .
Application procedure
The application should be written in English and attached as PDF-files, as below. Maximum size for each file is 40 MB. Please note that the system does not support Zip files.
CV
Personal letter
A brief introduction about yourself.
A brief motivation as to why you are interested in this position.

Bachelor’s and, if available, master’s thesis together with the transcripts.
Use the button at the foot of the page to reach the application form.
A background check may be conducted as part of the application process.
Please note: The applicant is responsible for ensuring that the application is complete. Incomplete applications and applications sent by email will not be considered. Contact details to references will be requested after the interview.
We welcome your application no later than  15th December, 2026.
For questions, please contact:
Jinhua Sun, Associate Professor,  [email protected]
We look forward to your application!
*** Chalmers declines to consider all offers of further announcement publishing or other types of support for the recruiting process in connection with this position.  ***
Chalmers University of Technology in Gothenburg conducts research and education in technology and natural sciences at a high international level. The university has 3100 employees and 10,000 students, and offers education in engineering, science, shipping and architecture. With scientific excellence as a basis, Chalmers promotes knowledge and technical solutions for a sustainable world. Through global commitment and entrepreneurship, we foster an innovative spirit, in close collaboration with wider society.
Chalmers was founded in 1829 and has the same motto today as it did then: Avancez – forward.

ap:254710.body:
Technical Student for KTH Innovation Makerspace – Help Startups Go from Idea to Prototype!
KTH Innovation is one of Europe’s leading startup hubs. Each year, we help hundreds of students and researchers explore ideas and launch startups. Our alumni include Blykalla, Airmee, TERASi, SuperAnnotate and Flox, as well as founders behind ventures such as Lovable and Neko Health.
An important part of our work is supporting teams developing physical products. That’s where you come in!
Your Role
We are looking for a student with an interest in, and experience from design and product development who wants a flexible part-time job alongside their studies. You will apply your technical skills, develop your prototyping expertise and gain insight into how startups and early-stage technologies evolve.
As a student assistant, you will support teams developing physical products, helping them move from ideas to functional prototypes in the KTH Innovation Makerspace.
Your responsibilities include:
Providing hands-on and digital support with CAD, 3D printing, laser cutting, basic electronics and prototype fabrication. You will particularly help others use 3D printers effectively and safely.
Guiding teams in defining what to test, choosing prototyping methods, planning iterations and evaluating results. Teams remain responsible for their own product development.
Introducing teams to the makerspace, its tools and equipment, and helping maintain welcoming, well-organized routines and workflows.

You will also contribute to events, study visits and administrative tasks. You will join the KTH Innovation student assistant team and collaborate with KTH's central makerspace, other makerspaces at KTH and student associations working with hardware.
The position is 30%, with flexible working hours to accommodate your studies. Some evening events are included.
Read more about KTH Innovation
Qualifications
Required - what is actually needed in the role
Admission to a first-, second- or third-cycle programme at a Swedish university.
Good spoken and written English as it is needed in daily work.
Practical knowledge of CAD software.
Experience using 3D printers.

Personal Attributes
We value inclusion, openness and diversity. You should enjoy helping people with different backgrounds and levels of experience feel welcome and confident in exploring their ideas.
You enjoy collaborating with and helping others.
You are solution-oriented and can troubleshoot practical technical problems independently.
You communicate technical concepts clearly and adapt your guidance to different levels of knowledge.
You take responsibility, show initiative and work independently.
You contribute to a welcoming environment where everyone feels comfortable asking questions, experimenting and learning.

Meriting- desirable, but not all are expected
At least one year of studies remaining at KTH.
Experience in physical product prototyping and product development.
Practical experience building hardware and/or software solutions.
Experience with makerspace equipment and manufacturing methods, such as laser cutting, casting, vacuum forming or 3D scanning.
Experience from student associations or other organizations connected to hardware and/or startups.
Knowledge of electronics.
Swedish language skills as it fascilitates daily work.

Join us at KTH
KTH shapes the future through education, research and innovation. As a leading international technical university, we play an active role in advancing the transition towards a sustainable society. At KTH, you have the opportunity to grow and develop in a creative and dynamic environment, with good working conditions and attractive benefits. Equality, diversity and equal opportunities are essential to quality and form an integral part of KTH’s core values as a university and public authority.
Learn more about our benefits and what it's like to work and grow at KTH
Trade union representatives
Contact details for trade union representatives .
Application
Apply through KTH’s recruitment system. As an applicant, you are responsible for making sure your application is complete when submitted. Your complete application must be received by KTH no later than the final day of the application period.
Instructions
The application must include the following documents:
A cover letter (maximum one page) in which you briefly: Explain why you are interested in innovation, prototyping, and the startup environment.
Provide a concrete example of something you have built, developed, or prototyped, and describe the tools, methods, or techniques you used.
Provide a concrete example of a time you helped someone else solve a technical problem, learn a tool, or make progress on a project.

A short CV (maximum one page) that focuses on the requirements and the additional desirable qualifications.

Applications that do not follow these instructions may be assessed less favourably.
Your application must be received by KTH no later than midnight CET/CEST (Central European Time/Central European Summer Time) on the final application date.
About the position
The employment is valid for a limited time according to the agreement - for up to one year with a possibility for extension, with a starting date to be agreed upon.
Other information

If this applies to the specific position, a security clearance will be conducted for the applicant in accordance with the same law with the applicant's consent. In such cases, a prerequisite for employment is that the applicant is approved following the security clearance.

ap:254711.body:
Teknisk student till KTH Innovation Makerspace – hjälp startups från idé till prototyp!
KTH Innovation rankas som en av Europas ledande startuphubbar. Varje år hjälper vi hundratals studenter och forskare att testa idéer och starta lovande startups. Bland våra alumner finns Blykalla, Airmee, TERASi, SuperAnnotate och Flox, samt grundare bakom Lovable och Neko Health.
Ditt uppdrag
Vi söker dig med intresse för och erfarenhet av design och produktframtagning och vill ha ett flexibelt deltidsjobb. Du får omsätta dina tekniska kunskaper i praktiken, utvecklas inom prototypframtagning och få erfarenhet av hur teknikidéer och startups utvecklas.
Du stöttar team som utvecklar fysiska produkter, från tidiga idéer till fungerande prototyper i KTH Innovations Makerspace. Rollen innebär både praktiskt och processledande stöd:
Du hjälper teamen med CAD-modellering, 3D-printing, laserskärning, enklare elektronik och prototyptillverkning med handverktyg. Särskilt viktigt är att kunna introducera andra till säker och effektiv 3D-printing.

Du vägleder teamen i att definiera vad en prototyp ska testa, välja metod och ambitionsnivå, planera iterationer och utvärdera resultat inför nästa steg. Teamen ansvarar själva för produktutvecklingen.

Du introducerar teamen till makerspacet och dess utrustning samt bidrar till rutiner som skapar en välorganiserad och välkomnande miljö.
Du medverkar även vid event, studiebesök och andra aktiviteter. Vissa administrativa uppgifter ingår. Du blir en del av KTH Innovations team av amanuenser och du samarbetar med KTH Biblioteks centrala makerspace samt studentföreningar och grupper inom hårdvara och produktutveckling.
Tjänsten omfattar 30 % med flexibel arbetstid anpassad efter studierna och verksamhetens behov. Vissa kvällsevent ingår.
Läs om vad vi gör på KTH Innovation
Kvalifikationer
Krav – vad som faktiskt behövs för rollen
Antagen till utbildning på grund-, avancerad- eller forskarnivå vid svenskt lärosäte.
God engelska i tal och skrift då det krävs i det dagliga arbetet.
Praktisk kunskap i en eller flera CAD-mjukvaror.
Erfarenhet av användning och hantering av 3D-skrivare.

Personliga egenskaper
Du delar våra värderingar kring inkludering, öppenhet och mångfald och vill bidra till en miljö där alla känner sig välkomna att utveckla sina idéer.
Du är social, öppen och tycker om att möta och hjälpa människor.
Du är lösningsorienterad och kan felsöka och lösa tekniska problem självständigt.
Du är pedagogisk och kan förklara tekniska moment för personer med olika förkunskaper.
Du är ansvarstagande, initiativrik och självständig.
Du bidrar till en välkomnande miljö där alla känner sig trygga att fråga, testa och lära.

Meriterande – önskvärda, men inte förväntade i sin helhet
KTH-student eller doktorand med minst ett års studier kvar.
Erfarenhet av prototyptillverkning och produktutvecklingsprocesser.
Praktisk erfarenhet av att bygga hårdvaru- och/eller mjukvarulösningar.
Erfarenhet av makerspace-utrustning och tillverkningsmetoder, exempelvis laserskärning, gjutning, vakuumformning eller 3D-scanning.
Elektronikkunskaper.
Engagemang i studentföreningar, organisationer eller andra sammanhang inom hårdvara och startups.
Kunskaper i svenska då det underlättar i det dagliga arbetet

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper.
Bli en del av KTH
KTH formar framtiden genom utbildning, forskning och innovation. Som ett ledande internationellt tekniskt universitet spelar vi en aktiv roll i att driva och medverka i omställningen till ett hållbart samhälle. Här erbjuds du möjligheten att växa och utvecklas på en kreativ och dynamisk arbetsplats med goda arbetsvillkor och förmåner. Jämställdhet, mångfald och lika villkor är en kvalitetsfråga och en självklar del av KTH:s värdegrund som universitet och statlig myndighet.
Läs mer om våra förmåner och hur det är att arbeta och utvecklas på KTH.
Fackliga representanter
Kontaktuppgifter till fackliga representanter.
Ansökan
Du ansöker via KTH:s rekryteringssystem. Du som sökande har huvudansvaret för att din ansökan är komplett när den skickas in. Din kompletta ansökan ska vara KTH tillhanda senast sista dagen för ansökningsperioden.
Instruktion :
Ansökan ska innefatta följande handlingar:
1. Ett personligt brev på max en sida där du kort:
Berättar varför du är intresserad av innovation, prototypframtagning och startupmiljön.
Ger ett konkret exempel på något du byggt, utvecklat eller prototypat och beskriver vilka verktyg, metoder eller tekniker du använde.
Ger ett konkret exempel på när du hjälpt någon annan lösa ett tekniskt problem, lära sig ett verktyg eller komma vidare i ett projekt.

2. Ett kort CV på max en sida där du fokuserar på krav och meriterande uppgifter.
Bedömningen av ansökningar som inte följer anvisningarna kommer att påverkas negativt.
Ansökan ska vara KTH tillhanda senast sista ansökningsdagen vid midnatt, CET/CEST.
Om anställningen
Anställningen gäller tidsbegränsat enligt avtal - i upp till ett år med möjlighet til förlängning, och med tillträde enligt överenskommelse.
Övrigt
För information om behandling av personuppgifter i samband med rekrytering.

Om så är fallet för just denna anställning görs en säkerhetsprövning av sökande i enlighet med säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) efter samtycke. I dessa fall är en förutsättning för anställning att sökande blir godkänd efter säkerhetsprövning.

ap:254712.body:
Let’s shape the future - University of Antwerp
The University of Antwerp is a dynamic, forward-thinking, European university. We offer an innovative academic education to more than 20 000 students, conduct pioneering scientific research and play an important service-providing role in society. We are one of the largest, most international and most innovative employers in the region. With more than 6 000 employees from 100 different countries, we are helping to build tomorrow's world every day. Through top scientific research, we push back boundaries and set a course for the future – a future that you can help to shape.
The lab of Prof. Emanuela Pasciuto and Prof. Sarah Weckhuysen from the VIB-UA Center For Molecular Neurology in the Faculty of Pharmaceutical, Biomedical and Veterinary Sciences are looking for a full-time (100%) doctoral scholarship holder in the field of Neuroimmunology
Position
You will actively work on the preparation and defence of a PhD thesis in the field of Biomedical Sciences.
You will draw up a research plan and corresponding research methods in consultation with your supervisor(s) and undertake the necessary administration for a smooth PhD process.
You will conduct the research efficiently and to an appropriate standard.
You will report progress to your supervisor(s) and committees and present your research at scientific conferences.
You will work with both human samples and animal models of disease.
You will defend your thesis publicly and aim for publication in the scientific press.
You will make a supporting, scientific contribution to existing research projects or lines of research within beyond your own doctoral research.
You will compete for internal or external predoctoral funding.

Profile
You hold a master’s degree in biomedical sciences, Biotechnologies, (and related discipline)  or you will have obtained it by the time of appointment.
The master's degree or equivalent diploma, must have been obtained not earlier than 1 February 2026
